༄nyu//'tsho byed sman pa'i lam gyi rim pa chung nga zhes pa'i bya ba'i dpe deb 'di nyid kyi ri tshori tsho ri brgyakhrims kyi bdag dbang rtsom pa po spral 'khor skal bzang la yod pas mi rigs gzhan gyi ༄skad yig nang la phab bsgyur dang dpar bskrun sogs 'grems spel gnang dgos byung tshe chog mchan nges par zhu dgos pa las/de min bshu bsgyur dang dpar bskrun sogs gtan nas gnang mi chog/༄rgya//'tsho byed sman pu'i 'am gyi rim pu chung du /44 yar/'asdob/spru'/'ashesar skal dbazang gizib ljorwadzi /rgyab sha dang deb gzags bzo mkhan/ lha sa ba phar ba stobs rgyal/dbyi ra ra dpar rtsa grog 'phrul nang bcug sgrig byed mkhan/lha sa ba mtshams lags/rgyab sha'i ri mo/ sman rams pa zla ba/kha byang yig ris/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ༷༷// dha//spriswāXstuX sgyuX rjiXhāXrdohrīX/kyi stuXgyiḥnubya'iX thaba'itshogosduma'i7625spyurnyi drosa'i bya'idzimathaba'i tshol tshokhu

ched brjod/༄༅/ /gangs can bod kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya rgyal gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa gso dpyad rig pa ni lo ngo sum stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus ldan zhing / mtha' bzhi'i gso dpyad kun gyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa'i rgya mtsho dpyad na 'dzad mtha' med pa zhig yin la/ che ba bcu gcig dang ldan zhing khyad chos du mas phyug pa/ deng dus tshan rig yar rgyas che ba'i dus rabs de 'dra'i nang rang gi ngo bo dang khyad chos la bsres lhad ma 'dres par gzhung lugs dang man ngag lag len kun la ma tshang ba med pa dang / dgos mkho ltar 'tshams shing ran pa/tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa/ rang rkya yongs su 'pher ba'i khungs ldan gyi gso ba rig pa'i srol lugs rnam par bkra zhing 'bur du thon pa zhig yin pa kun gyi khas blangs shing / de'i khyad nus la bsngags brjod kyi me tog thor zhing longs su spyod bzhin yod/ lhag par dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas chen po ji ltar phyin yod na'ang 'gro ba mi'i lus sems kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag lhag med du bcom nus pa'i thabs dang rig pa cha tshang ba zhig med la/ de bas sems sdug gi mnar ba'i lus can je mang du 'gro ba'i dus babs shig la slebs yod/ 'on 15

kyang de la sman pa'i thabs lam 'ba' zhig ni nang chos kyi rtsa ba bden bzhi lta bu yin zhing / 'das pa'i lo ngo bcu phrag kha shas nang laspyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa chen po mchog gi thugs brje'i 'od zer dang mdzad pa 'phrin las la brten nas 'dzam gling yul gru gang sar nang chos dar spel chen po phyin yod par ma zad/ chos khas mi len pa'i tshan rig pa mang pobazhibalda nas kyang bod kyi nang pa'i tshad ma rig pa dang / sems dang sems 'byung skor la do snang dang nyams zhib byed mkhan yang je mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / khong chos mgrin gcig tu de ni sems la zhi bde bskrun thub pa'i nus ldan kyi thabs lam legs shos kyi gras su ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod la/ bod kyi gso ba rig pas mtshon pa'i rang 'byung sman rdzas dang / lhag par rang re'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las mi'i lus sems kyi 'brel ba dang / nang chos bar kyi 'brel ba/ 'gro ba'i lus nad gnyen po rnams 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo ste bdag nyid gcig par 'brel tshul sogs kyi lta grub la do snang che ba'i dus babs shig la slebs yod/ der brten mi'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang dus rabs kyi rjes su bsnyegs te rang re'i gso ba rig pa'i shes bya de 'dzam gling mi mang la spel thub pa dang zhabs 'debs zhu thub pa zhig bya rgyu ni nga tsho'i phrag thog la babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin/de ltar dmigs yul de mngon du 'gyur phyir shes bya'i gnas la ṣā

brtson zhing blo sgo yangs pa'i sman rtsis mtho slob khang gi skabs bcu gsum pa'i sman slob skal bzang don ldan nas rang gi skabs babs slob sbyong bya rgyu'i brel zing las dus tshod dben pa'i ngal ba khyad bsad kyis gzhan phan lhag bsam kun nas bslangs te rang nus til 'bru tsam yang bod kyi gas ba rig pa'i bstan pa nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams brgyud 'dzin byed pa'i bya bzhag gi ched du legs skyes 'bul snyam nas da lam bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang zab mo nang don rig pa zung du 'brel tshul dang /bod kyi gso rig 'dzin pa rnams la tshang dgos pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan gyi gzhi dang / sman la tshang dgos pa'i rdzas sngags ting 'dzin nus pa dang / de sgrub tshul gyi lag len rim pa sogs nang don cha tshang zhing shes bya'i gnas la 'jug par spro ba rnams rang nyid gang zhig bslab par bya ba de'i phyogs 'tshol bde la brjod bya'i don gsal la rjod byed kyi tshig kyang go bde ba'i deb gsar 〈'tsho byed sman pa'i lam gyi rim pa chung ngu〉zhes pa brtsams bris gnang bar bcos min gyi bsngags brjod dang rjes su yid rangs zhu bzhin yod la mu mthud bya bzhag 'di'i thad 'bad brtson lhod med kyi gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa gong 'phel gtong rgyur zhabs 'debs sngar lhag zhu thub pa'i re smon bcas/ sman rams pa zla bas/ phyi lo 2006 zla 9 tshes 26 la// //stu1

sngon gleng /༄༅/ /mtho zhing brjid chags la yid du 'ong ba'i gangs ri'i mu khyud kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i chos ldan gangs can sman ljongs kyi rang byung khor yug ni/ yangs shing rgya che la sa gtsang ba/ dngas bsil rnyog ma med pa'i chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan shang shang du rgyu zhing / rlung khams bsil bsil du ldang bas me tog gi dri bsung phyogs bcur 'thul ba dang /'gro ba mi rnams kyang snying stobs che zhing lhan skyed kyi shes rig bkra bas/spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba zhi bde dang bag phebs su 'khod pa de dag la/ lo rgyus kyi rgyud rim mtshar du dngar ba'i chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs shig yin/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i phul byung gi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'di ni/ brjod bya'i nang don ni rgya che zhing gting zab la/ rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhung don la snga phyi 'brel chags shing / 'gal 'khrul sogs gang yang med pas sngon byon ston pa mnyam med shākya seng ges bstan pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos tshul spyi dang / lhag don nang pa'i thun mong ma yin gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid sman pa'i rgyal por lan gsum dbang bskur ba'i 'tsho byed gzhon nu/ mgon po klu sgrub/ arya de ba/ zla ba mngon dga' la sogs )/1

mkhas dang grub pa brnyes pa'i 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub du mas nyams su len par mdzad pa dag 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum gyi thugs bskyed bla med 'og bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i lo paṇa bka' drin can chos legs par gtan la phab ste dpal ldan rgyud bzhi bka' gter gnyis su sbas/ phyis su rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma'i rnam sprul g.yu thog gsar snying gnyis kyis bod gangs can gyi ljongs su 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs par mdzad de/ gas ba rig pa'i bstan pa rgya cher dar khyab mdzad pa dang / phyogs mtshungs khyim mtshes yul gru khag gi gso rig gi legs cha'i snying po khag gcig tu bsdus te gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun gyi yangs rtse gyur ba'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'chad nyan dri ma med pa 'di nyid da bar mi nyams chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas bzhin yod pa 'di ni sngon byon mes po bka' drin can tsho'i gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin las bskrun pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun gyi ma phyir gyur ba'i tshad ldan de dag shin tu rtsa che'i rin bral gyi khyad nor sha stag yin pa gor ma chags/des na rjes 'dzin gso ba rig par don du gnyer mkhan mchis so cog gi gso rig gzhung lugs chen mo dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnad rnams nges par mkhyen rtogs thub dgos par ma zad/ gzhan la'ang snga phyi kun tu dus rabs dang 'tshams ya/11

pa'i gnad lugs ngo ma 'grel brjod gnang thub pa bya rgyu de bas gal cher mngon/ lhag don rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i zab chos khyad par can rnams tshad ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung nas rgyab rten gyi lung / bgrod byed kyi khrid/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhu ba sogs mdzad de gang thub kyi nyams su len par shin tu gal 'gangs che bar ma zad/ sman rdzas rigs kyi 'byung khungs khag la lta zhib zab nan bgyis te skye dngos rtsi shing dang / srog chags/rang 'byung gter kha sogs sman rigs so so'i khyad chos dngos dang mthun pa'i ro nus bzhu rjes kyi byed las khyad 'phags can gyis rang byung khams kyi nad rigs sna tshogs la 'thab rtsod dang / phan nus ji thon thad la mkhyen rtogs thub dgos pa dang / phyogs mtshungs sman sbyor sdeb rdzas kyi lag rtsal dngos la gzhi rgya che ba'i bod kyi gso rig shes yon gyi slob sbyong la rmang gzhi'i rkang pa brtan po tshugs thub gal che stabs/ nga tshos rgyun du thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig pa'i gzhung lugs de dag la dga' tshor chen po'i ngang slob sbyong dang / nyams len/ do snang / gces spras byas te gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs spyi dang / bye brag dmigs bkar ched las mkhas pa'am rig gcig rkang 'dzin gyi mi sna mang dag cig skyed bsrings yong thabs dang 'brel/ deng rabs tshan rtsal rig pa'i gzhung lugs la'ang sbyangs brtson byas te thun mong zung 'brel thog gsar btod 517

kyi rnam pa yong thabs la yang 'bad 'bungs dang hur brtson bstud mar bgyis te/ sgo gang sa nas sman rtsis bstan pa nyams pa slar gso dang / mi nyams rgyun 'dzin dar spel yong slad phan tshun gyi shes yon dang / nyams myong / bsam tshul bcas spel res thog legs cha'i snying don gtso gras rnams gtan 'bebs yig char 'god thub pa dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi mi rabs rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed phyir gsar btod kyi lam kha zhig bskrun rgyu na nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di'i phrag par 'khri ba'i ches snyi ba'i las 'gan zhig yin par smos ci 'tshal nge / ri nga ji ri spo ba gang zhig mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang / na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i tshor ba gcig gyur yin pas/ nga tshos rin thang bral ba'i 7rgyal ba'i bka' slob kyi snying bcud byams brtse zhes pa 'di nyid nyams su blangs te mi rigs dang / rigs rus/ mtho dman/ dbul phyug yo mo sogs kyi dbye 'byed gang yang med par cirang nyid mi rigs kyi sron rgyun bzang po'i lta ba gzhir bzung gzhan phan gyi bde rtsar dmigs nas bod pa'i spyi tshogs tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling mi rigs hril po'i spyi tshogs 'dir bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nang pa'i chos tshul bzang po dang / bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'di nyid bed spyad de legs skyes dpyis phyin pa zhig phul nas phan rlabs kyi nus pa gzengs su thon pa gnang gal che bas kun gyis lhag bsam cher bskyed yas

gnang ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ deb 'di rtsom 'bri'i bya ba'i phyogs gang sar 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i rigs ji snyed cig yong srid pas mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i spyan sngar 'thol lo bshags shing / rgya che'i gzigs pa pos skyon brjod rogs ram gnang bar snying dbus nas dga' bsu zhu/ shes dman skal bzang don ldan gyis/ phyi lo 2007 zla 9cesas 26 la// / / 551

dkar chags bcad gnyis pa/ thun min nang gi sdon 'gro'i rim pa khag bshad pa/le'u dgu pa/ skyabs 'gro'i skor bshad pa/ 392dang po/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 392gnyis pa/ phan yon dang bslab bya/ 396gsum pa/ bye brag dkon gsum gyi yon tan dran cing dad par byed pa/ 399bzhi pa/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rim dngos/ 402lnga pa/ mjug bsdu ba/ 408le'u bcu pa/ sems bskyed kyi skor bshad pa/ 410dang po/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis sgo nas thog mar blo sbyong bar byed pa/ 410gnyis pa/ tshad med bzhi las btang snyoms tshad med/ 411gsum pa/ byams pa tshad med/ 414bzhi pa/ snying rje tshad med/ 417lnga pa/ dga' ba tshad med/ 424drug pa/ sems skyed dngos/ 428bdun pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam par blta ba/ 431brgyad pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba/ 434dgu pa/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa/ 441bcu pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ 447btsug tshul khrims pha rol tu phyin pa/ 452brtsus/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ 456bcu gsum/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ 4665511

bcu bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ 473bco lnga / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ 477le'u bcu gcig bstod phyag 'bul ba'i skor bshad pa/ 483dang po/ bstod phyag gi dmigs rim/ 483gnyis pa/ bstod phyag dngos 'bul ba dang phan yon/ 484gsum pa/ rje bla ma g.yu thog pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan/ 486bzhi pa/ bstod phyag 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 490lnga pa/ mjug bsdu tshul/ 994le'u bcu gnyis/ maṇḍal gyi skor bshad pa/ 496dang po/ tshogs gnyis gsog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 496gnyis pa/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu bstan pa/ 498gsum pa/ maṇḍal 'bul tshul gyi dmigs rim dngos/ 500bzhi pa/ phyi'i maṇḍal 'bul ba/ 504lnga pa/ nang gi maṇḍal 'bul ba/ 505drug pa/ gsang ba'i maṇḍal 'bul ba/ 505bdun pa/ mjug bsdu ba/ 506brgyad pa/ maṇḍal gyi phan yon bstan pa/ 508le'u bcu gsum/ sman sgrub kyi skor bshad pa/ 514dang po/ sa gzhi byin rlabs/ 514gnyis pa/ rang nyid lhar skyed pa/ 515gsum pa/ sman sgrub kyi dmigs rim/ 516bzhi pa/ sman mchod 'bul tshul/ 517lnga pa/ mjug bsdu tshul/ 52055111

le'u bcu bzhi/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi skor bshad pa/ 521dang po/ sdig pa bshags pa'i tshul/ 521gnyis pa/ gnyen po stobs bzhi/ 525gsum pa/ rdor sems bsgoms bzlas dngos/ 526bzhi pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba/ 532lnga pa/ mjug bsdu ba/ 534le'u bco lnga / ku swā la'i tshogs bsags kyi skor bshad pa/ 537dang po/ ku swa la'i go don/ 537gnyis pa/ ku swa la'i tshogs gsog gi dmigs rim dngos/ 539gsum pa/ ku swa la'i mchod sprin 'bul tshul/ 543bzhi pa/ mjug bsdu zhesal/ 544le'u bcu drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skor bshad pa/ 547dang po/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ 547gnyis pa/ spyan 'dren pa/ 551gsum pa/ spyir yan lag bcu pa 'bul tshul/ 552bzhi pa/ bla na yod pa dang bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'bul tshul/ 553lnga pa/ bshags pa 'bul tshul/ 554drug pa/ rjes su yi rangs ba 555bdun pa/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba/ 556brgyad pa/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/ 557dgu pa/ dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba/ 558bcu pa/ phan yon bstan pa/ 559btsug sman gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 561〉〈1〉(

bstsus/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs rim dngos/ 567bcu gsum/ dbang bzhi len pa/ 569 bcu bzhi/ mthar tshogs zhing 'od du 'thim tshul/ 57/bco lnga / mthar lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog tshul/ 572mjug byang / 574dpar byang smon tshig 57755
sa bcad gnyis pa/thun mong nang gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa khag bshad pa/391

le'u dgu pa/skyabs 'gro'i skor bshad pa la lnga/dang po/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/de ltar sngon du thun mong phyi'i rim pa khag brjod zin ma thag pa de nas thun min nang gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa khag la 'jug par bya ba las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba la'ang / skyabs su ma song ba'i sngon du 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa la bsam par bya dgos te/ mtha' yas kyi ma rgan 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur cing / sdug bsngal ba dang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa na/ de yang dmyal ba na gnas pa'i sems can dag ni rab 'bar lcags kyi sa gzhi chen po'i steng du shin tu mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po myong bzhin yod pa dang / yang na ni shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i grang reg gi sdug bsngal tshad med pa dag rab tu myong zhing yod pa dang / de yang dus yun thung du tsam ma yin par dus yun skal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos pa yin/ de bzhin du yi dgas kyi gnas su zas kham gcig tsam yang longs su spyod pa'i bskal ba 392

med par bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal gyis rab tu mnar ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros zhan cing blo rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal tshad med pa dang / gcig gis gcig za ba'i 'jig pa dang / gsod pa'i sdug bsngal dang / gzhan gyis bkol spyod byed pa'i sdug bsngal sogs mang po rab tu myong bar 'gyur ba yin pas/nga rang tsho mi'i mi tshe'i nang nyin ltar ngan 'gro ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di dag gi rang bzhin yid la dran par byed dgos te/ mgon po klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yis//dmyal ba'i zhi ma ci zhig dran/ /bkres skom dag gis rid pa yis/ /yi dgas dag kyang dran par bya/ /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab mang ba/ /byol song dag kyang dran pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na yin zhing / de ltar ngan song gsum tsam ma yin par lha la 'chi 'pho dang tshe ring gi sdug bsngal dang / lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la skye ba'i sdug bsngal/rga ba'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ngan thog tu babs pa dang / 'dod pa'i bde ba 'bad pas rtsal kyang ma snyed pa/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ rgyu nor longs spyod kyi dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / thabs dang 'bad pa chen pos rgyu nor gsog sgrub ched yar 'gro brgya dang mar 'gro stong sogs byed pa'i dka' tshegs kyi 393

sdug bsngal/ nor rdzas 'byor yang kun jag dang longs su spyod dbang med pa'i sdug bsngal/ glo bur 'byung ba sa chu me rlung 'khrugs pa'i gnod 'tshe'i sdug bsngal/ dmag 'khrugs dang mu ge'i sdug bsngal/ nga rgyal dang 'gran rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ na tsha mang zhing tshe mi rtag cing mi brtan pa'i sdug bsngal sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa dngos su myong bas grub cing mthong chos su gyur ba yin pas na/ nga tshos rin thang bral ba'i ba rtse ba snying rje chen por blo sbyong ste sems rab tu bskyed de bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag ste de las skyob pa'i nus pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum la yod pas/ dkon mchog gi yon tan yid la dran par byas te mos gus kyi dad pa chen po'i sgo nas snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya dgos pa yin/ de yang skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal de dag las thar ba'i ched du yin/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gong ma dkon mchog gsum yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las krol ba yin pa ma zad/ gzhan khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las skyob thub pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan khyad par can gyi nus mthu dang ldan pa zhig ci nas kyang yin dgos/ gal te skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul de 'khor ba zhes zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po skye ba'i rgyun gyi cha la zer 394

bas/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba las ma grol ba na gzhan sems can rnams kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas de dag las nam yang grol mi thub pa yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ nga tshos 'khor ba na gnas pa'i lha klu dang / 'dre srin dug pa can dang / yul lha zhi bdag dang / rgyal po dang btsan sogs kyi rigs gang la yang dus nam yang skyabs su 'gro mi rung ba yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang yang 'khor ba'i brtson rar bcings pa na/ 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba dang phyi nang gi dbye ba gtso bo yang / dang po skyabs 'gro'i 'jug sgo kho nar rag lus yod/ lhag don bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i sman pa gang dag gis bsten par 'os pa'i srung ma ni/ sngon dus mi lo nyis stong lnga brgya'i gong du ston pa mnyam med shākya seng ge dang / rgyal ba sman gyi bla mas dngos su sman gyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i rnam sras la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po bzhi/ rgyan 'dzin la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis bcas ni bka' 'gyur nang sangs rgyas sman bla'i sman mdo rang nas dngos su bstan yod pa ma zad/rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po 'gro mgon mahā gu ṇa'i bka' bsgos ltar sman srung dam can sde dgu bcas ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan 395

pa bcas gcig tu 'brel ba'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la/ yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir sman gyi bstan pa 'dzin cing spel bar mdzad pa la rtag tu srung skyob 'phrin las g.yel med du bsgrub par mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos srung ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i srung ma sha stag bsten par byed pa las/ gzhan 'jig rten na lha 'dre dang / rgyal btsan/ dam sri gdug pa can sogs kyi rigs gtan nas bsten mi rung ba'i gnad gcig yin/ /gnyis pa/ phan yon dang bslab bya/stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten chen po'i nang yid bzhin nor bu las rtsa che zhing / shin tu snyed par dka' la/ srid 'dir dkon pa'i mchog dam pa nyid yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir//mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir//'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /ces gsungs pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i ma gyur nam mkha'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla ma dkon mchog gsum la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas srog las gces par 'dzin pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro na de'i phan yon la'ang bsam gyis ma khyab yod de/ skyabs gsum bsod nams gzugs mchis na/ /stong gsum ri396

'di yang snod du chung / /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /phul gyi gzhal bas ga la nus/ /zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la yon tan gyi tshad 'di tsam mo/ zhes nga tshos gtan nas brjod mi thub par ma zad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sman mdo las kyang / ngas de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla beeḍarya 'od kyi rgyal po de'i yon tan brjod par 'gyur na ni/ bskal pa las lhag gi bskal pa yang zad par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing dkon mchog gi yon tan ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod gyis mi lang ba yin pas dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro na yang / skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dang 'bras bu'ang rnam par smin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin te/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byed na/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ rnam dag zhing du spyod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa rang yin gshis/ de ltar lus can su zhig skyabs su song ba'i bslab bya ni/ bla ma la skyabs su song nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la dad log byed pa dang bskur ba btab pa sogs gtan nas byed mi rung zhing / gal te dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul log par gyur na ni/ gang zag de yi rgyud la yon tan dang nyams rtogs sogs rtsa ba nas skye bar mi 'gyur ba yin/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas/ sku brnyan sogs la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du 397

shes bskyed de bkur sti dang phyag mchod byed dgos par ma zad/ 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre la skyabs bcol mi rung / chos la skyabs su song nas gsung rab yi ge na gcig tshun chad la chos dkon mchog gi 'du shes bskyed de gus pas bsten dgos par ma zad/ lhag par 'gro ba sems can su zhig la 'tshe ba gtan nas byed mi rung / dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas/ dge 'dun bzhi grwa tshun la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi 'du shes bskyed de bsnyen bkur bsod nams gsog dgos la/ ma zad las 'bras dang lta ba log pa can sogs mi dge ba'i sdig grogs gang dang mnyam du 'grogs mi rung / de ltar skyabs 'gro'i sgrub pa'i bslab bya dang / dgag pa'i bslab bya gnyis la tshul bzhin 'jug gang thub byed pa dang / sgos su dkar nag las 'bras kyi dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas la phyin ci ma log pa cis kyang byed dgos pa yin te/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye'i gdeng med cing / /de yi 'jigs skyob dkon mchog gsum du nge sa/ /de yi skyabs 'gro shin tu brtan pa dang / /de yang bslab bya nyams pa med par bya/ /de yi dkar nag las 'bras legs bsam ste//blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub la rag las so/ /zhes gsungs pa na rgyu dge mi dge gang rung bsags zin pa na las byas pa chud mi za bas na 'bras bu yang bde sdug gi tshor ba mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs su myong bar 'gyur rba ni chos nyid rten 'brel rang gshis dang las 'bras ni shin tu dbang 398

btsan pa'i phyir te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bram ze rnams ni dge sdig dag /sbyin par le zhing 'pho bar smra/ /khyod kyis byas chud mi za dang / /ma byas pa dang 'phrad med gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no//gsum pa/ bye brag dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran cing dad par byed pa/ gang la skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba ni dkon mchog gsum kho na yin cing / de gsum ni ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas/ skyob pa bla na med pa dam chos/ 'dren pa bla na med pa dge 'dun bcas yin zhing / ci zhig la dkon cog ces snyam na ni/ rang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol ba/ gzhan sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol ba'i thabs la mkhas pa/ sems can kun la thugs rje nye ring med pa/ phan gdags ma gdags thams cad kyi don rlabs po che mdzad pa la dkon mchog ces brjod pa lags na/ bla ma la skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba ni 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad rtsa ba theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen kho na la rag las shing / rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni don dam du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gsum ga 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'dul bya'i don du bla ma'i skur shar ba 399

yin te/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun chos//kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma dag la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs shing rgyas pa gong du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul skor la gzigs par 'tshal/ sangs rgyas rna nyon mongs pa'i dri ma mtha' dag las sangs pa dang / shes bya'i glo gros mchog tu rgyas pa na sangs rgyas zhes brjod cing / sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dus ma byas sogs yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug de la go dgos shing / yon tan brgyad po de dag ni rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas sheng lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces skye 'jig gi gnas dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan/ 'bad rtsol nyer zhi ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan/ sgra rtog snang bas ji bzhin rtogs mi nus pa'i yon tan/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos kun ma lus pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i yon tan/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i mthu stobs kyi nus pa'i yon tan/ rang don spang pa phun tshogs kyi yon tan/ gzhan don rtogs pa phun tshogs kyi yon tan bcas dang ldan par gyur ba ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog kho na'i khyad chos yin cing / mdor bsdus na/ don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug de yin/ /400

chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi rnam byang bden pa de yin zhing / chos dkon mchog gi yon tan brgyad ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyi/ /gang zhig gang gi chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /zhes bsam du med pa'i yon tan/ las nyon gnyis su med pa'i yon tan/ tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog med pa'i yon tan/ lam gyi ngo bor sgrib pa med cing dag pa'i yon tan/ ji lha ji snyed kyi chos gsal ba'i yon tan/ mi mthun nyon mongs phyogs kyi gnyen po'i yon tan/ gang zhig la chags pa dang bral ba'i 'gog bden gyi yon tan/ gang zhig gis chags pa dang bral bar byed pa'i lam gyi bden pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa bcas ni chos dkon mchog kho na'i khyad chos sam yon tan yin cing / mdor na 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis su bsdu ba yin/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid ni/ rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag de yin zhing / yon tan brgyad po de dag ni/ rgyud las/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /ces ji lta ba rig pa'i yon tan/ ji snyed pa rig pa'i yon tan/ nang rig pa'i yon tan/ chags pa med pa dag pa'i yon tan/ thogs pa med pa dag pa'i yon tan/ dman 401

pa med pa dag pa'i yon tan/ rig pa'i yon tan/ grol ba'i yon tan dang bcas ldan pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi khyad chos kho na yin zhing / mdor na rig grol gyi yon tan gnyis su bsdu ba yin/ /bzhi pa/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rim dngos /gong du bstan zin pa'i 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar ba'i mtha' yas pa'i nyam thag ma rgan sems can thams can mthar med 'jigs su rung ba'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar ba'i ched du rang nyid thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gi don du gnyer zhing / bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal rtsa gsum sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya snyam nas thog mar/ gnas khang gtsang mar stegs su khebs gtsang sngo ljang steng du dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇa ḍal padma 'dab ma lnga'i bris pa'i dbus su dang / phyogs bzhir 'bras 'bru sogs kyis tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du rje btsun guṇa'am g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i sku brnyan rab gnas byin chen ldan pa gang rung bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du/ sman mchog a ru ra/ dza ti sogs bzang po drug ra mnye sogs 402

rtsa ba lnga bcas sna tshogs pa'i sman dang rin chen dang dar sna tshogs dngos su 'byor na bkram/ ma 'byor rung yid kyis spyan gzigs sna tshogs pa sprul nas 'a di ltar/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag 'thil ltar mnyam beeḍūrya'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyi sprul/ /kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha wa te/zhes sa gzhi thams cad byin gyis brlabs te lta na sdug pa'i zhing phan sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi rang bzhin du dmigs te bsgoms pa dang / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma 'dam ma bzhi rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i mnyam med sprul pa'i skye mchog chen po mtshungs med rje btsun ma hā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dbu skra lcang lo me tog gis spras pa/ phyag g.yas 'gro ba mtha' dag la mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i brdar mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utal gyi sdong bu gsar pa 'dzin pa/ sku'i snyan gyi g.yas phyogs su thad kur kha bye ba'i steng du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi bdag por nges pa'i brdar chos kyi glegs bam dang ral gyis mtshon pa/phyag g.yon pa 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum rang 403

bzhin du bstan pa'i brdar thugs kur chos 'chad phyag rgyas pad sdong bsnams pa/ sku'i snyan gyi g.yon phyogs su thad ker chu skyes 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gur kum gzhon nu'i dzekha rgyan dang bcas pa la/ nor bu dbang rgyal/ gser rdor/ sman mchog a ru ra bcas kyi g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa can te/ bum pa rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dang / nor bu rgyal ba rin 'byung / gser rdor rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ a ru ra rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad/ kha rgyan gur kum rgyal ba dom yod grub pa ste rgyal ba rigs lnga / me long ye shes/bya grub ye shes/ sor rtogs ye shes/ mnyam nyid ye shes/ chos dbyings ye shes bcas ye shes lnga yi dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha'i 'od kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i brdar dang / mchog thun dang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas nyam thag sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i brdar dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ thugs zag med rdo rje lta gi'i ye shes la 'pho 'gyur med pas 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i drudar zhabs rdo rje skyil dkrung du bzhugs pa la 'khor du lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor te/ mdun du snye mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang sgyur ba/ g.yas su lha mo ser mo bya rgod kyi rkang gling sgyur ba/ rgyab tu lha mo dmar mo mi rkang gi gling bu sgyur ba/ g.yon du lha mo ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long bstan pa bcu drug gi lang 'tsho dar ba'i na 404

tshod can 'dzum sgeg 'gyings mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldan rked par rin po che'i me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing / dbu skra lcang mo sil ma mu tig dmar po'i lan tshar dang bcas pa sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs ldan pas gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo la zag med bde stong gi mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'bul bar dmigs te/ steng phyogs su byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mthar thug dngos rgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun thugs kyi thad du dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drugamadun du dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyi dang /lhag par ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la sogs pa'i sman bla bde bshegs mched brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyis mtshon sems dpa' chen po bcu drug dang / de'i mtha' skor du 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i mtha' skor du tshangs dang brgya byin sogs gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis/yang de dag gi mtha' skor du mu khyud gcig gi phyi rol du zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs sman srung dam can sde dgu'i tshogs dang / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du sman srung rig 'dzin drang srong gi tshogs thams cad mkha' dbyings su gza' skar bkra ba lta bur bzhugs pa dang / rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir yul 405

'khor srung / 'phags skyes po/ spyan mi bsad/ rnam thos sras sogs rgyal po chen po bzhis yongs su bskor zhing / de dag thams cad sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'ja' dang 'od kyi phung po 'khrigs pa'i klong du bzhugs shing / mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo mang pos glu gar rol mo mchod pa'i bye brag spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod du med pa mchod de bskor bar gyur bsams te/ dmigs rim bskyangs pa'i skabs su phyag gnyis thal mor sbyar te/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud ste dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab nas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla beeḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i rtsa gsum rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar khra lham mer gsal por bsgoms te/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su tshe 'di'i drin chen ma yis gtso byas pa'i ma gyur sems can rnams dang / g.yon phyogs su tshe 'di'i drin chen phas gtso byas pa'i sems can mdun du tshe 'di'i dgra bgegs kyis gtso byas pa'i dgra bo rnams dang / rgyab tu phan gnod dgra gnyen sogs gang yang min pa'i btang snyoms su gnas pa'i bar ma'i sems can bcas 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad mi yi lus su bsgyur te/ dus 'di nas bzung ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal rtsa 406

gsum dkyil 'khor gyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su 'gro bar bya snyam ste/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu snyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don grub 'thob par mi 'gyur te/ /gal te 'di las phan pa ma grub na/ /phyi nas yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur// zhes da res dus lan cig tsam shin tu snyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rtsa chen po 'di nyid thob pa ni bskal ba bzang / 'di lta bu'i 'gro ba mi'i lus rten dang rnam dpyod kyi blo gros bzang po'i phyogs su bed spyad pa las rnam dpyod log par bed spyad na ni/ phyis su slar yang mi lus bzang po zhig e 'thob bsams te/da res dal rten yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa'i mi lus 'di snyed dka' zhing / grog mkha'i glog dang 'dra bar 'jig sla ba'i tshe mi rtag cing mi brtan pa'i tshul la yang mno bsam zhib tu btang nas/ srid gsum mi rtag ston kha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i grog dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro// zhes pa'i don la legs par bsams pa'i mthar/na mo rigs 'dus bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos/ /bdag gzhan byang chub ma thob par/ /snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan grangs brgya dang / rtsa gcig nyer gcigabadun/ gsum sogs dus kyi long yod med la bltas te sman pa zhig gi mi tshe'i nang nyin rer rgyun du snga dgong gang rung du nges par ci nas kyang 407

skyabs su 'gro dgos pa yin/ /lnga pa/ mjug bsdu ba/de ltar skyabs su 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs su rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor nas sku gsum thugs kyi byin rlabs zag med chu bo'i rgyun ltar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la char du babs te rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol bsams/ byin brlab dang bdud rtsi 'beb sbyangs byed na'ang 'grig mthar skyabs 'gro mjug bsdu ba'i mtshams su ma rgan sems can thams cad bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud par gyur song bsams te rang rgyud la kun rdzob kyi skyabs 'gro rgyud la skye dgos pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gong ma rnams chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa dang / skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / skyabs su 'gro ba'i byed las dang bcas pa de dag thams cad chos kun gdod nas stong pa nyid du dbyer med ro gcig par gyur ba'i chos kyi gnas lugs mthar thug rang ngor rtogs par byas te/ don dam gyi skyabs 'gros rgyas thebs pa bya dgos pa yin/ rang nyid kyi rgyud la skyabs 'gro rnam par dag pa zhig yod tshe de nas theg chen gyi lam sna zin cing / 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre 408

gdug rtsub can gang gi rigs la'ang 'jigs skrag mi skye zhing / da dung de dag las nyon gyi gzhan can du gyur zhing 'khor ba na sdug bsngal gsum gyi mnar ba'i nyam thag pa'i sems can ya nga ba dang / snying rje ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yin pas bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa ngan pa dang bral nas/ phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur bar shog bsam pa'i snying rje'i blo yang gong du 'phel bar 'gyur zhing /des bsod nams dang ye shes kyis tshogs rab tu rdzogs shing / mthar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa'i gnas mtha' dag las grol thub pa yin no// // 409

le'u bcu pa/ sems bskyed kyi skor bshad pa la bco lnga /dang po/ rgyu 'bras man ngag drug gis sgo nas thog mar blo sbyong bar byed pa/rgyu 'bras man ngag drug gis sgo nas thog mar blo sbyong bar byed pa ni/nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma ma byas pa med snyam pa'i mar shes dgos/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ da lta'i tshe 'dir rang la pha ma gnyis yod dgos la 'di nas tshe 'phos nas skye ba phyi mar yang pha ma yod dgos/ der brten rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas ma gyur sems can thams cad zhes smos pa ni rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa yin/ de ltar nga tshos skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur phyin pa'i dbang gis ngo ma phrod pa ma gtogs da lta'i pha ma ltar sha rus gdod byas kyi phung por sha khrag gi 'brel ba bzang pos zas kyi phud dang gos kyi rtse sogs shin tu byams brtse'i drin gyis bskyangs nas rang rkya 'pher ba'i 'tshar longs thub pa sha stag yin pas/ pha ma sems can thams cad rang la drin chen po yin pa bsams te drin dran dgos/ ma rgan de rnams 410

sdug bsngal chen po gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin gyi bde bas phongs pa sha stag yin pas gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i rten bzang dang / mthar thug nges legs rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya snyam pa'i pha ma sems can gyi drin bzo ba dang / ma de rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bdag gis bya snyam pa ni byams pa dang / khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por gnas pa'i pha ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral bar bdag gis bya snyam pa ni snying rje dang / de ltar mtha' yas pa'i nyam thag sems can thams cad srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bdag nyid gcig bus nges par 'don par bya snyam ste sems can don du khur chen po blangs pa ni lhag bsam bskyed par bcas rgyu 'bras man ngag drug gi sgo nas blo yang yang du sbyong dgos pa yin/ /gnyis pa/ tshad med bzhi las btang snyoms tshad med bstan pa/bdag dang snang ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis 411

dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig ces btang snyoms kyi blo sbyong dgos pa yin/ de yang / da lta'i rang gi tshe 'di'i pha ma dang spun mched/ bza' zla bu phrug dang / grogs po spogs mo/ dga' nye blo dga' sogs blo chags pa'i yul du gyur ba'i dum bu gcig dang /yang rigs gcig la rtag tu phan tshun nga rgyal dang / zhe sdang dang / phrag dog 'khon 'dzin/ khong khro byed pa sogs sems khongs zhe thag pa nas snang ba'i yul du gyur ba'i dum bu gcig de ltar chags sdang gnyis kyi phyogs gang du yang ma song ba'i phan gnod med pa'i bar ma'i yul du gyur ba'i dum bu gcig bcas mdor na/ mi'i mi tshe'i nang du dgra gnyen bar ma gsum du 'dzin pa'i ma dag blo yi snang ba phyin ci log pa can gyi kun nas bslangs te/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i gegs chen po zhig byed pa yin/ der brten nas ma dag pa'i blo yi snang ba ya ma zung 'di dag pa'i blo yi snang ba 'ba' zhig tu yang yang sbyong dgos pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni da lta'i rang gi tshe 'di'i pha ma dang spun nye dang dga' nye blo dga' byed sa'i yul du gyur ba 'di rnams dus snga mo zhig gam dus gdod ma nyid nas dga' nye glo dga' can zhig ma yin par rang la gnod pa bskyel ba'i dgra bo zhig tu yang lan mang gyur zin/ dus skye ba phyi ma yang rtag tu rang gi pha ma spun nye lta bur 'gyur mi srid pa yin/ yang da lta'i rang gi tshe 'dir mi dga' ba'i yul du gyur ba'i dgra bo dang / nga rgyal 412

can/ phrag dog can/ zhe snang can/ rang la gnod pa byed mkhan 'di rnams dus ring po zhig nas da lta bar rtag tu gnod 'tshe byas pa kho na ma yin par rang la phan pa'i bya ba yang byas yod/ dus skye ba phyi ma yang 'di rnams rtag tu brtan par gnas pa'i dgra bo sha stag ma yin par rang gi pha ma dang / zla bo/ spun nye/ grogs po sogs du mar 'gyur 'gro ba yang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pa ma zad dngos su myong bas grub thub pa yin/ dper na/ phan tshun pho mo gnyis bza' tshang gi khyim thab bsgrigs/sha khrag gi 'brel ba dam por bzung / lan chags kyi bu phrug btsas/ brtse dung dang 'dun pa drag po bcangs/ skad cig tsam bral mi phod pa'i gnyen du 'dzin/ yid ches dang snying gtam bshad res byas/ phyis su phan tshun mi mthun pa'i 'thab rtsod byung ste/ pha ma kha bral/ bu phrug ya thor/ khyim tshang thor bshig tu song nas phyogs phan tshun gnyis ka mthong na mi 'dod pa'i dgra lta bu chags nas 'khon du 'dzin/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog byas/phan tshun zur za dang smod res byas pa sogs mi'i spyi tshogs nang dngos su mthong chos su gyur ba yin/ yang 'ga' zhig tshe stod du dgra ru 'dzin kyang tshe smad du gnyen du 'gyur ba dang / kha shas tshe stod gnyen du gyur kyang tshe smad du dgra ru gyur ba sogs dgra gnyen la dus brtan du nges pa zhig rtsa ba nas med par shes thub pa yin/ de'i phyir mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams rang gi pha mar ma gyur ba gcig kyang med la/ de rnams 413

kyis byams brtse'i drin gyis bskyangs pa la'ang tshad med par song sems can thams cad rang la drin chen po yin pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la nye ring dang chags sdang med par glo snyoms par bzhag pa ni btang snyoms tshad med la blo sbyong tshul yin/ /gsum pa/ byams pa tshad med/de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces byams pa sgom dgos pa yin/ de yang sngon du btang snyoms kyi blo la yang yang sbyangs pa'i rjes su rang nyid bde ba 'thob par 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal ni khab rtse tsam yang mi 'dod pa'i tshor ba yod pa 'di rgyu mtshan du byas te gzhan sems can thams cad kyang de dang 'dra bar 'dod pa bde ba dang / mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba gcig gyur yod pa 'di shes par byas nas gzhan la sdang sems dang gnod sems mi skye bar phan tshun byams pa'i sems kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba gnyis kyi blang dor phyin ci ma log par dge ba'i las lam bzang por thabs dang sgo du mas bskyed par byas te/ sems can bde ba la ci nas kyang 'god par bya snyam ste blo sbyong dgos pa yin te/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ mig gis sems can blta na yang //414

drangs shing byams pa'i tshul gyis blta/ /zhes rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas 'gro ba sems can gzhan su la'ang gnod pa dang 'tshe ba mi bya bar drangs shing byams pa'i tshul kho na la 'jug gang thub ci thub byed dgos pa yin/ kun bzang zhal lung las/ snying thag pa nas gzhan la phan par 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa kho na bya/ bdag skye ba nas skye ba/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du sems can gzhan gyi tha na ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la gnod pa byed pa la ma gyur cig phan 'dogs par gyur cig snyam du yang nas yang du smon lam gdab/ ces gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i thugs smon khyad par rgyas pa zhig yin la/ de lta bu'i smon lam khyad par can 'grub par gyur ba ni/ rgyal bas zhal gyis bzhes te/ gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs yod/ dper na gsar snyed ḍi se kā par ri zhes pa'i gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin nang du bya ngur pa pha ma gnyis kyi phru gu drug tsam skam sa chen po zhig nas mtsho gling gcig gi nang du gom pa brgyab nas 'khrid yong ba'i lam bar du khyi spyang wa mo 'dra ba zhig glo bur du thug song bas/ des phru gu rnams 'dod rngam chen pos bza' bar 'gro ba'i tshe bya ngur pa a ma des rang nyid blos btang ste/ khyi spyang de'i kha'i mdun du song nas gshog pa gnyis ther ther du bkrams nas brdab brdab byed pa dang chabs cig mgrin pa nas kyang gre gre zhes skad sgrogs 415

par gyur ba na/ khyi spyang des bya ngur pa a ma de bza' bar rgyugs song bas/bya a ma des phar tsam 'phur nas yang sngar bzhin gshog pa gnyis dgrad de brdab brdab byas/ slar yang khyi spyang des phyogs der song bas yang phar tsam 'phur/ de ltar lan 'ga' shas shig byed pa'i dus yun de'i nang du pha ma gcig gis bya phrug gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad mtsho gling de'i chu nang du khrid thub pa byung ma thag bya ngur pa a ma de gnam du 'phur nas mtshe'u de'i nang du babs nas phru gu de dag mnyam dang du chu nang du bde bar bskyod thub pa byung mtshams su khyi spyang de ci bya 'di byed med par bya ngur pa a ma de'i mgo skor 'og tu tshud par gyur song / de ltar rang byung khor yug nang rnam dpyod kyi rtsal zhan pa'i bya byi'u dang khyi spyang dud 'gro'i rigs kyi byams brtse'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang / skyong stangs mi 'dra ba snying rje po 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po 'dug par brten/nga tsho 'gro ba mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas mi'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal rab tu phyug pa des rang byung khor yug nang gi byams brtse'i sems khur dang / 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ byams skyong dang gso skyong byed stangs sogs mi 'dra ba khag la legs bya'i yon tan bzang po len dgos pa dang / mi'i rnam dpyod de bzang po'i phyogs su bed spyad de rin thang bral ba'i byams brtse la goms 'dris bsten thabs byed dgos pa ni gal che gos shig yin la/byams brtse'i sems kyi yon tan bzang po 'di dag la longs su spyad de 416

gong 'phel gtong thub na 'gro ba mi'i khyad chos ngo ma de kho na yin la/ mi tshe'i nang gi ches snying po'i snying po yang byams brtse zhes pa de gnyis rang yin par brten/ 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gis byams brtse'i nus stobs zhes pa'i thad la deng sang 'dzam gling gang sar bka' slob bka' drin thugs rje chen po bskyangs dang skyong bzhin yod pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa chen po'i mdo sngags kyi chos kyi nying bcud cig dang / 'dzam gling nang 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'gro ba mis gtsos srog chags dung phyur phrag phrig grangs las 'das pa dag la phral yun kun tu phan bder gyur ba'i ches shin tu rtsa che'i nor bu zhig kyang yin pas/ nga tshos mi tshe'i nang du rgyun du gang thub kyi bsam blo btang nas nyams su len ci thub byed dgos/ /bzhi pa/ snying rje tshad med/sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces snying rje bsgom par bya ba ni/ dmigs pa mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal gsum gyi dus rgyun chad med par rab tu mnar ba'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bral 'dod kyi blo brtse ba snying rje chen po la 'bad 417

pa du mas yang nas yang du bsgom par bya dgos pa yin/ de yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mnar med rab tsha tsha ba dang / /ngu 'bod che dang ngu 'bod chung / /bsdus 'joms thig nag yang sos te/ /tsha dmyal brgyad las thar bar shog /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol/ /so 'tham a chu kye hud dang / /u dpal padma ches gas te/ /grang dmyal brgyad las thar ba shog /nye tshe nye 'khor ro myag 'dam/ /mi gtsang 'dam dang me mur 'obs//chu bo rab med shal ma ri/ /de dag gnas las thar bar shog /ces bskal pa brgya phrag du mar tshad me da pa'i sems can dmyal ba mnar me da la sogs dmyal khams bco brgyad na bde ba skad cig tsam yang med par rtag tu sdug bsngal mi bzod pas rab tu mnar zhing / la la ni sa gzhi thams cad me dong lcags dmar po'i nang du gnas pa dang / la la ni lcags kyi khro chu dmar po 'khol ma'i nang bco ba dang / la la ni lcags ‘gses kyi ral gri rnon po'i thang du dgrad pa dang / la la ni sa gzhi thams cad mi bzod pa'i 'khyags rom nang gnas nas grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glag med pa myong nas lus kun zhig nas kha gas par gyur ba/ la la ni mda' ma rdo gseg mtshon gyi char pa babs pa dang / phan tshun mtshon gyis brdegs pa sogs mdor na/ mtshams med kyi las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bur bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sdug bsngal mang po dus yun bskal par myong bar gyur ba dang / de bzhin du yi dgas kyi gnas su skye ba'i sems 418

can rnams ni/ grod pa ri tsam la kha ni khab kyi rtse mo tsam yod cing / rkang lag shin tu phra bas lus mi theg pa dang / kha zas snyed kyang mgrin pa 'gags nas bza' mi thub pa dang / yang la la ni sa gzhi thams cad bye ma'i thang du gyur nas chu thigs pa cig tsam yang ma rag par rab tu skom pa'i sdug bsngal dang / la la ni zas skom zos shing btung bar gyur ba'i tshe khong du slebs ma thag tu lcags kyi khro chu tsha por gyur nas khong thams cad rab tu 'tshog pa'i sdug bsngal sogs mdor na/ so so'i las kyi dbang las bkres ltog gi sdug bsngal mi zad pa myong bar 'gyur ba yin te/ ji skad du/ phyi sgrib can dang nang sgrib can/ /zas skom gnyis ga'i sgrib pa can/ /me lce 'khor lo can la sogs/ /yi dgas gnas las thar bar shog /ces dang yang / bying na gnas dang kha 'thor dang / /glen lkugs gcig la gcig za dang / /gsod byed bkol brdung byed pa ste// ‘dud 'gro'i gnas las thar bar shog /ces dud 'gro'i skye gnas su blo rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / phan tshun gcig gis gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal dang / gsod pa'i sdug bsngal dang / gzhan gyi bkol spyod dang bdung brdegs tshad med btang ba'i sdug bsngal sogs dpag tu med pa myong ba yin/ de bzhin du lha la ltung ba phog pa'i sdug bsngal dang / lha 'chi 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal zhes sngon yod pa'i lus kyi dri zhim po nyams pa dang / gzugs mdzes pa'i bkrag mdangs shor ba dang / me tog sogs 419

rnyid pa dang / sngar gnyen nye ba'i lha yi grogs po grogs mo sogs kyis kyang mig tsam yang mi blta bar rang nyid gcig pur lus pa'i sdug bsngal dang / la la ni don med du dus yun bskal pa'i bar du ting 'dzin la gnas pa dang / sngon gyi bsod nams dang las kyi ting 'dzin gyi 'phen pa zad pa na/ slar yang 'og tu lhung nas dmyal ba dud 'gro sogs su skye ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba dag mang po yod/ de bzhin du lha ma yin la phan tshun rtag tu nga rgyal byed pa dang / phrag dog byed pa/ dmag dang g.yul 'gyed pa sogs zhi bde skad cig tsam yang med par 'thab rtsod kho na byed pa'i sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong ba 'gyur bar yin/ yang de bzhin du 'gro ba mi la yang / dang po ma yi mngal du lus chags shing 'phel ba'i skabs su mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes skyed pa'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal chen po lnga myong bar gyur ba dang / btsas ma thag tu lus dmar 'byam la reg pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa myong ba/ bar du gnas pa'i skabs 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzom pa'i dka' ngal/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i skabs su pha ma dang kha bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen bza' mi bu phrug dang kha bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ lus la na tsha byung ba'i sdug bsngal/ gang 'tshams nas lus 'khogs shing rgas pa'i sdug bsngal/ dbang po mig dang dran shes sogs nyams pa'i sdug bsngal/ mthar mi 'dod bzhin du 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal sogs mdor na sdug bsngal gyi gnas las 420

thar thabs med pa'i ngang tshul 'di kho na nyid yin te/ de nyid las/ lha la 'pho dang ltung ba dang / /lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod dang / /mi la skye rga na 'chi sogs/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar shog /ces gsungs/ des na ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can dmyal ba sogs ni grangs shin tu mang zhing sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba dang / bde 'gro lha mi'i gnas la gnas pa'i sems can ni da lta zag bcas kyi bde ba la mngon par zhen nas sdug bsngal ngo ma 'phrod par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nang gnas pa yin/ de'i phyir lha dang mi'i gnas su bde ba gang yod pa thams cad ni rtsa ba sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu la longs su spyod pa sha stag yin pas/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i 'dod yon gyi bde ba la longs su spyod pa 'di dag thams cad phyi ma sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu sha stag yin pas sdug bsngal bde bar 'dzin pa'i blo log shes kyi blo phyin ci log gis rtog pas sgrib nas sdug bsngal ngo ma gang yin pa dag ngo cha gsal po ma phrod pa yin pas/ khams gsum 'khor ba na gnas pa phyin chad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rab tu mnar ba yin pa 'di shes par bya dgos/ de ltar khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang mtha' yas pa'i nyam thag ma rgan sems can thams cad tshad med pa'i sdug bsngal bzod glag med par myong bar 'gyur zhing /bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba'i gnas la dmigs te dus 421

rgyun du yang nas yang du snying rje bsgom par bya dgos/ skabs mtshams su rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab ste/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la thugs brtse ba snying rje chen po mgyogs nas myur du skye bar shog rgyud byin gyis rlob tu gsol bsams te/ skyon gyis ma 'gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu la rgyan/ /thugs rje can gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes lan grangs gang mang bton nas snying rje bsgom pa'i rjes su/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can //'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag dang pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams/ /myur du 'khor ba'i mtsho las drangs su gsol//zab cing rgya che bla med byang chub sems/ /myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes skal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung byin rlabs can 'di bton nas sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la dmigs te phan pa dang bde ba dga' ba sogs sems can gyi ched du 'phen pa btang ste/ nyam thag 'gro ba 'di kun bdag gi ma/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i tshul bsam pa/ /sdug pa'i bu la brtse ba'i ma bzhin du// bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes rgyud rab tu rtsub pa'i gshis rgyud du byams brtse'i tshor ba bzang po yang yang goms shing 'dris par byas te/422

rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye bar gzhan don gyi phyir du snying stobs chen pos thabs shes 'bad pa du ma'i sgo nas brtsonasna ngu/ par byed dgos/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi mdo las/sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ chos mang po la bslab par mi bgyi yi/chos gcig la bslab par bgyi'o/ de gang zhe na snying rje chen pa'o/ gang la snying rje chen po yod pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos lag mthil du yod pa ltar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa yin zhing / tha na khyi phag la sogs pa'i sems can gang su zhig gi rgyud la brtse bskong rje chen po 'khrungs pa'i dus de nas bzung / theg chen gyi lam sna zin cing 'jig rten lha mi kun gyis skyabs su gyur te phyag 'tshal ba'i zhing mchog dam pa nyid du yang 'gyur ba yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byed kyang bde 'bre la ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes byang chub kyi sems rin po che zhes bya ba ni/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas nyag cig yin la mtshams med la sogs pa'i las kyi sdig sgrib stobs chen rnams kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho nas gzil gyis gnon cing gzhom par gyur la/bde ba'i rgyu dge ba gzhan kun las lhag cing dus rgyun chad med par dge ba rim bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phan yon yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'am bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag yod de/ dge ba 423

gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa dang yang na 'phags mchog phyag na padmo rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mtshan sngags dang / ma ṇi yig drug gang rung 'don zhing / rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che ci nas kyang rgyud la bskyed par byin gyis rlobs phyir gsol ba smon lam drag tu 'debs par bya'o/ /lnga pa/ dga' ba tshad med/sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi bral bar gyur cig ces dga' ba tshad med la blo sbyong dgos te/ de yang dga' ba bsgom pa ni rang rgyud la phrag dog med pa'i blo bzang pos dper na/ rang gi pha ma dang / spun mched/ bza' zla/ bu phrug sogs tshe ring ba dang nad nyung ba/ gzugs mdzes pa/ dpal 'byor mnga' thang che ba/snyan grags che ba/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur na/ rang gi yid rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ba yin/ de lta bu'i tshe ring nad med dang / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur ba mtha' dag gzhan pha rol po'i gang zag su 'dra zhig la'ang nges par dgos pa zhig dang / bde 424

skyid 'thob par 'dod pa ni gcig mtshungs yin pas na gzhan sems can thams cad rtag tu bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / nad med cing tshe ring ba dang / 'khor dang longs spyod dang ldan par gyur nas/ gnas skyabs mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba thob pa dang / lus rten de'i steng nas phyi ma rdzogs pa'i byang chub ste mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas gtan gyi bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur bar shog ces bsams pa'i thos nas sems can su 'dra zhig la yang phun sum tshogs pa byung na/de la mi dga' ba'i blo ngan gyis nga rgyal dang / 'gran rtsod/ lhag par phrag dog sogs mi bya bar sems can rang rang so so'i sngar gyi las dang bsod nams bzang po'i mthu las byung ba sha stag yin par brten/ de la rang gi mi dga' ba bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med la/ ma zad da dung sems can de dag thams cad gtan gyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po'i sa la reg pa 'gyur bar shog snyam ste/ nyon mongs pa'i phrag dog gi kun nas bslangs pa'i blo ngan ma rung ba gang dag la skabs mtshams dga' ba tshad med kyi glo yang yang sbyangs nas gnyen po bsten thub na/ sems bzang po'i mthu las bsod nams dang tshogs mang po rab tu rdzogs shing bde skyid dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin mod/ de las ldog te gzhan gyi rgyu nor longs spyod dang tshe bsod snyan grags sogs rang gi snying du mi 'dod cing / yid rab tu 'khrugs pa'i phrag dog skyed par gyur na ni tshe 'di phyi 425

gnyis kur rang nyid 'phung ba'i las ngan tshabs che bsags pa yin/dper na/ rang nyid kyi grogs po dang / grogs mo/ spong pa khyim mtshes sogs su zhig yin rung phan tshun gcig gi gcig la phrag dog med par byams pa'i gnyen bzhin rogs ram dang / sems 'khur/ phan 'dogs byed pa sogs bzang po'i glo yis kun nas bslangs te mi tshe skyel ba na/rang nyid gang du gnas sa'i khor yug der spro snang zhig snyer ba dang / zhi bde dang / bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bag phebs pa zhig bskrun thub la/ phyi ma yang las bzang po'i 'bras bu yang bzang po zhig 'thob par 'gyur/gal te phan tshun bar nga rgyal dang phrag dog byas nas bsdad na/ nyin gcig yin yang sems nang don dam pa'i bde skyid cig bskrun mi thub la/rang gzhan gnyis kur mi 'phrod pa'i dug bzhin mi tshe'i bde skyed dang 'tsho gnas dang 'brel ba'i dpal 'byor dang 'phrod bsten la'ang gnod par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ der brten bkra shis pa dang / lo legs pa/bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams mthong ba'i tshe rang nyid dga' ba bsgom par bya ba dang / shin tu dbul zhing phongs pa'i nyam thag dang nad pa sogs sdug bsngal gyis gnon pa'i sems can rnams mthong thos byung tshe/ de dag bde skyed phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur bar shog snyam pa'i blo bzang po'i phyogs su gang thub thub kyis dang po goms par byed pa dang / bar du de la 'dris par byed pa/ mtha' mar nyams 426

su len cing smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar ba bcas byed dgos/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ snying rje dang / byams pa dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms bcas bzhi po ni lus can gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la bskyed pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen dang mthun rkyen bzang gos shig tu gyur yod pa yin/ de yang sman gzhung las/ snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi/ /smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// dngos gzhi 'jug pa tshad med nyams su blangs/ /'jug pa sngags par blta zhing 'khon 'dzin med/ /de ldan gso sla tshogs mang grogs su 'a gyur//zhes gso ba rig pa'i sman pa'i rgyu gal che gos shig tu bstan yod cing /sman pa gang zhig gi rgyud la nad par snying thag pa nas phan pa'i kun slong ngam sems bzang po yod pa dang / brtse ba snying rje chen po dang du blangs pa dang / rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma'i rtsa gsum rigs 'dus kyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / rig 'dzin drang srong rnams kyi bden pa'i mthu stobs dang byin rlabs bcas kyi nad pa'i tshogs gso bar sla zhing thams cad dga' ba'i gnyen nye dang grogs su 'gyur ba ni blta ci smos te/ mdo sdud pa las/mi yi 'jig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba/ /phan dang snying brtse ldan pā bden pa'i byin gyis zhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i nang rang byung gi khor yug sogs la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen 427

song ba'i rkyen gyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs la sngar med nad rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pa'i skabs su 'tsho byed sman pa rnams kyis/ byams brtse'i sems 'khur bzang pos kun nas bslangs te gang thub kyis gzhan phan sgrub par byed pa la brtson dgos so/ /drug pa/ sems bskyed dngos/le'u bdun pa las/ ji skad du/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrub nas ni/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis/ /'gro ba grol bar dam bca'o/ /zhes pa ste de ltar gong du mar shes drin dran sogs rgyu 'bras man ngag drug la blo sbyang ba dang / tshad med bzhi yis ngang nas sems bskyed par byas te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla beeḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan mngar sems bskyed pa'i dam bca' bzung nas skyabs yul gong ma rnams dpang por dmigs te/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /bdag la dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa dang / /bdag kyang 'gro la phan 'dod du/ /byang 428

chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la//rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o/ /zhe sa lan gsum brjod cing dmigs pa med pa'i mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di ma stong gi bar bdag kyang sems can de dag thams cad kyi don du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de/ nyam thag sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa ji srid rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du de srid du bdag kyang de dag gi don kho na byed do snyam/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar legs par bsams te bdag gi rgyud la dus 'di nas bzung byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'khrungs nas rgyal ba'i sras su gyur to snyam nas yid du dga' bde'i spro snang chen po bskyed de/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig 'di rnams bton nas de nas dngos su/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang mchog /ma thob bar du bsgrub par bya/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas ma 'gro ba rigs drug gi ched du bdag nyid rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po sa gsum 429

'gro ba'i dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad kun ma lus pa sel bar mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma g.yu thog rje/ yi dam rta phag yab yum/ mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba bcas rtsa gsum rigs 'dus chen po'i go 'phang snying khongs rus pa'i gting nas 'thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub smon pa mchog tu sems rab tu bskyed par byas te/bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mgrin gcig tu 'di ltar 'don par bsgoms te/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi//bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyin sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces jo bo rje'i gsung byin chen gyi tshigs bcad sho lo ka 'di lan gsum mam bdun nam nyer cig gam brgya dang rtsa gcig gang rung 'don par bya ba dang / de nas 'jug pa sem/sa bskyed kyi skabs su gnas dang yul dang zhing dang / dus 'di tsam sems can gyi grangs 'di tsam/ zhes tshad dang grangs sogs gang yang med par dngos gzhi 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems la tshad med par nyams su blangs te/rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i phyin drug gi spyod pa la rab tu bslab par bya snyam pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su byas te/ ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid bdag kyang gnas gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /ces 430

gsungs pa ltar tshad dang grangs sogs gang yang med par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam bzang pos rgyas thebs par bya ste/ theg pa dman pa las/ khyad du 'phags pa'i sems bskyed pa dang /de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed du smon 'jug gnyis kyi bdag nyid can dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems su bdag gzhan dang snang ba thams cad gdod nas ma grub par mtshan rtog dmigs pa kun dang bral ba chos kyi dbyings su 'khor 'das ro mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms par bya ba bcas so/ /bdun pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam par blta ba/ma gyur 'gro ba rigs drug gi ched du bdag nyid sangs rgyas sman bla'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i bslab byar bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / bdag gzhan brje ba/ bdag las gzhan gces par 'dzin pa gsum las/ dang po bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du bsgom dgos pa yin/ de yang tshe rabs 'khor ba dus thog ma med pa nas bzung las ngan bag chags rgyun 'khrigs su bsags pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i khar brgyud nas 'gro ba rigs drug tu lus ngan rnam pa sna chogs pa blangs nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 431

las thar pa'i dus ma byung / de'i rgyu rtsa ba ni nang du nga zhes bya ba'i gang zag ya ma zung zhig la lhag par mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin gcig dang / bdag 'dzin des kun nas bslangs pa'i 'khrul snang gi ngor phyi ru dngos po'i chos thams cad la'ang bdag tu 'dzin pa bcas bdag 'dzin rnam pa gnyis kyi gzhan dbang du song nas nga gtan nas med pa la ngar 'dzin pa dang / 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad nga de gzhan las mchog tu 'dzin pa'i blo phyin ci log gis rang nyid gcig bu bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'dod nas phyi'i zag bcas kyi 'dod yon la shin tu sred pa skyed de/ de'i phyir gzhan pha rol po'i sems can mtha' yas pa yal bar dor nas rang nyid kyi bde skyed ched du gzhan la 'dod chags dang / zhe snang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog ser sna bcas kyi sgo nas gzhan sems can la gnod par byas pa dang / rang nyid bde ba thob par 'dod pa'i rgyu lung du bstan pa gang zhig bde ba skyed byed kyi rigs su gnas pa bde ba'i rgyu dge ba bsgrub ma shes pa dang / lung du bstan pa gang zhig sdug bsngal skyed byed kyi rigs su gnas pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dag spong mi shes pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung dus da lta bar du mi 'dod sdug bsngal thams cad thog tu babs/ 'dod pa bde bas phongs pa sha stag yin/ de'i phyir 'jig rte na na sems can thams cad rtag tu rgud par byed pa'i rgyu'i rtsa ba ni bdag 'dzin ma rig 432

pa de kho na nyid la rag las pa yin te/ rten 'brel bstod pa las/ 'jig rten gud pa ji snyed pa/ /de yi rtsa ba ma rig nyid/ /ces gsungs pa yin/de ltar rang nyid dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bde skyid dang phan bde'i dngos po yid la ce ltar 'dod de/ gzhan sems can thams cad kyang de ltar 'dod pa'i tshor ba gcig mtshungs yin pas/ rang nyid la bde skyid cig skrun pa'i ched du gzhan la gnod pa rtsa ba nas byed mi rung ba yin/ gal te gzhan sems can la nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis gnod pa khab rtse tsam byas rung / de'i lan du rang nyid la sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu zhig smin par 'gyur ba ni las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa kho na'i gshis lugs yin/ des na rang nyid la phral yun kun tu phan bde bzang po zhig bskrun thabs byed dgos na/ gzhan sems can la sems bzang pos kun nas blangs te phan pa'i bya ba chung ngu ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam yin kyang bsgrub gang thub byas na/ de'i 'bras bur yang rang nyid la bde ba'i 'bras bu zhig nges par du smin pa 'gyur ba yang las 'bras kyi chos nyid yin/ der brten rang nyid bde skyed dang 'dod yon longs spyod tshe ring nad med kho na 'dod pa ltar/ sems can gzhan thams cad kyang de ltar 'dod pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khams gsum gyi 'khor ba gang na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rang dang khyad par gtan nas med pa bde sdug gi tshor ba gcig gyur yod pa 'di shes pa'i thog nas/433

rang dang khyad med du bltas nas 'di phyi phral yun kun tu bde ba'i phan bde 'ba' zhig gi bya ba bsgrub dgos/ de yang sman gzhung las/ gzhan gyi don la'ang rang gi 'drar sems pa/ de dag dam pa'i spyod pa mthar thug nyid/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin sman pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas rgyun du sman bcos byed pa'i skabs/ mtho go sa yod med dang / nor longs spyod yod med/ shes bya yon tan yod med/ rigs skyes sa mtho dman/ skyes pho mo sogs kyis dbye ba gang yang med par thams cad nad na tsha'i zug rngu rtsa ba nas mi 'dod pa yin la/ 'dod pa ni nad las thar thabs dang /tshe ring ba/ bde ba sha stag 'dod pa yin pas dus kun tu bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du sgom gang thub la 'bad pa lhur len bya dgos pa yin te/sdug bsngal phra mo tsam yang mi 'dod cing / de la nam yang chog shes med rdopar ni/ /bdag dang gzhan la khyad par yod min zhes/ /gzhan bde dga' ba bskyed par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gang thub kyis bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du blta dgos pa'o/ /brgyad pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba/de nas bdag gzhan brje ba zhes bya ba ni/ shin tu nyams su len dka' ba'i gnas shig yin kyang / dang po blo bzang po'i phyogs su rim 434

pas yang nas yang du goms shing mthar 'dris pa'i mtshams su rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i lam du zhugs pa rnams kyi snying stobs chen pos bdag gzhan brje ba'i nyams len dngos su len par gnang ba yin/ de yang dmigs pa med pa 'i gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ma rig dang / de las byung ba'i 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs nyon mongs pa'i rigs su gyur ba mtha' dag dang / rgyu mi dge ba de dag las byung ba'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs bkra mi shis pa'i nad gdon dang / sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad du ba nag po'i rlung 'tshub kyi rnam pa lta bur dmigs te/ dgugs nang du rngub dus rang gi sna nas rgyud rang la 'khrim par bsam pa'i gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad dang du blangs pa dang / de nas dgugs phyir gtong ba'i tshe rang gi 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa dang / gsog bzhin gsog par 'gyur ba thams cad mdor na lus dang / longs spyod/dus gsum dge rtsa yongs rdzogs rlung dkar po'i rnam pa lta bur mtha' dang mu med pa'i nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i sems can dpag tu med par btang nas phan pa dang bde ba'i bkris pa gang dang gang ci yod pa thams cad sems can gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la smin song snyam pa'i gtong len gyi phan pa rgya chen po dbugs lan grangs mang po'i bar du yang 435

yang rgyun du sgom par bya/ de yang bla mchod las/ des na rje btsun bla ma thugs rje can/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus da lta bdag la smin pa dang / /bdag gi bde dge gzhan la btang ba yis//'gro kun bde dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bsams te lan 'ga' shas 'don dgos/ des sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i nyams len don dngos su gnas skabs byed ma thub kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma reg ba ra du rang nyid 'gro ba gzhan gyi don byed par 'gyur ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang po'i kun slong dang / snying stobs chen po rgyud la bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu rkyen nam grogs bzang po nges can zhig byed nus pa yin par ma zad byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud dang 'dres nges su gyur nas tshogs dang bsod nams rab tu rdzogs nas sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang dag par 'gyur ba yin te/ rdza dpal sprul rin po ches/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/ chos theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa thams cad kyi bsgom bya mthar thug gi snying po ma nor ba yin te/ 'di lan cig rgyud la skyes pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sdig sgrib 'dagabasod nams dang ye shes kyi rdzogs rgya chen po rdzogs/ ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa dang / mnyam med jo bo rje la sogs pa'i bka' gdams kyi bla ma dam pa 436

rnams dang / rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi mthil kho na 'dzin sa ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid yin te/ glo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma las/ mdor na dngos sam brgyud pa yis/ /phan bde ma rnams kun la 'bul/ /ma yi gnod dang sdug bsngal kun/ /gsang bas bdag la len par shog /ces dang / yang / lam rim bsdus don las/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing sde/ /rlabs chen spyod pa rnams kyi gzhi dang rten/ /tshogs gnyis kun la gser bsgyur rtsi lta bu/ /rab 'byams dge tshogs sdud pa'i bsod nams gter/ /de ltar shes nas rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams/ /rin chen sems mchog thugs dam mthil tu 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /thar 'dod khyod kyang de ltar 'degs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal ba dmigs te gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du len par gyur ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par byed pa'i sa yi gzhi rten lta bu yin/ dper na sngon bdag cag gi ston pa bka' drin can 'di nyid dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i tshe grogs sdug bsngal ba kā ma rus pa la dmigs te/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du len par mdzad pa na dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs skyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ gling gzhi bye ba phrag brgyar mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan nas 437

rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes che shos su gyur ba ni/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor ba 'di rnams yin te/mdzad pa kun las gsungs kyi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar ston pa'i chos kyi phung po brgya khri bzhi stong gi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa ni byams dang snying rje kho na yin te/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ ngan song gsum gyi gnas khang du/ slebs nas 'gyod pas ci zhig phan/ /byams dang snying rje rgyud la dgos/ /de med ngan song gsum gyi rgyu/ /zhes 'gro ba sems can su zhig gi rgyud la zhe sdang med par byams pa'i blo dang / 'dod chags med par snying rje'i blo'am sems bzang po 'di gnyis yod phyin chad la/ ngan 'gro ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs mi dgos par tshe rabs nas tshe rabs su bde nas bde bar 'gro ba dang / byams brtse'i sems bzang po 'di gnyis dang bral bar gyur ba'i tshe lus kyis skor ba stong brgyab/ phyag 'bum btsal/ mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ ngag nas sngags 'bum phrag bgrangs/ yid kyis lha sogs bsgom sgrub gang byas kyang phyi nas 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi mig lam du chos byed par 'bad brtson shin tu che bar snang yang / don dam du chos chos su mi 'gro bar phyi ma ngan song gsum du 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu la brtson par gyur ba kho na yin/ des na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zhes bya ba'i don ni/ nang gi sems rgyud chags sdang gnyis 438

kyi rigs ngan pa gang dag yod pa de byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyi ngo bor bzo bcos byed pa'am 'chos par bsgyur ba la chos zhes rang gzhan thun mong kun la rtag tu phan pa skrun par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan nges can zhig yod pa la go ba len dgos pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' dang mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang mthun pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos thams cad nyon yongs pa'i blo ngan gyi shes rgyud ma rungs pa'am/ ma thul ba thams cad zhi 'dul byams brtse'i rang bzhin can zhig tu 'dul ba'i thabs shes kho nar dmigs te gsungs pa yin te/ bka' gdams bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas/ bka' dang bstan bcos gsungs pa thams cad kyang / /sems bskyed 'dul ba'i thabs su gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /dper na/ rang cag bod gangs can pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan grub pa'i skyes mchog chen po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pas ri dgas bzhin du gnas yul ri la bskyal/ 'tsho ba tsam po ba zhig la bsten/ gnas khang rang byung brag phug stong pa zhig la brten nas lus skam pa dang / sha rid pa/ mdog sngo ba sogs mi yi ro dang / khyi nyal ba gnyis su med pa yin te/ ban chung gis/ mi la ras pa skad pa de/ /ma mthong gong na grags che ba/ /mthong nas drung du slebs tsam na/ /mi rgan khyi nyal byed pa gcig /ces brag phug stong pa zhig gi phyi rol du khyi nyi mar nyal ba lta bu'i mi rgan zhig phred nyal du byed pa gcig 'dug snang yang /439

don dam du khong ni byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can kho na la nyams su len par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur yod pa yang de ltar yin/ khong brag phug stong pa'i nang du 'tsho ba tsam po ba zhig la brten nas sku tshe gang po ri la bskyal dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang med par nges pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ni nang sems kyi steng gtso bor byed dgos pa las/ phyi dngos po'i dpal 'byor gyi thog nas sgrub par bya ba ni gtan nas ma yin zhing / des na rje btsun mi la zhabs kyis/ nor longs spyod bdag la 'bul ba med/ /pha bla ma'i bka' drin sgrub pas mjal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i snying por byams snying rje kho na nyams su len par mdzad de tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas bod khams chos ldan gyi zhing du mchod pa'i yang rtse zhig tu gyur yod pa yin/ de bzhin du rgya gar gyi dpal na len ḍa'i paṇa grub rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha yang / phyi tshul du rtag par bza' ba dang / nyarme ba/ 'dug pa bcas 'du shes gsum pa'i spyod tshul kho nar dus gda' ba'i tha mal ba'i gang zag zhig tu snang tshul bstan pa las/ don dam du khong ni bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che kho na nyams su len par 'jug pa'i paṇa chen gtso bo zhig yin/ byang chub sems 440

dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa brtsams pa'i mthar bcu pa bsngo ba'i le'u las/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci 'ang rung / /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig/byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /'gro ba'i bde la spyod par shog/ces 'gro ba gzhan sems can nyam thag pa'i sdug bsngal dang du len par mdzad pa yin pas/ dngos su nga tshos gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du len pa ra ma rig kyang / de lta bu'i sems bzang pos kun nas blangs te 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar byed nus pa'i rgyal sras byang chub kyi sems dpa' chen po zhig tu 'gyur thub pa'i smon lam yang rgyun du btab ste/bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus bder smin shog/ces snyam nas bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo la bsgom pa yang yang bsten te 'bad par bya'o/ /dgu pa/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa/bdag gzhan mnyam brje gnyis kyi mjug tu de nas bdag pas gzhan gces par sgom pa'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ bskal pa du mar rab bsgoms mdzad pa yis/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /zhes dper na/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de nyid rgya mtsho zhig gi nang du rus sbal chen po gcig tu skye ba len pa'i gnas 441

skabs su/ rgya mtsho'i nang du 'grul bzhud byed pa'i tshong dpon lnga brgya gyur zhugs te gang mtshams phyin pa na glo bur du gru la skyon chen po shor te gru de zhig par gyur pa'i tshe/ rus sbal chen po des gzhan tshong dpon lnga brgya dang bcas pa dag rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du 'chi bar nges pa'i 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal chen po myong bzhin yod pa dag mthong ste/phyogs der bskyod nas tshong pa thams cad rus sbal gyi sgal par khur nas 'gro ba'i tshe srog bskyabs te rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bde bar bskyal bas rang nyid shin tu ngal dub chen po byung bas mtsho'i mtha' der ngal gso zhing gnyid du log pa dang / skabs der rus sbal de'i sgal par sbrang bu brgyad khri tham pa babs te khrag mang po 'jibs par gyur ba'i tshe/ gnyid bsad par gyur te de ma thag tu chu'i nang du song na sbrang bu mang po 'di dag snying rje bsams pa dang lus 'gul bskyod byas na sbrang bu rnams 'chi ba 'dug snyam pas sngar yod rang sar bzhugs/ rang rus sbal gcig dang gzhan sems can sbrang bu mang po 'di dag byas na rang nyid gal chung zhing /gzhan mtha' yas pa'i sems can 'di dag mchog tu gces par 'dzin dgos pa'i thugs bskyed bla na med pa 'khrungs te rang nyid kyi sku lus sbrang bu brgyad khri'i ched du blos btang mdzad par gyur/ mthar rgyal ba shākya thub pa rang nyid mi mjed 'jig rten zhing du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sbrang bu rnams lha brgyad khrir skyes nas thams cad 442

byang chub lam gyi chos nyan pa'i bskal ldan gyi gdul byar gyur nas bden pa mthong ba yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dus rtag tu rang nyid gzhan sems can thams cad las bde ba dang skyed pa sogs 'dod cing mchog tu gces par 'dzin par gyur na/ don du rang nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las gtan du thar ba'i dus med par rgud pa thams cad kyi sgo yin pa dang / de las gzhan 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad rang gi mar ma gyur ba gcig kyang med la/ tshe 'di'i ma bzhin du byams brtse'i drin gyis bskyangs pa'ang gcig mtshungs su gyur yod cing / ma rgan sems can 'di dag thams cad rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ma rig pa des kun nas bslangs pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du dus rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal chen po gsum gyi rab tu mnar zhing mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin kho na yin pa la dmigs te rang nyid myur ba nyid du rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag tu 'thob par 'gyur nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can dpag tu med pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral zhing / gtan gyi bde ba bla na med pa zhig la 'god par byed nus pa'i snying rje'i sems rgya chen por bskyed par byas te ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi drin gso zhing / rang las mchog tu gces par 'dzin dgos pa yin te/ rang nyid gces 'dzin rgud pa kun gyi sgo/ /gzhan 443
