rnams gces 'dzin yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /de'i phyir bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnal sbyor la/ /nyams len snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na nyid yin zhing / gzhan sems can ni bgrangs kyis mi lang zhing nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa dang / rang nyid ni ga tshod gal cher 'dzin yang sems can gcig rang yin cing des na lus can sems can rnams mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa'i blo zhig byung na/ don dam du rang gzhan thams cad bde nas bde bar 'gro ba'i lam gyi yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten rang chags yod/ zhib cing phra ba'i sgo nas legs par dpyod pa'i tshe/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog pa med pa nas bzung dus da lta bar rang nyid phungs par byed mkhan su zhig yin nam/ zhes dri ba zhig bskul na rang nyid bde bas phungs shing sdug la sbyar mkhan gyi byed gte gtso bo de phyi rol du gzhan su gang yang mi 'dug cing / nang du rang nyid rtag tu gces par 'dzin pa'i blo ngan ya ma zung zhig yod pa de rang yin/gzhan phyi rol du yod pa'i sems can su zhig gis rang nyid sdug la mi sbyar bar/ da dung rang nyid 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i dus thams cad du ma rgan gzhan sems can kho na la brten te/ gnas dgos pa las gzhan sems can su zhig la ma brten par rang nyid kher rkyang du rang rkya 'phel ba'i dus shig gtan nas yong thabs med pa yin/ der brten dus thog ma med pa zhig nas bzung da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus sogs gang 444

la'ang gzhan pha rol po'i sems can thams cad rang nyid la shin tu drin chen po dang rtsa chen po/ rang nyid 'di phyi phral yun kun tu bde ba 'thob pa ra byed pa dang / ma zad rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la'ang dgos mkho yod pa zhig dang med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ sra zhing brtan pa'i brag ri ltar gces 'dzin gong bur 'dril ba'i skabs su/rang nyid 'khor bar ltung mkhan gzhan sems can/ rang nyid sdug la sbyar mkhan gzhan sems can/ rang nyid la gnod par byed mkhan gzhan sems can/ rang nyid la snang bar byed mkhan gzhan sems can/ rang nyid la bsam sbyor ngan pa byed mkhan gzhan sems can/ rang nyid la 'jigs skrag skul mkhan lha 'dre gzhan sems can/ rang nyid la dug rtsub gnod 'tshe byed mkhan gyi gdon gegs sogs gzhan sems can yin pa lta bu'i rang sems gces 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang kun brtags gnyis kyi gzhan dbang du song ba las/ phyi rol du rang la 'khon du 'dzin pa 'i dgra bo zhig dang / rang la gnod par byed pa'i gdon chen zhig sadod nas grub par med la/ lhag par rang nyid sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas mi 'dod kyang / mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal thog tu babs nas srid pa 'khor ba'i gnas su sdug la sbyar mkhan yang rang gces 'dzin yin /de yang bla mchod las/ rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i gcong nad 'di//mi 'dod sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rgyur mthong nas/ /len lan bdas la 445

'khon du bzung byas te/ /bdag 'dzin gdon chen 'joms par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid la nad byung na gcong chen gyi nad de rang gces 'dzin la 'dzin dgos/ rang nyid la sdug bsngal byung na/ sdug bsngal sprod mkhan de rang gces 'dzin du blta dgos/ rang nyid la dgra zhig byung na dgra bo rang gces 'dzin la kha gtad gcog dgos /rang nyid la gegs bar byung na gdon gegs phyi rol du yod par mi 'dzin par nang gi gdon chen po rang gces 'dzin de zhi drag gnyis kyi sgo nas mthar bskrad dgos pa'i thabs shes la 'bad pa yang nas yang du bya dgos te/ bka' gdams dge shes glang thang pas/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /don mchog sgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gces par 'dzin par shog /ces dgos 'dod kyi yid bzhin nor bus ni tshe 'di'i dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa tsam las gzhan pa'i phan gang yang mi thogs shing / mtha' yas pa'i lus can sems can thams cad kyi ni rang gzhan gnyis ka gtan gyi phan bde bla na med pa zhig bskrun nus shing / byang chub thar pa chen po'i myo 'phang yang thob par byed nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dus rtag tu rang las/ gzhan gces par 'dzin shā shog snyam snye gang thub thub kyis smon lan/ 'debs pa dang nyams su len par ci nas kyang nges par byed dgos pa ni theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snying po mthar thug pa de yin/ /446

bcu pa/ sbyin pa'i nyams len bshad pa/ji skad du rje bla mas/ lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /sems can rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos sgyur te/ /chags med gtong sems spel ba'i man ngag gis/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa bcas rnam pa gsum du dbye zhing / de yang dang po zang zing nor gyi sbyin pa chung ngu gtong ba la glo goms par bya ba yin te/ gzhan 'gro ba nyam thag pa shin tu dbul zhing phongs pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba'i skyon can/nad kyi mnar ba sogs la rang nyid kyi rgyu nor chung tshegs rigs dper na/ dngul sgor skar cha gnyis gsum cung zad tsam phangs sems med pa'i blo yis kun nas bslangs te sbyin par byed dgos/ de lta bu'i dngul dang zas gos sogs sbyin pa chung du btang ba des/ rang nyid kyi rgyu nor longs spyod la nyams rgud dang gyong kun chen po phog pa sogs gang yang mi byed par/ gzhan dbul phongs la de lta bu'i zang zing chung tshegs kyi sbyin pa btang ba'i dngul gyi kha grangs mang po nyin re zla rer bsags pa'i cha yis mthar dbul phongs kyi dka' ngal sel bar phan thogs nges can zhig bskrun thub pa'i gzhan phan gyi dge ba'i bya ba bzang po nyid du 'gyur ba 447

yin/ de ni sbyin pa gtong ba tsam gyi glo yi 'jug sgo thog ma de yin zhing / de ltar rgyun du glo la goms pa yang yang bsten pa'i mthar gtong ba chen po zhes rgyun du rang nyid la shin tu dgos gal che ba dang / rin thang che ba/ lhag par rtsigs che ba'i rigs gser dngul rin chen sogasadang / zas gos gnas mal/ gnas khang / rgyu nor longs spyod mtha' dag de bzhin du rang nyid kyi bu dang bu mo sogs kyang gzhan la sbyin pa gtong bar byed nus pa'i blo rgya bzang po bskyed de/ dngos su nyams su len par byed thub pa dang / de nas shin tu gtong ba chen po'i sbyin pa zhes bya ba rang nyid kyi lus po'i yan lag dang / khrag dang mig dang lus po'i snying dang glo ba sogs lus srog longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad sems can gzhan dbul zhing yongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod ji bzhin du skong bar nus pa'i sbyin pa chen po'i nyams su len par zhugs par spro ba yin/ dper na/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i bu snying stobs chen por skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe nags kyi dkyil du stag mo phru gu btsas nas zas ma rag par lus shing shin tu bkres nas ltogs shi 'thebs par nye ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa dag gzigs nas rang gi lus po'i rma kha 'byed de/ shin tu gces pa'i lus srog nyid kyang glos btang nas phangs pa med pa'i glo yis kun nas bslangs te/ glo snying mchin mcher sogs lus po'i sha khrag thams cad stag 448

mo dang stag mo'i phru gu'i ched du sbyin pa btang bar mdzad pa yin/ de nas chos kyi sbyin pa zhes bya ba ni nang du rang nyid kyi gshis rgyud gyong po ma thul ba dag 'dul zhing / byams brtse'i rang bzhin can zhig tu 'gyur ba'i rjes su mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba mang po chags sdang drag po'i gzhan dbang du ma song ba'i thabs shes bzang po bsten phyir/ dam pa'i chos lugs bzang pos sna gdul bar byas te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas nye bar brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzang po zam ma chad par nyams su len par mdzad pa mtha' dag gdul bya snod rung rnams la rgyab rten gyi lung gnang ba dang / mdo rgyud sogs grol byed kyi khrid 'chad par byed pa dang / rjes 'dzin slob pa'i gshis rgyud ma smin pa dag smin par byed pa'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba sogs ni chos kyi sbyin pa chen po gtong ba yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa zhes bya ba ni sa 'og tu 'bu srin phra mo'i rigs gzhan gyis rkang pas brdzis te 'chi la nye ba'i rigs dang / ra lug dang phag pa bya de nya sogs sems can mang po gzhan gyis gsod par nges pa'i skabs su rang nyid kyi rgyu nor dngul dngos sogs dang brje po brgyab ste/ de dag 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs par byas te re zhig zhi bde snying 'jags ngang 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i go skal bzang po bskrun par mdzad pa na/ 'gro ba'i tshe srog bskyabs pa'i mi 449

'jigs pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba'i nyams len yin par ma zad skabs 'dir gso rig sman pa zhig gi ngos nas 'gro ba mi'i tshe srog bskyabs te shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i nad kyi zug rngu las grol te 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs nas re zhig mi na bar bde bar gnas shing / tshe bsring bar byas pa'i 'gro ba mi'i srog skyob pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'i mchog nyid du gyur la de yi bsod nams las 'di phyi kun tu rang nyid kyi tshe ring du 'phel bar 'gyur la/ sbyin pa chen po'i don nyams su len par mdzad pa'i mthus/ tshe rabs kun tu rgyu nor longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas pa dang / bde bar gnas pa/ tshe ring ba bcas kyi 'bras bu bzang po nyid du smin par gyur te/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde//tsho zhes gsungs pa ma zad/ ston pas kyang / skye bo 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing / /mi rnams bde ba longs spyod med min la/ /longs spyod rnams ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas/ /thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do/ /zhes rgyu nor longs spyod thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu'i rtsa ba ni/ gtso bo tshe rabs snga ma dag tu sbyin pa rgya che chung ji tsam btang ba'i mthu kho na las/ tshe 'dir nor longs spyod ldan mi ldan gyi 'bras bu smin pa yin zhing / des na rang nyid kyi re 'dod phyir du ma yin par phan pa'i bsam pa bzang pos kun nas bslangs te/ zas kham gcig tsam bstsal ba'i sbyin pa btang ba tshun chad chud mi za bar phyis su rang la de'i 450

'bras bu bzang po zhig nges par smin par 'gyur ba yin te/ sbyin las 'byor ldan gnas yin dbul po min/ /ser snas dbul po'i gnas yin 'byor ldan min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdor na bsam blo zhib tu btang na sbyin pa ji tsam btang yang / rang nyid dbul po gtan nas mi chags par rgyur nor longs spyod 'phel bar byed pa yin la/ ser sna chen pos ji tsam rgyu nor 'bad pa chen pos bsags te/ yar bla ma dkon mchog rin chen gyi tshogs la mchod pa 'bul ma nus pa/ mar 'gro ba nyam thag pa'i dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ma phod pa/ bar rang nyid kyi phyir du bed spyod gtong ma phod pa'i ser sna chen po byas par gyur na/ mthar yi dgas kyi skye ba len par gyur la/ gal te mi ru skyes kyang de ni rtag tu tsho dbul phongs kyi skye ba kho na len par 'gyur ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi mdo sdud pa las kyang / ser sna can ni yi dgas gnas su skye/ /ji ltar mir skyes na yang dbul por skye/ /zhes dngos su gsungs yod pa yin pas/nyin re'i mi tshe'i nang du rang gi lus dang longs spyod/ de bzhin du lhag par rang gis phyag btsal ba dang / mchod pa phul ba/ sbyin pa btang ba/kha bton dge sbyor sogs gang byas pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yod pa dag rang nyid kho na bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i ched du mi bsngo bar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ngan 'gro ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can sdug bsngal ba thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par mdor na/ khams 451

gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad la dmigs te/ ci nas kyang de thams cad gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i rten bzang dang / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas gtan gyi byang chub chen po'i zag med kyi bde ba dam pa nyid 'thob par shog snyam ste/ bdag gi lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge tshogs phung po ci mchis pa/ /ma gyur sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de nas phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ /zhes bsams te sbyin pa'i gtong sems rgya chen po bskyed par bya dgos/ de ltar byas par gyur na tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su de nyid kho na nyid rang nyid la phan par gyur ba yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /dge slong bram ze bkres dang tsho bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin bstsal gyis pha rol tu/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zang zing gi nor la snying po len shes pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /btsug pa/ tshul khrims kyi nyams len bshad pa/yang de nyid du/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa yi/ /bcas mtshams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong zhing / /dge chos sdud dang sems can don sgrub pa'i/ /tshul khrims phar phyin tshogs par byin gyis rlobs//452

zhes pa ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims bcas gsum yod cing / de yang tshul khrims zhes bya ge ni/yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten sa gzhi chen po lta bur 'gyur zhing rnam dkar legs tshogs kyi yon tan gyi phung po'i rgyu ci dang ci yod pa thams cad kyi 'bras bu bzang po de 'dra ba thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu yi gzhi rten gtso bo ni tshul khrims kho na yin pas na/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa gshin te/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdig pa'i rgyu mi dge bcu spang zhing dge ba'i las lam bzang po bcu sgrub par byed pa dang / sor thar gyi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ltung bco brgyad sogs lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bar byed pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dper na/ kha shin tu skoms pa'i sems can gcig la chu hub gang tsam sbyin pa dang / de bzhin du rang nyid kyi lus po'i steng du dbyar kha dug sbrang chung ngu zhig babs te/ khrag 'jibs par gyur kyang shin tu nyam chung ba'i dug sbrang de bsad par dka' tshegs ci yang med par lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis kyi bar cung zad btsir thengs shig yin kyang / 'gro ba de'i tshe srog la bar gcod rtsa 453 7

ba nas ma byas par phyi rol du 'tsho zhing gnas par bya ched phyir 'bud pa sogs byas na/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni chung chung lta bu zhig tu snang yang don dam du 'gro ba'i skom pa sel ba dang / 'gro ba'i srog ma bcad pa'i tshul khrims bsrung zhing / de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni nyin re bzhin du gcig nas gnyis/ gnyis nas bzhi sogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / skom pa sel ba'i bsod nams dang 'tshe ba ma byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba brjod kyis mi lang ba gong nas gong du 'phel mthar/ dge tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin/ yang de las ldog ste nyam chung gi dug sbrang gcig bsad par gyur na ni/ de'i sdig pa ni phyi ru mi mngon pa'i chung chung zhig tu snang yang / gong du brjod pa bzhin nyen re bzhin du gcig nas gnyis/ gnyiso nas bzhi sogs su nyin re bzhin 'phel te/mthar dug sbrang grangs med pa bsad pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i nyes pa'i rgyur 'gyur te mtha' ma sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam gsog par 'gyur ba yin/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ dper na/ sa gzhi chen po 'di'i steng du ljon shing gi rgyu chung ngu nas 'bru tsam zhig 'thor na/ rgyu sngon du song ba de'i rjes su mthun pa'i 'bras bu yang / phyis su mi zad pa sbyin par 'gyur ba'i dpe dang / de bzhin du yang me stag chung ngu nas 'bru tsam zhig gis nags tshal gyi nang du 'thor na/ rgyu tsha zhing bsreg pa de'i chos dang mthun pa'i 'bras bur nags tshal chen po dag kyang / mthar rab tu 454

bsreg par byed pa'i dpe dang kun nas mtshungs par gyur ba yin/ de ni phyi nang gi chos thams cad phan tshun gcig la gcig brten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba'i gshis lugs kyi rgyu 'bras sam/ las 'bras nyid chud mi za bar shin tu dbang btsan pa'i rang bzhin can zhig yin/ de yang kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ ji skad du/ dge ba phra mo tsam la yang mi phan snyam du brnyas mi bya/ /chu yi thigs pa bsags pa yis/ /snod chen rim gyis gang bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sdig pa chung ngu tsam na yang / /mi gnod snyam du brnyas mi bya/ /me stag phra mo gcig gis kyang / /rtsa phung ri tsam bsreg bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rang nyid kyi gshis rgyud zhi zhing 'dul te byams brtse'i rang bzhin can zhig tu 'gyur phyir/ rtag par bla ma dkon mchog gsum la yang yang gsol ba 'debs dgos/ rgyun du sdig pa chung chung yin kyang spang gang thub byed/ dge ba chung chung yin yang snang med du ma bzhag par bsgrub gang thub bya/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras la rtsa ba nas bslu ba med cing sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gnas shig yin/ don dam du de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying po mthar thug de rang yin te/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang rgyud dge ba'i bya ba gang dag la goms 'dris bsten cing gzhan phan gyi bsam 455

pa rgya cher bskyed par byed dgos/ de nas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du gtong zhing rang nyid bde bar 'dod pa'i blo ngan rtsa ba nas spangs te/ gzhan sems can thams cad bde bar 'dod pa'i blo bzang po rab tu 'phel ba'i sgo nas mkho ba sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba/ 'jig rten gyi don dang mthun pa/ gdul bya sems can thams cad kyi don kho na spyod cing nyams su len pa mdzad pa yin/ gong du bstan pa bzhin 'jig rten na gang su dag bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa mtha' dag ni tshul khrims bsrung ba las byung ste/sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde/ /zhes tshul khrims bsrung ba las bde ba mtha' dag ldan zhing / mi ma min la sogs pa'i gnod pa'i rigs kyis kyang mi tshugs par gzhan gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi dpa' gdeng 'thob par 'gyur ba bcas ni tshul khrims kyi yon tan yin//brtsus pa/ bzod pa'i nyams len bshad pa/ji skad du/ khams gsum skye dgu ma lus khros gyur te/ /gshe zhing mtshang 'bru bsdigs shing srog gcod kyang / /mi 'khrugs gnod lan phan pa sgrub byed pa'i/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs//456

zhes pa ste/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gsum ste/ gzhan gyis log sgrub la bzod pa dang / /chos kyi phyir dka' thub spyad nus pa'i bzod pa/ gnad lugs gzab mo'i don la skrag par mi 'a gyur pa'i bzod pa dang bcas gsum yod/ de yang dang po/ gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa ni/ gzhan pha rol po'i gang zag su zhig gis rang la zur za dang / 'phya smod/ mthong chung / brnyas bcos/ tshig ngan/ gshe ba/ mtshang brtol pa/skyon brjod pa/ sdig ra skul ba/ bdung brdeg dang / mnar gcod gtong ba sogs dngos shugs gang du byas kyang / de'i lan du sems kyi gting nas rang rgyud la zhe snang chen po skyed par byed pa dang / khong khro'i me lce drag po rab tu 'bar bar byed pa dang / des kun nas bslangs te gzhan la gnod 'tshe'i bya ngan brtsam par 'gyur na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying don dang rgyab 'gal du song ba yin te/ rdza dpal sprul rin po ches/ gzhan pha rol po'i tshig gcig gi nga la brnyas byung / nga la smad byung zer nas rgyud khro long nge yod pa de chos dang rang rgyud so sor song nas chos kyi sems la cung zad kyang ma phan pa'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs par ma zad/ gzhan sems can la zhe snang dang khro ba chen po skyed par byed pa ni/ rang nyid rtag tu bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'dod pa'i rang gces 'dzin gyi blo ngan de brag ri ltar brtan por gnas shing / legs tshogs thams cad dang yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten du 457

gyur ba'i gzhan gces 'dzin gyi sa gzhi chen po'i sems bskyed yangs po rgya skyed gtong ma thub pa'i skyon kho na yin pas/ des rang nyid kyis bsags zin pa'i bskal pa mang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang dus gcig tu 'joms par byed pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ skal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs byas gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'jom par byed/ /ces sngon gyi dge rtsa thams cad chud zos su gtong ba ma zad/ da lta khong khro chen po langs pa'i gnas skabs su rang nyid kyi rgyun du yid du 'ong ba'i bza' mi bu phrug dang / snying nye ba sogs/ de bzhin rgyun du dga' po byed sa'i ca dngos dang rang byung gi khor yug bcas thams cad mi 'dod pa'i snang ba chen po skyed de/ sems rgyud rab tu 'khrugs te byams brtse'i sems kyi zhi bde'i 'od snang chen po de nyid kyang / khong khro'i me lces rab tu bsreg par byed cing / lus po'i 'phrod bsten la shin tu gnod pas khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad mang po skyed par byed pa yang mngon sum du mthong thub pa yin/ mno bsams zhib tu btang na zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa'i khong khro'i rigs kyis/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i bya ba rtsa ba nas mi byed pa'i khar/ da dung lus sems gnyis rab tu 'khrugs par byed cing / mi'i tshe'i nang gi bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bzang por gtor bshig gtong mkhan gyi dgra bo ngo ma rang yin/ de'i phyir rgyun du zhin re'i mi tshe'i 458

nang gang thub kyis su dang su zhig yin rung / phan tshun dbar bzod sran byed thub na nang pa'i chos kyi nyams len nang du'ang dka' thub kyi mchog gcig yin gsungs te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ /zhe snang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mi su zhig yin rung bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bzang po'i mi tshe'i bskyal 'dod yod cing / de 'dra'i bde skyid cig 'thob par byed na de 'byung sa'i gzhi rtsa gang yin pa de ngo 'phrod par byed dgos/ de ni rin thang bral ba'i byams pa dang brtse ba zhes pa'i tshig gnyis po 'di nyid yin cing / de gnyis po nyams su blangs te zhe sdang gi gnyen po'i kha gtad du byams pa bsgom par byed pa dang / 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa sgom par byed pa kho na yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir chags sdang gnyis kyi blo ngan drag po ji tsam skyed pa de rtsis kyis 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi lus sems gnyis kyi bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yang nyams rgud du gtong bar byed pa dang /byams brtse'i sems rgyud bza nga po 'di nyid ji tsam gong du 'phel ba de rtsis kyi 'jig rten na/ 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i sems can rnams kyi lus sems gnyis kyi bde skyed kyi 'tsho ba bzang po nyid kyang gong nas gong du skrun par byed thub pa yin/ de ltar nang pa'i chos dang bzod pa'i nyams len rtsa ba nas mi byed mkhan zhig gis/ ngos nas rgyu mtshan don gyis 459

sgo nas bsam blo btang na yang / rang nyid kyi sems rgyud nang zhe sdang chen po dang / nga rgyal chen po/ khong khro chen po bcas kyi nyon mongs pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs kyang / gzhan pha rol po'i sems can ni nam mkha' chen po'i mtha' dang mnyam pa nyid du yod dgos shing / de lta bu'i sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa thams cad zhe snang dang khong khros bcom ste/gtan nas phyi rol du dgra bo rtsa ba nas med pa zhig dus nam yang bzo thabs dang bral ba zhig yin/ dper na/ ngas zhe sdang dang khong khro chen po'i ngang nas gzhan pha rol po'i kha gtad du langs shing dmag 'khrugs sogs byas te/ mi brgya bsad kyang stong lhag yod/ stong bsad kyang khri lhag yod/ khri bsad kyang 'bum lhag yod/ mdor na/ 'jig rten na sems can 'bum khrag mang po khong khros bcoms par gyur kyang / da dung 'jig rten gyi khams la mtha' med cing sems can gyi grangs la'ang de bas kyang gzhal bar mi nus pa yin/ de'i phyir srid pa khams gsum na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la ngas dgra ru 'dzin kyang / dgra bo 'di dag thams cad mthar rtsa ba nas gzhom par byed thub pa'i dus shig gtan nas yong thabs med pa shes rtogs thub par gyur/ de ltar byas na de las phyi rol du yod pa'i gzhan pha rol po'i sems can 'di dag dgra ru ma bltas par gnyen du brtsis te nang du rang nyid kyi gshis rgyud la mnga' ba'i zhe snang dang khong khro de dgra ru 'dzin de byams pa dang snying 460

rje'i blo la yang yang gong nas gong du spel thabs la 'bad brtson bsten te/ mthar bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i dus shig 'byung nges mtshams su sngar dgra bor 'dzin pa'i dgra bo sems can thams cad btul ba dang khyad med du gyur ba yin te/ rgyas sras zhi ba lhas/ sems can mi sun nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis mi langs la/ /khro ba'i dgra 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra 'di thams cad bcom dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na nyid yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 7skyabs gon 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' slob las kyang / phyi rol du yod pa'i dgra bo ni dgra bo ngo ma ma yin zhing dgra bo ngo ma ni khong khro zhes pa de yin/ khong khro'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i gnas skabs der khong khros rang la phan pa dang grogs byed pa lta bu zhig snang yang / don du sems kyi bde skyed la gtor bshig cabatang ba las phan thogs rtsa ba nas med/ces gsungs nyin re nyin re'i mi tshe'i nang ga tshod thub thub kyis bzod pa'i nyams len byed thub na/ de rtsis kyis rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i khor yug der mi dang srog chags rtsi shing sogs thams cad yid du 'ong zhing dga' bde'i tshor snang dang / bde skyid kyi spro snang chen po zhig 'byin par byed pa yin la/ ma zad de'i bsod nams kyis tshe rabs phyi ma yang gzugs bzang yid du 'ong zhing / gzhan gyis bkur ba'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur la/ tshe rabs mang po'i las kyi sdig sgrib 'dag par 'gyur 461

ba yin te/ 'jug pa las/ bzod pas mdzes shing skye bo dam pa la//phangs dang lugs dang lugs min 'byed pa dang / /rgyas par 'gyur zhing de yi 'og tu ni/ /lha mi skye dang sdig pa zad par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas/ gnod pa byed pa la khong ma khro zhes gnod pa'i lan du da dung phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub par byed pa'i blo bzang po bskyed par byas te/ mthar rang gi srog gcod par 'gyur na yang khong mi khro bar de la snying rje'i sems bskyed de/ ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar te/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhi po nyams su len par mdzad pa ni rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying don dang / mdzes rgyan ngo mtshan can zhig yin pas/ gnas skabs dngos su nyams len ma thub kyang / rgyun du yang yang glo sbyong bar byas te/ gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i/ /re ba che ba 'ga' zhig gis//shin tu mi rigs gnod byed na'ang / /bshes gnyen dam par blta bar shog /ces gsungs pa bzhin bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du zhugs thub pa'i 'bad brtson dang smon lam 'debs par bya'o/ gnyis pa/ chos kyi phyir dka' ba spyad nus pa'i bzod pa ni/ dper na/ bdag cag gi ston pa bka' drin can de nyid kyis bskal pa mang por shin tu snyed par dka' ba'i gtan gyi byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par byed pa la/ lus skam par byed pa dang / sha dang lpags pa rnams kha gas par byed pa 462

dang / rus pa rnams zhig par 'gyur ba sogs chos kyi phyir du tsha grang dang / bkre sa skom/ dka' tshegs gang dag phrad par gyur kyang bzod pa chen po'i dka' thub kyi nyams len kho na mdzad nas mthar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis/stan 'dir bdag gi lus ni skam gyur kyang / /lpags pa rus pa sha rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang snyed dka'i byang chub ma 'thob bar/ /stan 'dir bdag gis lus bskyod mi bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' chen po 'jog gnang mdzad pa dang / rgya gar gyi chu bo nir nyang ṇa'i drung du lo drug gi ring du chu thigs pa re re dang / 'bras 'bru re re gsol nas dka' spyad snying rus kyis bzod pa'i nyams len mthar phyin par mdzad pa yin la/bod gangs can gyi ljongs su rje btsun mi la ras pas mar pa lo tsā'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas/ las sgrib dag phyir lto brag sangs dkar dgu thog bzhengs nas/ mthar dben pa'i ri khrod du chu dang za tshod kho na la yongs su spyad de dka' thub mthar phyin pa mdzad pas sgrub pa'i skyes ma chog yangs rtse nyid du gyur ba yin/ de bzhin du rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i jo bo a ti sha bod du gdan 'drangs phyir spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis tsha grang gi dka 'a thub chen po khyad du bsad nas rgya gar du byon nas/ jo bo'i ci bsung bka' bzhin dang du blangs nas zhabs tog dpyis phyin pa bsgrub 463

par mdzad pas/ thugs sras gtso bo nyid du gyur ba yin pas/ rtag tu jo bos nga la slob ma bzang po khyed dang 'dra ba zhig sngar rgya gar na bsna da pa'i skabs su yang yod/ ces yang yang thugs dgyes mnyes chen po mdzad pa lta bu dang / yang de bzhin du sman bla gnyis pa rje btsun g.yu thog chen pos kyang / bod gangs can gyi ljongs su gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa dang / 'gro ba nyam thag nad pa'i tshogs kyi ched du rgya gar du lan gsum dang / rgya nag tu lan gnyis sogs phyi nang gi yul gru gang sar dka' tshegs snying rus chen pos dang du bslangs nas/ bdud rtsi'i snying po gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum rgya cher mdzad nas 'gro ba'i gzhan don rlabs chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyangs pa yin/ de lta bu'i dka' spyad snying rus mdzad pa'i rnam thar sogs na/snyan ngag mkhan gyis sgro skur 'khyogs bshad dang / brtsams sgrung lha bu gtan nas ma yin zhing / gong gi lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya'i nang tshud du 'jig rten gyi mi yul 'dir dngos su byung ba'i gnas tshul ngo ma yin/de'i phyir rang gzhan gnyis ka bde bar smin nus pa'i byams brtse'i chos dang / rig gzhung / skad yig shes rigs bzang po sogs nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gtong bar byed pa la nges par dka' thub kyi bzod sran bsten dgos/ spyi tshogs dang / mi rigs/ rgyal khab sogs 'dzugs skrun dang yar rgyas yong bar byed pa la'ang nges par bzod sran 464

bsten dgos/ tha na rang nyid gcig bu bde ba 'thob 'dod kyi blos rtag tu rang don kho na'i las la rtsom par gyur ba zhig yin kyang / bya ba che phra chung gsum thams cad la bzod bsgom byed dgos pa ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ mdor na/ bzod pa'i nyams len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ku'i bya ba gang yin pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i ka ba lta bu zhig tu gyur yod pa yin/ gsum pa/zab mo stong nyid kyi chos kyi gnas lugs ngo ma gang yin pa dag ngo sprod pa'i skabs su/ sems nang 'jigs skrag gi snang ba med par zab mo'i chos kyi don ji bzhin bstan pa gang yin pa'i tshul la rang gis glos gzod nus pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ mnyam med rje myong kha pa chen pos/gnas lugs zab mo'i don la skrag gyur ba/ /blos bcad nyi tshe'i lta ba phyogs 'dzin pa'i/ /log pa'i lta ngan mtha' dag rab spangs nas/ /chos kun gdod nas stong par rtogs par shog /ces gsungs pa dang / sngon jo bo rjes/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med gsungs pa'i skabs dge gnyis kyi blo la mi bzod pas 'jigs skrag skyed de/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs nas chos zab mo la yid ches pa zhig med na/srung sdom dag pa gcig pus gar yang mi phyin pa 'dug gsungs/ yangari gdul bya 'a ga' zhig zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don thos pa'i tshe rgyud la log lta skyed pa dang / zab mo'i chos kyi gnas lugs ston pa'i gang zag la'ang 465

skur ba btab par 'gyur ba sogs byas te/ don dam du glo rgya chung zhing zab mo'i chos kyi gnas lugs yid la mi gzhong bar mi bzod par 'gyur ba'i dbang gis/ dus bskal pa brgya phrag mang po'i ring du dmyal ba nas thar thabs med pa'i las ngan tshabs che gsog par 'gyur ba yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi chos rnams bdag dang / snang ba dang / sgra dang rtog pa sogs mtshan rtags dmigs pa'i chos thams cad chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brtan dang / rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin 'khrul pa'i snang ba kho na las ma 'das shing / nam yang bden pa med pa'i tshul kho na rab tu rtogs nas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi gnas lugs bslu med bden pa'i rang bzhin du 'char ba'i tshul du rtogs par bzod nus pa'i bzod pa'i don nyams su len tshul dang bcas so/ /bcu gsum pa/ brtson 'grus kyi nyams len bshad pa/ji skad du/ de nyid las/ sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med pa'i/ /me nang bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos kyang / /snying rjes mi skyo byang chub mchog brtson pa'i/ /brtson 'grus phar phyin rdzo gas par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa ste brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la go cha'i brtson 'grus dang / sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ chog par mi 'dzin pa'i 466

brtson 'grus bcas gsum las/ dang po/ go cha'i brtson 'grus ni/ ma rgan nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par byas te/ ji srid sems can rnams byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar ma de dag gi phyir du bdag gi phan pa'i bya ba chung ngu tsam zhig las sgrub ma thub kyang nges par ci nas kyang bsgrub par bya'o/ snyam nas mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha brtan por gyon nas las la rtsom par byed de rim pas mthar 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don bla na med pa zhig sgrub par byed pa'i sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can ston pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla beeḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po bzhin dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad mtha' dag sel bar byed nus pa 'gyur ba ni smos med yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par byed pa'i khams bde gshegs kyi snying po can yod par gsungs te/ rgyud ta pa las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin/ /'on kyang glo bur sgrib mas grib/ /ces gsungs shing / las nyon gyis gzhan dbang kho nar song nas sgrib pa bzhis sgrib pa gyur ba na/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bzung da lta bar 'khor bar ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgyun chad med pa rab tu myong ba yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ da res snyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa de'i steng nas spyir 'gro ba sems can thams cad dang / sgos su nyam 467

thag pa'i 'gro ba nad pa rnams kyi don du phan pa'i phyir du gang thub kyis sman pa bzang po zhig dang / sman bzang po sha stag de'i nad g.yog sogs gang nye bar mkho ba'i gzhan phan gyi dge ba'i bya ba bzang po ga tshod thub thub gcig byas te/ mthar rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma dang / mnya ma med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po 'gro mgon mahā gu ṇa'i go 'phang bla na med pa zhig bsgrubs nas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan ci 'dra ba mnga' ba rnams bdag kyang de 'dra bar yong bar shog snyam /ste dam bca' brtan po zhig bzung nas sems rgyud bzang po'i phyogs su gong nas gong du spel te zhi ba lha'i gsung ltar/ 'gro ba nad pa ji snyed pa/ /nad gsos gyur gyi bar thag tu/ /sman dang sman pa nyid dang ni/ /de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar mdzad par gyur na/ de'i phan yon la'ang bsam gyis mi khyab cing brdzod gyis mi lang ba dag yod pa yin te/ rgyal bas/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang / /skyes mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /phan snod yon ni gzhal du med/ /ces shin tu nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba nad pa'i tshogs la phan pa'i sman gyi ril bu gcig tsam sbyin par gyur na'ang / de'i bsod nams dang phan yon la tshad med pa zhig yin/ gnyis pa/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus ni/ de ltar 'gro ba nad pa'i don sogs bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i tshe sang nyin dang gnangs nyin zhes phyi bshol gtan nas byed mi rung zhing / lhag don sman pa dang 468

sman dang nad g.yogs dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ni/ nad pa'i tshe srog dang 'brel ba'i las 'gan gal che zhig yin pas nges par du phral mar sgrub dgos pa las/ bar du gcod pa'i bya ba sogs gzhan gyis phyi bshol dang / sgyid lug cing le lo'i gzhan dbang du ma song bar gcigs cher 'dzin dgos te/ bod kyi gso rig sman gyi rgyud rang las kyang / gyang thog ma bor bor na gsod sdig bzhin/ /sman dpyad dus las ma 'gyangs brtson pas sgrims/ /zhes sman bcos byed pa'i dus su rig pa rtse gcig tu bsgrims pa las/ rnam g.yeng dang le lo'i dbang du ma song ba'i sman pa zhig byed dgos pa gal cher gsungs yod/ de bzhin du mi'i mi tshe ni shin tu nas phra ba'i dus kyi yun tshad thung ngu rtsis ma nus pa'i cha zhig nas skar cha'i dus thung / skar cha nas skar ma/ skar ma nas chu tshod/ chu tshod nas nyin/ zhin nas zla ba/ zla ba nas lo sogs dus skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par 'gro ba'i tshe rdzogs 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba rnams ni rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis ded pa'i chu bo'i mnyer ma bzhin rgyun chad med pa zad pa'i mtha' med cing / rang gces 'dzin gyi blos rang 'dod kyi bde ba bsgrub phyir las ngan gyi sdig pa'i rgyu ci tsam spyad kyang /mthar ngoms rgyu med pa'i 'khrul pa'i snang zhen gyi ra ba kho na las grol ma thub pas/ srid pa 'khor ba 'di nang mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal chen po gsum gyis rtag tu mnar bzhin yod/ rje gung thang pas/ dam chos nyi 469

shu ma byas nyi shu song / /byed do byed do zer nas nyi shu song / /ma byung ma byung zer zhing nyi shu song / /mi tshe stong par rdzogs pa'i rnam thar yod//ces bdag lta bu'i tha mal pa'i gang zag rmongs pa rnams kyi mi tshe ni/ tshe stod du ma thos la ma go ba ma shes pa'i phru gu'i snang bar lo ngo nyi shu tsam rdzogs shing / de nas dar ma'i gnas skabs su sdod pa'i ring gzhan phan gyi bya ba ci dang / bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par byed pa'i chos shig sgrub ma thub par 'di snang gi 'jig rten gyi bya bar mgo g.yengs nas mi lo bzhi bcu tsam rdzogs/ de nas rang lo bzhi bcu tsam la slebs pa'i skabs gzhan phan gyi bya ba zer ba de dngos gnas rtsa chen po yin pa'i ra 'phrod thub pas/ 'di phyi phral yun kun tu rang gzhan tshang mar phan bde zhig skrun thub na snyam/ de bskrun par byed pa'i thabs bzang shos de dam pa'i chos bzang po kho na yin pas/ dam pa'i chos shig byed do byed do zer zhing de 'dra'i ngang du yang mi lo nyi shu tsam rdzogs par gyur te lo na drug cur slebs/ de nas tshe smad du lang tsho'i mtshar sdug dang mdzes sdug sogs nyams te rgas shing lus 'khogs par gyur ba'i dus dam pa'i chos bzang po zhig bsgrub ma thub par ma zad 'jig rten nang phan pa'i bya ba cung zad tsam yang bsgrub ma thub par lus song snyam ste/ ma byung ma byung zer ba'i blo 'gyod kyi ngang skedu yang mi lo nyi shu tsam rdzogs nas mthar mi gzugs phyugs kyi 'du shes 470

rmongs pa can zhig tu gyur/ de ltar 'jig rten gyi mi yul 'dir gnas shing sdod pa'i skabs su rtsi shing nags tshal lta bur mi'i srog 'tsho ba tsam las/ snying po gzhan ci yang bsgrub ma thub pa'i blun rmongs ya nga zhing /yid skyo ba'i ngang tshul kho na'i 'og tu dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin chen gser las lhag pa de don med stong zad du phyin te/lus can rnams sems skyo ba'i ngang mthar mi 'dod bzhin du tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs par gyur ba'i lo rgyus 'di dag yod pa yin pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang po bla na med pa gong na med pa 'di nyid cung zad rgyud dang 'dres nges su gyur na/ mi lus 'thob pa'i don go chod cing mi tshe'i snying po yang len thub par gyur ba yin pas gang thub kyis gzhan phan ci thub la 'bad de de bsgrub pa la le lo dang phyi bgol gyi dbang du mi 'gro ba'i 'jug par sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi las bzang po brtsam par bya dgos pa'i gnas shig yin/ gsum pa/ chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ gong du brjod pa bzhin sman pa zhig gis ngos nas ngas 'gro ba nad pa'i grangs 'di tsam zhig gso thabs byas pa yin/ de bzhin du gzhan phan gyi bya ba 'di tsam zhig bsgrubs pa dang / sems bzang po 'di tsam bskyed pa yin pas da 'grig song snyam ste chog shes rtsa ba nas brten par mi rigs par da dung sngar las bzang po gang dang gang brtsams pa rnams la rjes su yid 471

rangs kyi sgo nas dmigs pa med pa'i mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi phan pa dang bde ba kho na'i ched du phangs pa med pa'i blo yis kun nas btang / da dung bzang po'i yon tan gyi legs tshogs kyi cha thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phyir chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus chen po nyams su len dgos te/ rje mi la ras pas/ rnam 'dren shākya seng ge ni phul du byung ba'i snying stobs dang rmad byung brtson 'grus chen pos sangs rgyas pa nyid yin zhes gsungs te/ khyed ni brtson 'grus can gyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nga ni le lo can gyi 'khor bar 'khyams//zhes rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la yang phul du byung ba'i snying stobs chen po dang / rmad du byung ba'i brtson 'grus chen po bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med par sgrub dgos kyang / nges par sgrub par byed nus pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom dgos pa yin/ yang de min 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang dag sgrub par byed pa de dag gi 'bras bu 'thob par byed pa la'ang brtson 'grus ni gal che zhing las kyi mtha' rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par byed pa'i cha rkyen bzang po zhig tu gyur yod pa yin/rje mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyi sum rtags las kyang / 'dod pa'i yon tan la chog shes bsten dgos kyang / rig pa'i gnas kyi shes bya la chog shes bsten par mi rigs/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ legs tshogs kyi gzhir gyur ba'i yon tan gang yin pa mtha' dag gong nas gong 472

du 'phel phyir chog shes bsten par mi rigs pas rtag tu chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi nyams len gang thub kyis 'bad de brtson par rigs so/ /bcu bzhi pa/ bsam gtan gyi nyams len bshad pa/ji skad du de nyid las/ bying rgod rnam par g.yeng ba'i skyon spangs nas/ /chos kun bden pas stong pa'i gnas lugs la/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa ste/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan dang / don rab tu 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dang bcas gsum yod pa las/bsam gtan bsgoms par bya ba la sngon du 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i gnas dben pa sogs su 'khor ba 'i sdug bsngal la bsams nas 'khor bar nges 'byung dang skyo shas tshad med skyes nas byams snying rje'i blos zin par byas nas bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che yang yang bsgom par bya ba dang / srid pa'i rtsa ba mtha' gcod par byed pa'i zab mo'i chos kyi gnas lugs mthar thug bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bcas/ mdor na/ nges 'byung byang sems/ yang dag lta 473

ba bcas gsum gyi sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du spel bar byed nus pa'i gnas chags snang bral ba'i dben pa lta bur bsten dgos pa shin tu gal che/ rje mi las/ mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ /skyo chad bde ba la sang dus med/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /yid dung nge ba la 'bral ba med/ /zhes dang yang / na na dri med med pa dang / shi na ngu mi med pa ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /zhes 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng chags sdang sogs dang bral ba'i gnas dben pa bsten nas dge sbyor yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel nas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can kho na zung 'jug nyams su len par mdzad pa'i mthar nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa rgyud la 'khrungs nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par yin pas/ rnal 'byor mi la zhabs kyis/ nga 'chi bar 'jig nas ri la bros/ /sems gzugs po'i gnas lugs stong bar rtogs/ /da 'chi ba byung yang nyam nga med/ /ces chos kyi gnas lugs mthar thug gang yin pa de nyid rtogs par mdzad/rang re'i gangs ljongs gso ba'i rig pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i bod lugs gso rig sman pa dag gis kyang / deng gi dus su bdun phrag re gnyis sogs gang thub kyis 'bad pa bsten te/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus sangs rgyas sman bla'i sgo nas sman sgrub dang / rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i sgo nas byin rlabs bla sgrub sogs 'gro 474

mgon mahā gu ṇa'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab chos bdud brtsi'i byin chen gyi chu rgyun la cung zad ro bcud myangs te/ nyams su len par mdzad na rang gzhan nad pa kun la 'di phyi phral yun kun tu phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar nges pa yin te/ rje btsun g.yu thog nyid kyi zhal nas/ kho bo la zhag bdun tsam ring gsol ba btab par gyur na nges par dngos sam/rmi lam tshun chad nas rjes su bzang ste byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ba zhal ༄bzhes mdzad yod la/ lhag par gso rig sman pa rnams kyis bsgom bya'i snying po gtso bo ni byams snying rje'i nyams len kho na yin te/ g.yu thog chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od lcags kyu las rje g.yu thog chen pos/ nga rgyal dang bral gso ba gtso bor ston/ /byams dang snying rje che ba'i lag rjes yin/ /snying rje che na gang byas chos su 'gro/ /snying rje'i ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nyid/ /dge ba gang byas dmigs med dge rtsar bsngo/ /zhes sems rtse gcig par bzhag pa'i sgo nas mtha' na dus yun skar ma gcig gnyis las ma byung yang / byams snying rje bsgom par byas te 'gro ba nad las grol ba'i gzhan phan gyi las bzang po bsgrub par bya ba ni/ gal cher gsungs te/ de yang nyid kyi zhal las/ nang dug gsum rnam rtog sems kyi nad/ /phyi rlung mkhris bad kun lus kyi nad//thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyis gsos/ /sman pa zer na nga la zer//zhes bdag 'dzin rtsa ba ma rig pa las byung ba'i dus gsum gyi rnam rtog 473

ni/ nang lus can rnams kyi sems kyi gcong nad chen po zhig yin cing / rgyu de dag las skyed pa'i 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kun gsum ni phyi 'gro ba'i lus kyi nad gcig yin pas/ phyi nang dus gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad dang bcas pa mtha' dag thabs la mkhas shing brtse ba thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis sel bar mdzad nus pa na/ sman pa bla na med pa zer na bdag la bgyi zhes rjes 'jug gso rig sman pa rnams kyis kyang de lta bu la nyams sku len par mdzad dgos pa ni gal che nan tan du gsungs yod pa yin/sems bying rgod ces sems nang du rab tu rmugs pa dang / sems phyi rol gyi rnam pa gzhan gye phyogs su g.yeng ba byed pa'i skyon chen 'di gnyis spangs te/ lus rnam snang chos bdun gyi sgo nas drang por bsrangs dgos te lus drang por bsrangs na lus la rten pa'i rtsa drang / rtsa drang por bsrangs na rtsa la brten pa'i rlung drang / rlung drang por bsrangs na shin tu phra mo'i rlung drang / shin tu phra ba'i rlung drang na rlung sems phra mor brten pa'i sems kyi gsal rig drang zhing / mthar shin tu phra ba'i rten rlung dang brten pa sems gnyis kyi ngo bo dbyer med mnyam pa nyid kyi thog nas gong du bstan pa bzhin brtse ba snying rje chen po rgyud la skyed par byed thub cing / snying rje'i ngo bo yang gdod nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las 'khor 'das kyi chos kun ma lus pa thams cad chos rnams spros bral chos kyi 476

dbyings su dbyer med ro mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo nas zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la rab tu mnyam par bzhag te/ lus sems kyi bya byed thams cad las su rung ba'i bde ba chen po 'dren nus pa yin pas na rtag tu sems rnam par g.yengs ba'i dgra bo de bcom par byas te/rang sems ting 'dzin gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ don de la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad de ched du gnyer ba ste nyams zhen gyi rtsi dang bcas bsgom pa'i dus dang po'i bsam gtan dang / nyams zhen dang bral nas stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas sgom pa'i dus gnyis pa'i bsam gtan dang / chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin la sgom pa ni bsam gtan gsum pa bcas so/ /bco lnga pa/ shes rab kyi nyams len bshad pa/ji skad du/ de nyid so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /drangs pa'i shin sbyangs bde chen dang 'bre la ba/ /don dam mnyam bzhag nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /shes rab phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab dang / bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab bcas gsum yod/ de yang dang po/ thos pa'i shes rab ni theg pa 477

gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi yis bsdus pa'i nang pa'i lung rtogs kyi ston pa'i dam chos ji snyed cig mchis pa thams cad dang / shes bya rig pa'i gnas ji snyed cig mchis pa thams cad dang / lhag par rang cag bod kha ba can gyi ljongs su sngon byon chos rgyal chen po mes dbon rnam gsum dang /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsā na/ sman pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshul can g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la sogs pa'i lo paṇa bka' drin can tsho'i mtshungs pa med pa'i stong gsum rin chen gyis bkang nas phul kyang gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin la brten nas gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dpal ldan rgyed bzhi dang bcas par bslab par bya ba la/ thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gsung gi thugs rje chen po'i lam ston 'og thos pa rgya cher bstsal dgos pa ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen bzang shos shig yin cing / de nas gang thos pa thams cad kyi tshig don la legs par bsams te/ gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag gi rang bzhin du shar ba byed pa dang / de nas gang thos pa dang bsam pa'i don kun ma lus pa dngos su lag tu len te rang gi nyams su myong bar byed dgos pa'i tshul zhig yin pas na/ de yang rje tsong kha pas/ dang por thos pa rgya cher mang du bstsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun ta nyams su blangs/ /zhes gsungs pa dag yin gshis/478

thog mar shes par bya ba'i rig gnas gang yin rung thos pa'i bag chags zab mo zhig 'jog thub pa / de nas de'i don gang yin pa dag bsam par bya ba la'ang ma rtsa'am gzhi rtsa lha bu snyed thub cing / gzhi rtsa gang yod pa dag las de dag gi don thams cad phyug pa med pa rang gi dngos su nyams su len par 'gyur thub ste yid kyi rmongs pa'i dri ma rnams yongs su sel nus pa zhig yin/ ston pas/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /kun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha mchog /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyang yin/ /zhes gsungs pas thog mar thos pa rgya cher bstsal dgos pa gal che/ gnyis pa/bsam pa'i shes rab ni/ de nas rang gi slob dpon gyi bstan pa'i gso rig sman gyi rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don dri ma med pa 'di dag gi gnas lugs la legs par bsam par bya ba'i skabs su gang dag lag tu len par bya ba'i snying bcud rnams bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba dang / zhib tu shes par bya ba/ rab tu dpyod par bya ba bcas kyi sgo nas the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod cing / gzhan 'drings mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa dang gdeng snyed thub pa zhig byung ba yin pas na bsam par bya ba'i gnas 'di rang nyid kyi rnam dpyod bed spyad de mthar nyams su len par nus pa'i dpa' gdeng zhig thob pa 'gyur ba la shin tu gal che/ gsum pa/ sgom byung gi shes rab ni/ de ltar thos bsam gnyis ya ma bral ba zhig byung na/ gang 479

dag sbyangs pa'i sman gyi shes bya sna tshogs pa dag la mthar nges shes gsal po snyed pa'i thog nas sman dpyad lag len gang dag gi gnas la thogs pa med pa'i nyams snyed de dngos su gso ba po sman pa mkhas pa'i don nyams su len par 'gyur thub pa yin pas/ de yang bla sman mkhyen rab nor bus/ gso dpyad mdo rgyas ma lus khong du chud/ /lag len man ngag gnad du sgril ba dang / /snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang song ba yis 'tsho byed dam pas sa 'dir yongs gang shog /ces gsungs pa yang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi don 'di dag ya ma bral ba'i sgo nas thog mar gso dpyad kyi mdo rnams khong du chud dgos pa dang / bar du lag len gyi man ngag thams cad gnad gcig tu sgril thub pa zhig dgos pa/ tha mar don nyams su len pa'i skabs dngos su 'gro la brtse ba snying rje chen po sgom pa'i sman pa sems rgyud bzang po zhig gi ngang nas nad pa'i gzhan don mdzad par 'gyur ba zhig byung na/ dgos don snying po yongs su tshang bar gyur ba yin/de yang kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ dang po thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas sgom pas nyams su len pa'i dus su/ phyi yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad med bzhin du 'khrul ngo la snang ba rmi lam lta bu rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las glo bur du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ med pa la yod par snang ba ni mig yor lta bu/ snang bzhin bden par dzi grub pa'i smig sgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la'ang med bzhin du snang ba 480

brag cha lta bu/ snyen dang brten pa med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang 'char bar sprul pa'i spong khyer lta bu bcas dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bkral nas snang ba thams cad rdzun pa'i rang bzhin du bstan nas chos nyid gsal stong nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ zhes gsungs zhing / des na chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa ni glo spos sam shes rab kyi don yin gshis/ de lta bu'i shes rab gsal ba/ shes rab khyer ba/ shes rab zab pa bcas kyi sgo nas chos rnams kyi gnas lugs mthar thug gang yin pa de nyid ma 'dres par so sor rab tu rnam par 'byed nus pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin par byas pa'i stobs kyis drangs pa'i lus sems gshin sbyangs kyi bde ba chen po'i nyams dang 'brel ba'i steng nas/ bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phyi nang snod bcud kyi 'khor 'das kyi dngos po'i chos rnams thams cad snang la rang bzhin du ma nges pa'i 'ja' 'od dang / chos nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur spros bral chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres shing rtogs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos zhes bya ba yin/ de lta bu'i sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la legs par yongs su bslab cing / nyams su len par mdzad pa ni sman pa byang chub sems 481

dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la spyod cing / rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir du yin pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i sman pa byang chub sems dpa' zhig gi ngos nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa pha rol chotu phyin pa drug gi nyams len ma tshang ba med par thams cad kyi gnad rnams yongs su sman gyi nang du bsgril nus shing / shin tu ngo mtshar che la rmad du byung ba'i gso rig sman gyi gzhung lugs dpal ldan rgyud bzhi nyid yin pas rjes 'dzin gso bar rig par don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnams kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'di dag gi gnad la gang thub kyis mi nyams lag tu len par bya ba ni shin tu gal 'gangs che ba'i gnad gcig yin// // 482

le'u bcu gcigabastod phyag 'bul ba la lnga /dang po/ bstod phyag gi dmigs rim/bsags sbyong gnyis kya'i phul du gyur ba ni bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang ngo bo dbyer med gcig gi sgo nas bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba nyid yin cing / de yang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'gro ba mi'i lus su bsgyur te/ rang gi g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun gyi sa gzhi chen po 'di gang ba'i tshul gyis mdor na dmigs pa med pa'i mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas lus gus pas 'dud cing / lag gnyis thal mor sbyar bar byas te phyag 'tshal/ngag gi sgo nas bstod dbyangs snyan cing sgrog yid kyi sgo nas sems gzhan du ma g.yeng bar mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing 'dir chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ston par mdzad pa'i ston pa bla na med pa bka' drin can dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa de'i bka' drin yid la dran cing / sku gsum thugs kyi yon tan rab tu dran par byas te dad gus chen pos bstan pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po gtso bo de la sngon du bstod phyag gsum phul te/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa 483

chen po'i gsung 'di nyid 'don par bya ste/ 'gro la phan bzhed thugs rjes rab skrun pa/ /spang rtogs skyob pa mchog brnyes lha yi lha/ /rten 'byung gtam gyi 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa/ /thub dbang smra ba'i nyi mor 'gosaphyag 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum phul te/ de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasasman gyi bla beeḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i mtshungs med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po 'gro mgon mahā gu ṇa'am rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med chu la chu bzhag lta bu'i sgo nas sgo gsum dad pa chen po'i ngang nas phyag 'tshal dgos/ /gnyis pa/ bstod phyag dngos 'bul ba dang phan yon/gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs dpal la 'dud/ /ces pa ste/tshig re dang phyag re sbrags grangs brgya dang rtsa gcig gam nyer gcig mdun gsum sogs dus kyi long yod med la bltas te gang thub gcig bstod phyag 'bul bar bya ba dang / de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su rang nyid gcig pus rang gi sdig sgrib kho na dag pa'i ched du ma bsam par khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag pa'i phyir rang gis gcos pa'i mkha' khyab kyi sems 484

can ji snyed gcig mchis pa thams cad kyis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang rnam pa drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i tshul du byon pa de nyid la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba snying nas btab ste gus pas phyag 'tshal dgos/ de yang mdo las/ pad ma kha 'bus phye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs bcas//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pad ma'i 'dab ma kha phye ba dang 'dra ba'i lag pa'i sor mo rnams gcig tu mnyam par sbyar ba ma zad/ pad ma'i dbus su ze 'u 'bru yod pa bzhin la ga pa'i mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug ste khong stong pa min pa'i tshul gyis spyi bor bskyangs pa de'i bsod nams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug tor gyi yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa dag 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / de nas smin dbrag tu thal mor sbyar ba byas pa des sangs rgyas kyi mdzod spu dang /mtshan bzang so gnyis sku yi yon tan ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / de nas mgrin par sbyar ba des gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa dag 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / de nas snying gar sbyar ba des kun mkhyen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thugs kyi yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa rnams 'grub par 'gyur zhing / mdor na sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku bcas 485

mthar rang gzhan sems can thams cad mthar lus ngag yid gsum gyis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag nas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can zhig tu 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phan yon bgrang gis mi lang ba dag yod pa yin/ gangs can bod kyi gso rig bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan mgro mgon mahā gu ṇa'am rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po de nyid ni gdul bya'i snang ngor sman pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i tshul du byon pa la don dam du kun tu bzang po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang ston pa mi bskyod sman gyi bla dngango bo dbyer med gcig tu gyur ba yin/ /gsum pa/ rje bla ma g.yu thog pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan/rje btsun g.yu thog nyid kyis zhal nas/ kho bo ni rig pa'i gnas lngal sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i 'gran zla med pa ste/—rgya gar du mu stegs de tsamabatul nas nang pa la bcug bod dbus gtsang du yang da lta 'chad rtsodartsom pa'i tshul kho bo la 'gran par sus spobs/ nang ltar grub pa thob tshul yang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob pa ni/ deng sang gangs can pa snang ba ma dag pa thams cad kyi snang ngor gsal ba 'di ga yin la/ gsang ba ltar rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 486

dkyil 'khor ma lus pa med pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / khyad par cung zad tsam yang med pas mchog gi dngos grub thob bam ma thob the tshom za bar byed dam/ khyad par rgya gar du 'tsho byed gzhon nu/ gu ru padma/ dpa' bo/ pha dam pa/ bir wa pa/ skyes bu me lha/ bod du srong btsan sgam po/ dgas po lha rje rnams kho bo yin cing / rgya gar gyi grub chen gzhan thams cad dang / kho bo'i rtogs pa nus mthu mnyam pa yin la/ zhing khams 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pa'i mthar/ lus kyi phung po 'di ma spangs par sman bla mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhing khams su 'gro ba khyed kyi ma rig gam/ zhes dag pa'i zhing du sku 'ja' lus kyi gong bur ma phebs pa'i sngon rol du bu slob dang / yon bdag la sogs lha mi'i tshogs rnams la yang rdo rje'i snyan mgur 'di dag gsungs te/ ka ye gson dang skal ldan kun/ /legs par gson dang 'jig rten mi/ /lhag par 'di tshogs lha mi rnams/ /khyed sngon chad ma nyan dgu nyan yang //'khrul tshig cal col lung ma bstan/ /de ring nyan pa don chen yin/ /sngon chad ma bltas dgu bltas kyang / /'khrul snang rdzun gyi ri mo yin/ /de ring ltos dang sgrib gnyis dag /mi nga ngo khyed kyis ma shes na/ /nga bde gshegs kun gyi pho nya yin/ /lus nad rnams kyi skyabs mgon yin/ /brtan g.yo shes byas gar khyab tu/ /nga yis lus ngag yid kyis khyab/ /sgyu lus gzugs kyi phung po yin/ /yi dam lha tshogs ngo bo grub/ /snyigs/ ma gdos bcas 487

rang sar dag /'ja' tshon lta bur ngos bzung ste/ /chu zla'i gar bzhin cir yang 'char/ /ngag grag stong brag ca'i glu dbyangs las/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrog /gang la gang 'dul chos char 'bebs sems can smin grol lam la bkod/ /sems gsal stong spros bral gnyug ma'i ngang / /bde chen khyab la rgyun chad med/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas/ /spros mtshams rang sar thim nas gda'/ /nga skad cig gcig gis bye brag 'byed/ /nga skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhing khams rngabargya ru dus gcig 'gro/ /sangs rgyas brgya dang dus gcig mjal/ sprul pa brgyar yang dus gcig 'gyed/ /sems can brgya ni dus gcig 'dren//zad par zin gnon thams cad 'grub/ /the tshom med par mos gus bgyis/ /som nyi med par gsol ba 'thob/ /rang snang ma dag rab rib kyis/ /de dag thams cad ma mthong yang / /kun gyi mthun snang grub pa la/ /nang dug gsum rnam rtog sems kyi nad/ /phyi rlung mkhris bad kun lus kyi nad/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyis gsos/ /sman pa zer na nga la bgyi/ /chos bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur glo nas 'chad/ /mu stegs rgol ngan rig pas bcom/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs//mkhas pa zer na nga la zer/ /lto dpal gyi ri la phyin pa'i tshe/ /mi rgod jag pas bar du bcad/ /lta stangs gcig gis thams cad rengs/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer/ /nub phyogs u rgyan yul du phyin pa'i tshe/ /sha 488

za mkha' 'gros gnam lcags phab/ /sdigs mdzub ltad pas mkha' 'gro 'gyel/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer/ /siṅga gling du phyin pa'i tshe/ /gru zing chu bo'i dbus su zhig /bya bzhin 'phur nas grogs kyang bsgral/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer/ /ka la tshal du phyin pa'i tshe/ /dug sgrul kha rlangs mun ltar gtibs/ /snying rje bsgoms pas myur du zhi/ /grub thog zer na nga la zer/ /stag gzig yul du phyin pa'i tshe/ /sog po'i dmag dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /brag ri phar thal tshur thal phug /grub thog zer na nga la zer//bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu/ /bon dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa'i tshe//nyin phyed bar du nam mkhar bsdad/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer/ /rdo rje gdan nas gangs can ljongs/ /nyin lam gcig la bcad nas 'ongs//gnas 'dir me tog skyes su khyer/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer/ /gtsang gi tshong 'dus 'gur mo ru/ /rta bdun rgyal pos btson du bcug /sman rgyal gser mdog char du phab/ /grub thob zer na nga la zer lar de 'dra brjod pas zad mtha' med/ /sems la rang dbang thob pa'i mi sa chu me rlung lha 'a dre sogs/ /brtan g.yo'i dgra yis brdzi mi nus/ /mkha' la 'phur na bya las mgyogs/ /chu la 'dzul na thogs dugs med/ /ri bo 'bigs na gnam lcags thog /me dpung dbus su me lha yin/ /dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung / /nga mthong nga ming thos pa nyung / /mthong thos dran reg dad pa la/ /byang chub bla med myu gu bskrun//489

skal par bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyangs/ /tshe 'di'i mi mthun bar chad bzlog /rang 'tshengs gzhan 'tshengs gnyis ka 'tshengs/ /de yi rje su slob tshad 'tshengs/ /nga la log lta'i sems can yang / /gnod byed bde bsdo 'brel ba'i phyir/ /bde nas bde bar 'dren par bya/ /'di la the tshom yod re kun/ /lar nga la glo snying gtad nus na/ /gsol ba phur tshugs 'debs nus na/ /the tshom yid gnyis spongs nus na/ /tshe gcig skyabs gnas re ba na/ /de ma thag tu sgrib gnyis bral/ /dngos nyams rmi lam nga 'phrad na/ /gnas skabs mthar thug lam mchog ston/ /da ltar bzhugs dang slad kyi byon/ /bu dang slob mas de ltar dgongs/ /re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs/ /da ni mi bskyod gnas su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas 'di lta bu'i 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa rlabs chen mdzad mtha' med pa bskyangs nas mthar dgung grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lngar gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi las dang bskal pas yongs su dben te re zhig sku yi bkod pa 'ja' lus 'od kyi phung por bsdus nas/ sman bla mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhing du gshegs pa yin/ /bzhi pa/ bstod phyag 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/de ltar rje btsun maha ṇa yi mkhye na brte nus pa'i yon tan dang sku 490

gsung thugs kyi bka' drin yid la dran cing / mos gus dang dad pa chen po'i sgo nas bla ma rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po de nyid drug pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chos sku kun tu bzang po sman bla mi bskyod rgyal po dang khyad par cung zad tsam yang med par yid ches brtan po'i sgo nas bstod phyag yang yang btsal bar gyur na/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thogs med nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams myur du dag cing / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs par gyur ba ma zad dngos sam rmi lam tshun du rjes su bzu nga zhing / gnas skabs tshe 'di dang phyi ma tshe rabs kun tu lam bzang po nyid ston par 'gyur ba rje btsun gyis dngos su zhal bzhes mdzad yod pa yin pas/ rig 'dzin sman gyi rgyud pa 'dzin pa'i rjes 'jug dag gis de ltar nyams su blangs bar bya 'os pa yin/ dper na/ sngon rgya gar gyi dpal ṇa len ḍar paṇa chen rnams phyi rol mu stegs pa'i rtsod pa bzlog pa'i phyir phyogs bzhir paṇa chen re re yod cing / dus gcig tu nā ro pas dpal ṇa lan ḍar paṇa chen gyi mtshan bzhes nas sgo srung mdzad pa'i skabs shig nub gcig rmi lam nang du bu mo sngo gsang ma gcig gis/ khyed rang tshig la mkhas pa zhig ma gtogs don la mkhas pa'i mkhas4zhepa zhig ma yin pas/ khyed rang nges par du don la mkhas pa te lo pa zhes bya ba zhig yod pas der song zhes smras pa rmis/ gnyid bsad ma thag tu de ni mkha' 'gro ma zhig gi lung bstan yin pa mkhyen nas tsha grang gi ngal 491 —

dub mang po myangs nas yul gru mang por myul te brtsad gcod mdzad kyang ma snyed/ nyin gcig lung pa zhig gi nang mi zhig la te lo pa zhes bya ba'i grub thob chen po yod dam/ zhes skad cha dris pas/ des grub thob yin pa mi shes kyang nga tsho'i mgar ba te lo pa zer ba gcig dang / sbrang po nywa zin mkhan gyi te lo pa zer gcig yod pa/ khyed kyi ga gi zer ba yin zhes smras ma thag tu 'o na gang du bzhugs yod dam dris pas/ mi des sbrang po te lo pa ste pha gi'i chu 'gram zhig tu yod ces lab/ de nas dpal na ro pas phyogs der bskyod pas/ te lo pa de chu 'gram gcig tu nya gson po gcig chu'i nang nas bton te zos nas mdzub mos se gol gcig gtogs/yang nya gcig zos se gol gcig gtogs byas nas bzhugs yod pas/ nā ros khyed rang grub chen te lo pa e yin nga rjes su bzung rogs zhes zhus pas/ te lo pas nga sprang po te lo pa yin pas ngas khyed rjes su bzung ba e yong zhes gsungs pa na/ dpal nā ro pas shing gi sdong po 'gyel ba ltar don dam rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngos yin par dgongs te sku phyag btsal nas rjes su bzung ba'i gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i mthar zhal gyis bzhes te/ te lo pas khyed nga'i g.yog por nyar chog gsungs/ de nas te lo pa gang du phebs kyang g.yog por khrid de chos tshig gcig kyang ma gnang ba rtag tu bka' bkyon mdzad/ nyin gcig mkhar thog rtsegs dgu lhag yod pa zhig rtser khrid nas bla ma'i bka' sgrub phyir mchongs nas 492

sam zhes dris pas/ g.yas g.yon du gzhan su gang yang med par kho rang yin par snyam nas mchongs pas/ lus la brdab chags chen po byung yang bla ma'i thugs rjes ma shi bar dran gsos nas khyod na'am zhes gsungs pas/ nad bas ma tshad ro bzhin chags byung gsungs pas/ de nas bzung mtshan la nā ro pa zhes bya ba gsungs srol byung bar grags/ yang nyin zhig me gtong ba'i skabs shig snyug ma gshags nas rkang lag gi sen du btab pas khrag chu ser sogs mang po thog nas na zug bzod glag med pa myongs bzhin pa'i skabs su bla ma te lo ba de da lta 'khris su yod gin yod gin la spo bur du 'ja' yal ba bzhin gar song med par gyur/ yang gsol ba btab pas zhag 'ga' zhig song nas mdun du byon/ de nas nyin gcig zhing kha zhig nang zhing las byed pa'i skabs su lto slong bar phyin pas thug pa thod phor gang byin pas de bla ma te lo pa la phul bas thugs dgyes mnyes chen pos gtsang bzhes gnang bas sngar zhabs phyi zhus pa'i nang nas da res nang bzhin thugs dgyes 'tshor chen po byung ma song bas/ da dung thug pa slong bar 'gro bsams te phyin pas/ zhing las byed mkhan rnams las skar song tshar bas da brkus na drag snyam ste thug pa lhag ma rnams brkus pas mi rnams kyis rjes su ded cing bdungs pas/ nyin shas yar langs rgyu med par chags nas lus kyang bla ma la gsol ba btab pas bla ma byon nas byin rlabs mdzad nas drag skyed song / de ltar te lo pas nā 493

ro pa zhabs phyir khrid de g.yog rgyu ba dang / bka' bkyon mdzad pa/ nyes brdung btang ba sogs kho na las chos kyi don tshig gcig kyang ma gnang bar dka' spyad gi shu rtsa bzhi sku lus kyi steng du spyad par mdzad nas/mthar nyin zhig te lo pas khyed song nas chu zhig len/ nga gnyis me gtong dgos gsungs nas na chos chu len par mdzad/ de nas me gtong bar phyin pas/ bla mas ngas khyed la chu len ma gtogs me gtong zhes lab med ces gsungs nas thugs shin tu khros pa'i tshul bstan nas zhabs lham phud de na ro'i mgo nas bzungs te thod par lham tshad med zhus pas/ na ro pa dran med du song zhing rgyal/ mthar dran pa sangs pa na bla ma rdo rje 'chang dpal te lo ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi spang rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa ji snyed gcig yod pa thams cad dpal na ro pa'i thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur ba yin par gsungs/ / lnga pa/ mjug bsdu tshul/tshul 'di lta bur legs par bsams pa'i thog sman bla mi bskyod rgyal po dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la mi phyed dad pa chen po'i sgo nas/rang gi lus steng nas gang thub bstod phyag phul te/ gong bzhin gang gis 494

drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs dpal la 'dud/ /zhes lan mang phyag btsal ba'i mthar bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams rang gi lus ngag yid gsu ma du zhugs te/ ngo bo dbyer med gcig tu 'gyur thub pa'i phyir te/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /sman rgyal gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang / /rang rig gsal stong gzhug ma lhan cig gshis//tshe 'dir rang sems sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces dang / dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /bla ma gu ṇa 'grub gyur cig /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /khyed kyi sa la 'god par shog /ces mjug tu smon pa bzang pos mtshams sbyar dang bcas te bstod phyag 'bul tshul 'di ltar lags na gso ba rig pa'i sman pa gang dag gis rgyun du dgong mo ma nyal khar rje btsun g.yu thog mthong grol chen por sku phyag lan gsum nges par ci nas 'bul gnang mdzad dgos// // 495

le'u bcu gnyis pa/maṇḍal gyi skor bshad pa la brgyad/dang po/ tshogs gnyis gsog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshul shes par bya ba la/ thog mar tshogs dang bsod nams gnyis kyi stobs rab tu rdzogs dgos pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin/ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyud la yon tan skye ba'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa la tshogs bsags kyi phul du gyur ba phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇḍal 'bul dgos/de yang mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ /ces dang po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rab tu ma rdzogs na/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don yang ma nor ba mngon sum du rtogs par mi 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma bsags na dag pa chos gzugs gnyis ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang nam yang thob pa med/ de'i phyir 'bad rtsol ri rab tsam byed pa las/ bsod nams yungs kur tsam bsags pa dga'/ /zhes gsungs shing / tshogs gnyis bsags par byed pa la'ang rab dang phul du byung ba ni maṇḍal rang yin te/ gangs can 496

mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rje tsong pa chen pos kyang / 'ol kha chos 'dzin du/dka' thub chen po'i sgo nas maṇḍal 'bum phrag bsags gnang mdzad par brten/ mthar phyag gi sha lpags zad nas khrag dang chu ser sogs tshad med thon nas phyag mdzub sogs gas par gyur ba'i rnam thar khungs dag yod cing / de lta bu'i skyes chen dam pa de sgrib gnyis dag cing rlabs chen rdzogs gnyis kyi stobs rab tu rdzogs pa'i mthar ltung bshags lha su ma cu rtsa lnga'i zhal mngon sum du mjal ba yin te/ rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga mngon sum du/ /rang rang sku yi dbyibs dang phyag mtshan sogs/ /ji bzhin rgyun du gzigs pa chos kyi rje/ /zhes gsungs pa na/ lus can sems can gang dag ni las kyi sgrib pa gsal zhing / tshogs chen po rdzogs thub pa'i dus shig la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi zhal mngon sum du mjal zhing zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dpal du longs su spyod thub pa'i bskal pa bzang po byung ba 'gyur ba ni nges par song / rgyun du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed pa ni gal che/ de yang sgrub pa'i skyes mchog chen po tai lo pas/ snyo snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med pa ma rtogs par/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo la/ /bral ba ma byed nā ro pa/ /zhes phan bde'i legs tshogs kyi yon tan gang yin pa thams cad rgyud la ma skyes pa rnams skye ba dang / skyes pa rnams kyang nyams pa med 497

par gong nas gong du 'phel ba byed pa'i gzhi rten gtso bo ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kho na yin pas tshogs gsog pa dang dus nam yang bral ba med par bya ba ni gal che ba yin/ zhes nan cher gsungs/ /gnyis pa/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu bstan pa/maṇḍal gyi rgyu yi gzhi rten ni kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las gsungs pa bzhin rab gser dngul sogs rin po che'i maṇḍal/ 'bring 'khar ba sogs rgyu dag pa/ tha ma rdo leb dang shing leb sogs kyang rung / maṇḍal bkod par byed pa'i rgyu'i tshom bu ni/ rab g.yu byur mu tig sogs/'bring sman mchog a ru ba ru skyu ru sogs/ tha ma 'bras 'bru sran ma dang / tha na rdo gseg dang bye ma sogs dmigs pa'i rten tsam rung zhing byi dor legs par byas pa zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu nor ji tsam 'byor min la bltos nas 'bul dgos/ de dag ni phyi ru 'byung ba lngas grub pa'i kun rdzob dngos po'i chos rnams kyi sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa yin kyang / don dam du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dmigs rim zab mo la brten nas 'bul ba ni nang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa yin pas/ phyi'i zag bcas dngos po'i rgyu rin chen 498

gser dngul sogs kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms ma 'dzoms ni de tsam gyi gal chen po ma yin zhing / da dung ser sna dang chags zhen che ba'i yul du gyur ba nyen che/ des na lag pa'i mdzub mo rnams kyi steng du phreng ba lta bu stong min tsam zhig khyer nas maṇḍal gyi tshom bu bdun ma zhig bkod nas gtso bo yid kyi sgo nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho lta bur sprul nas phangs pa med pa'i blo yis kun nas blangs te/ 'gro ba sems can rnams sgrib gnyis sbyang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir du dmigs te phul na don dam pa'i tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs thub pa 'gyur ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snying po ni gtso bo nang sems kyi steng nas byed pa las phyi dngos po'i dpal yon gyis sgo nas gtso bo byed pa gtan nas ma yin zhing / dper na/ bod chos ldan gyi zhing du rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi lar gser gyi maṇḍal steng du g.yu yi tshom bu bkod nas brjid nyams rab tu ldan pa'i rtsa che'i rin chen las grub pa'i maṇḍal zhig 'bul rgyu yod pa gtan nas ma yin te/ rje mi la zhabs kyis/ nor longs spyod ji tsam 'byor na yang / /mthar mi phan da lta 'phung pa'i rgyu/ /gtam snyan pas sa gsum khyab na yang / /slar lhung ba 'khor ba'i spyi srol yin/ /don de phyir srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /khyed ma reg zhen pa gting nas thongs//zhes dang / nor longs spyod bdag la 'bul ba med/ /pha bla ma ma'i bka' drin grub pas mjal/ /zhes gsungs nas khong gis brag phug stong pa zhig 49 9

nang nor rdzas ci yang med par sprang po'i tshul du ston pa bka' drin gyi —gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo yang dag pa nyid nang sems kyi steng nas gtso bo nyams bzhes mdzad pa la brten nas tshe gcig tu sangs rgyas pa yin pa smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir dngas zhing gtsang ba'i glo yi rgya mtsho chen po las byung ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi maṇḍal dmigs pa med pa zhig 'bul thub par 'bad brtson skyed par byed pa gal chen ba yin/ /gsum pa/ maṇḍal 'bul tshul gyi dmigs rim dngos/dang po lag g.yon gyi maṇḍal gyi gzhi bzung nas g.yas kyi maṇḍal gyi tshom bu bkod par byed pa'i rgyu rdzas blangs te/ ngag nas oṃ badzra sa ta sa ma ya zhes yig brgya bton nas maṇḍal gyi sa gzhir dri chu bzang po chag chag byas te skor ba g.yas skor gsum gyis gtsang mar phyis/ bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdeg sgrib dag par bsams/ de nas yang skor ba g.yon skor gsum bgyis/ byi dor byas te rang gzhan thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i dpa 4 rgyal ba rdo rje'i sems dpa'i sku gsum thugs 560

kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams/ de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas maṇḍal 'gul bar byed pa las/ dang po/ phyi'i maṇḍal la ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa shin tu brjid chags la 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod par byas te/ oṃ badzra stu mi a hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi bkod/ oṃ badzra re khe a hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gi skor ba'i dbus su ri yi rgyal po ri rab/ 'byung ba lnga'i nying bcud du gyur ba'i phyogs re re dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa'i ri rgyal lhun po dbyibs gru bzhi can ma mtshon byed du tshom bu chen po gcig bkod/ de nas shar ngos nas rim pas brtsis bzhin shar lus 'phags po zhes rin chen shel dkar po'i 'od mdangs bzhin nam mkha' dkar por snang pa'i zhing khams 'byung ba sa'i rang bzhin mtshon byed du tshom bu gcig bkod/ lho 'dzam bu gling steg bu'i dbyibs dang ldan pa rin chen beeḍūrya yi 'od mdangs bzhin nam mkha' sngon por snang ba'i zhing khams 'byung ba chu yi rang bzhin mtshon byed du tshom gu gcig bkod/ nub ba glang spyod gor gor rnga dbyibs dang ldan pa rin chen padma rag gā'i 'od mdangs bzhin nam mkha' dmar por snang ba'i zhing khams 'byung ba me yi rang bzhin mtshon byed du tshom bu gcig bkod/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi sho dbyibs can dang ldan pa rin chen inta ṇi lnga'i 'od mdangs bzhin nam mkha' ljang khur du0

snang ba'i zhing khams 'byung ba rlung gi rang bzhin mtshon byed du tshom bu gcig bkod/ de nas shar lus 'phags po'i zhing khams dang 'dra bar zhing gi bkod pa gcig tu mnyam pa'i zhing khams yang shar du lus dang lus 'phags gnyis bkod/ lto 'dzam gleng zhing gi bkod pa dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams yang ltor rnga yab dang rnga yab gnyis bkod/ nub ba glang spyod kyi zhing dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams yang / g.yo ldan dang lam phyogs 'gro gnyis bkod/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi zhing dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams yang sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi gda' gnyis bkod/ de nas shar du thun mong ma yin pa'i longs su spyad byar gyur ba'i rin po che'i ri bo gcig bkod/ ltor thun mong ma yin pa'i longs su spyad byar gyur ba'i dpag bsam shing gcig bkod/ nub tu thun mong ma yin pa'i longs su spyad byar gyur ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba gcig bkod/ byang du thun mong ma yin pa'i longs su spyad byar gyur ba'i ma rmos pa'i lo tog gcig bkod/ de rnams ni lcags ri gcig gi nang du bkod dgos/ de nas gsar du lcags ri gcig gi nang du gnyis pa nang gi maṇḍal 'bul bar byed pa la/ chos kyi rgyal srid bsgrub par bya ba la snying po gzhi 'dzin du gyur ba'i phyir bsod nams khyad par can rab tu bsags te gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i rten bzang gi dpal yon bzang po 'thob pa'i steng nas chos kyi rgyal srid bsgrub par bya phyir rgyal srid sna bdun dang gter chen po'i bum ripa meyilha

bcas brgyad 'bul dgos te/ de yang shar du 'khor lo rin po che/ ltor nor bu rin po che/ nub tu btsun mo rin po che/ byang du blon po rin po che bcas phyogs bzhi sor sor bkod nas de nas mtshams bzhi ru yang shar ltor glang po rin po che/ lto nub tu rta mchog rin po che/ nub byang du dmag dpon rin po che/ byang shar du gter chen po'i bum pa bcas bkod/ de nas slar yang phyogos bzhi mtshams brgyad du phyi nang gi sgeg mo ma brgyad kyis sgo nas 'bul bar byed pa las phyi'i sgeg mo bzhi ni shar du sgeg mo ma/ ltor phreng ba ma/ nub tu glu ma/ byang du gar ma bcas bzhi bkod/ de nas mtshams su yang shar ltor me tog ma/ lto nub tu bdug spod ma/ nub byang du snang gsal ma/ byang shar du dri chab ma bcas bzhi bkod nas 'bul/ de nas slar yang lcags ri gcig gis skor te shar tu nyi ma tsha ba'i stobs dang ldan pa gcig bkod/ nub tu zla ba bsil gyi stobs dang ldan pa gcig bkod/ ltor rin po che'i dugs gcig bkod/byang du phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan gcig bcas bkod pa'i zhing gi dbus su lha dang mi yi rin po che la sogs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'di dag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin bshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po ཿ 513

dang ngo bo dbyer ma phyes pa'i mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po mtshungs med rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams la zhing khams dbul bar bya ba bcas so/ /bzhi pa/ phyi'i maṇḍal 'bul ba/sa gzhi spod kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /ces pa ste/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas bkod pa ni zhing khams gcig dang / zhing de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams gcig 'jig rten gyi khams de 'dra ba yang stong phrag gcig la stong dang po gcig phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig stong dang po gcig phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de 'dra yang stong phrag gcig la slar stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gcig stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams yang de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag sogs zhing khams rab 'byams ther 'bum khrag khrig mang po brjod kyis mi lang ba yod pa dag so so'i blos stagasgos stobs kyis kun nas blangs te/ phangs pa med pa'i sems kyis maṇḍal 504

'bul ba ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams grangs med dpag tu med pa dag 'bul ba yin/ /lnga pa/ nang gi maṇḍal 'bul ba/de nas gong du brjod pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dag gi nang na gnas shing yod pa'i mtha' dang mu med pa'i ma gyur 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi dus tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung lus dang / longs spyod dang / dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad rtsa gsum sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhing du dbul bar bya ste/ bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs dang bcas ri gling nyi zla sogs/ /kun bzang mchod sprin bsam yas sprul byas te/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can la 'bul/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shog /ces phyi nang gnyis kyi sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rab tu rdzogs par gyur//drug pa/ gsang ba'i maṇḍal 'bul ba/de nas gsang ba ltar maṇḍal 'bul bar bya ba ni rje btsun ma ha gu ṇa'i 505
