snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas las gsungs pa bzhin phyi ltar padma'i 'dab ma/ nang ltar ḍarki'i mkha' rgya/ gsang ba ltar yul de la rol bas snying po rol pa len pas myur lam pho lha'i man ngag gi gzung 'dzin ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ye shes sgra gcan gyi dbang bar byas te/ rtsa mdud nyer gcig btsan thabs su dkrol bas rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcu dang / tshogs lam la sogs pa'i lam lnga bcas sa bcu lam lnga'i rtogs pa bsgrub phyir mkhas pa bzhi'i gnas la goms pas/ byang sems dbang ldog gi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas snying po bde chen gyi ye shes skad gcig la len par byed pa'i maṇḍal gyi dkyil 'khor ni khyad du 'phags pa'i rnal 'byor chen po mchog gi spyod yul kho na las thun yong las dang po ba'i gang zag blun rmongs can bdag dang 'dra ba rnams kyi spyod yul ni ma yin no/ /bdun pa/ mjug bsdu ba/de ltar mdor na mkha' khyab kyi zhing khams rgya mtsho blos blangs sheng sprul te sgo gsum gus pas bstod phyag dang bskor ba sogs dmigs nas maṇḍal 'bul ba ni phyi'i maṇḍal/ rang gzhan gyi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang bcas 'bul bar byed pa ni nang gi maṇḍal/ 'khor gsum 506

rnam par mi rtog pa'i spros pa gzod nas zhi ba'i rang ngo la mnyam par 'jog pa ni gsang ba'i maṇḍal bcas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇḍal lhan cig tu 'brel bar byas te/ grangs brgya dang rtsa gcig nyer gcig bdun/ gsum sogs dus tshod la gzhigs te phul ba'i mthar bcom ldan 'das 7rgyal ba wasman gyi bla dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun bla ma g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i rtsa gsum sman gyi dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'ja' 'od phung po dkrigs pa'i klong nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas bdag gzhan nam mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bsal/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i bskal pa can du byas/gzhan gyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos nas g.yu thog chos skor zin khrid las gsungs pa bzhin/ na mo zhes lan 'ga' shas bton nas bdag gzhan rten dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag sge/ gang gi rten cing 'brel ba 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /'chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa//tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi ston pa/ /rdzogs pa sangs rgyas smra rnams kyis/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de bar mtshams rnams su/ rten 'brel snying po'i sngags 'di gar 'don par bya'o/ oṃ yi nyi ma tehu prabha ba/ hai hun he khyab bya'o ghaha lhabs dathu/507

he okha stsa o ne a rdo ni oka ri mahā ṣamaṇaya sa hā/ zhes rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs 'don par bya dgos/ /brgyad pa/ maṇḍal gyi phan yon bstan pa/maṇḍal phul bar byed pa ni bsod nams dang ye shes gnyis kyi tshogs rab tu rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir yin la/ 'jig rten 'di na phyi dngos po'i zang zing dpal 'byor sogs rin thang gzhal du med pa'i mchod pa phul ba sogs gang byas pa thams cad las/ maṇḍal tshar gcig phul ba'i bsod nams che zhing / de lta bu'i maṇḍal phul bar byed pa ni tshogs bsags kyi sgo thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin pas/ rgyun du maṇḍal 'bul bar byed pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin/ maṇḍal phul ba la rin chen gser dngul sogs kyi dngos po nges par du 'byor dgos pa ma yin zhing / rang gi lag pa'i steng du phreng ba dang / yang na 'bras dang 'bru sogs gtsang ma 'a ga' shas shig gis dgang nas gong du bstan pa bzhin maṇḍal phul ba'i dmigs rim zab mo bsten nas rang rang so so'i blo yi stobs che chung i kun nas blangs te/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin bzhin zhing khams rgya mtsho lta bur sprul byas nas grangs med 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi las nyon gyi sdig sgrib dag phyir sems bzang 508

po'i yon tan gang dag gong nas gong du 'phel te/ byams pa dang brtse ba snying rje chen po rgyud la myur du 'khrungs pa'i phyir dmigs te 'bul dgos/ de ltar bsams te phul ba'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu bzang po ji byung snyam na ni/ g.yu thog chos skor gyi nang tshan them skas las gsungs pa bzhin/ gnas skabs tshe 'dir dpal 'byor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur nas/ dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas nor longs spyod rgya chen po byung / rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dngos rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po skye bar 'gyur/ rang las gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub kyi sems sogs theg pa chen po'i chos la nges shes khyad par can skye/ bsod nams kyi stobs de'i mthu las mi ma yin sogs lha 'dre dug pa can gyi mi tshugs/ 'gro ba tha dag gi dga' zhing gong du bkur ba'i 'os su 'gyur/zhes dang / yang dus tshigs bzang po khyad par can dang bla ma dkon mchog sogs rten gnas khyad par can sogs kyi drung du maṇḍal gus pa chen pos dmigs rim dang bcas tshar gcig phul na yang / de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni bskal pa dpag tu med par bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyi nang gi mchod gsol rgya chen po byas pa las lhag pa'i bsod nams 'thob par 'gyur/ gang ci bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub/ bskal pa nas bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung 509

gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur/ lan gcig phul nas yid dad pas smon lam ji ltar btab pa thams cad 'bad med du 'grub/ de bas na phyi rabs kyi skyes bu rnams kyis mnasal 'bul ba la brtson par gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang / sngar chobarjod pa bzhin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gnad de rnams kyi zin pa'i sgo nas phul ba'i phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi mnasal rgyu gsham/ nang skyes bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs rim bsal/gsang ba 'khor 'das kyi chos kun ma lus pa dbyer med ro gcig par mnyam pa nyid du lta bas rgyas btab nas phul na/ de ni thabs shes khyad par can gyi zin pa'i mthu la brten/ skal chen grangs med gsum gyi tshogs kyang dus skad cig nyid la zlums pa yin te/ kun ma khyen chen pos/ de phyir grangs med gsum sogs gsungs pa kun/ /myur du rdzogs dang ring du rdzogs pa dang / /tshe gcig spol ba blo yi stobs la rag /de yang thabs dang shes rab brtson 'grus mchog /gsum gyis bsgrubs sgang bla med stobs che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa na/ mnasal sogs tshogs dang bsod nams gang bsags pa thams cad rang gces par 'dzin pa'i glos rang gi tshe 'di phyi kho na'i bde skyid dang bsod nams/ dpal 'byor/ dbang thang / longs spyod mnga' thang sogs 'byung phyir ma dmigs par 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can sdug bsngal ba spyi dang / bye brag ngan 'gro ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol zhing / bde 'gro mtho ris su lha dang mi'i 510

rten bzang khyad par can zhig snyed nas de'i thog nas bdag pas gzhan mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che sngar ma skyes pa rnams skye ba dang / skyes pa gang dag nyams pa med par gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phyir du bsams te snying khungs rus pa'i gting nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i rtsa gsum rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor dam par 'bul bar bya ba ni shin tu gal che ba yin te/kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ rang don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod kyang / theg pa chen po'i lam gtan nas ma yin pas na/ tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong gang dang gang byed kyang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs pa las/ rang 'dod kyi blo dang gtan nas ma 'dres pa zhig cis kyang gal che/ de ltar byas na rang don dang tshe'i 'di'i bde skyid sogs mi 'dod kyang zhor la 'byung ste/ me 'bud pa'i tshe dud pa zhor la 'byung ba dang / nas btab pa'i tshe sog ma zhor du byung ba lta bu yin pas na/ de dag la ched du gnyer ba'i glo ni dug bzhin du spong dgos so/ zhes dpe don bcas legs par gsungs 'dug par ma zad/ spyan ras gzigs dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyabs mgon rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen pos kyang / rgyu nor longs spyod sogs dpal 'byor gyi 'byor ba che chung mi 'dra ba yong ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/511

rtsa ba so sos bsod nams bsags ma bsags gcig dang / bsod nams kyi rgyab rten che chung rang la rag lus pa red/ dper na/ bod pa tsho dang rgyu nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i ched du nor gyi lha sogs bsten te mchod pa phul ba sogs byed kyin yod kyang / bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nang du a sgor dung phyur mang po yod mkhan gyi 'byor ba can yong gi mi 'dug la/ a ri sogs phyi rgyal rgyal khab khag gi nang khong tshos nor gyi lha gang yang bsten gyi med kyang / gang ltar a sgor dung phyur dang sa ya mang po yod bsdad mkhan mang po mthong yas 'dug de rgyu mtshan ga re byas nas red zer na/ rtsa ba tshe rabs sngon la so sos bsod nams bsags pa kho nas byung ba red/ byas tsang / dus rgyun du bsod nams gsog par byed pa gal chen po red/ bsod nams mang po bsags par gyur na nor lha sogs gang yang ma bsten kyang / rtsa ba bsod nams kyi rgyab rten yod tsang / rgyu nor longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'phel gyi yod pa red/ ces zhal gsal zhing go bde ba'i phyir du rgyun du bsod nams gsog dgos pa ni rtsa ba'i gal che zhig tu gsungs yod/ de'i phyir du gso ba rig pa'i sman pa rnams kyis kyang rje btsun g.yu thog chen po'i snyan rgyud kyi zab gnad dam pa 'di dag la nyams bzhes ci thub mdzad de/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa spyi dang yang sgor 'gro ba'i nad pa'i tshogs kyi gcos pa'i dmigs med sems can thams cad bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs 512

par gyuranas dag pa chos gzugs gnyis ldan gyi go 'phang dam pa zhig thob par bya ba'i phyir du gang thub kyis maṇḍal gyi tshul 'di lta bu phul bar byas pa'i mthar/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi gsung ltar/ dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis 'thob par shog /ces mjug pa smon lam khyad par can gyis rgyas thebs par bya'o// //513

le'u bcu gsum/sman sgrub bshad pa/dang po/ sa gzhi byin rlabs/mtshams 'dir sman pa rnams kyis nad par ma gzigs pa'i snga rol du sman sgrub mdor bsdus shig rgyun du gnang dgos pa ni shin tu gal chen po yin/ rgyas pa sman sgrub drang srong dgongs rgyan las gsal mod kyang /'dir bshad rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa bya byed sman pa'i le'ur gsungs pa bzhin sman sgrub mdor bsdus shig bstan par bya ba ni/ de ltar gong du maṇḍal phul zin pa'i rjes slar yang thog mar sa gzhi thams cad byin gyis brlab par bya ba ni/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /seg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam beeḍūrya'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /ces sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dpal rdo rje rnam 'joms la bstod phyag sngon du phul de sngags 'di 'don par bya ste/ na maḥsha lan gsum brjod de/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yis 514

chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku 'khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thu ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye ā hūṃ/ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje sku nyid la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje sku thob shog /gnyis pa/ rang nyid lhar skyed pa/de ltar gong du sa gzhi byin rlabs dang 'khrus gsol gnang ma thag tu rang nyid bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin a ru ra dang / phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag bdud rtsis gang ba'i sman gyi lhung bzed dang / sku la mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na phyogs kyi sprul sku'i ngo bor gyur/ rang nyid beeḍūrya yi rgyal po dang / /sman gyi snod ni bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsnams/ /sman bla drang srong rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ /'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /sku mdog mthing ga baiḍūrya yi 'od/ /sprul pa'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /rlung mkhris bad dzin nad kyis gdung pa la/ /nad kyi gnyen po phyag g.yas a ru ra//phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed par bu bsnams/ /baiḍūrya yi 'od la 515

phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su chud/ /tshe la dbang ba'i bcud len dngos grub brnyes/ /mngon shes snying rjes 'gro mchog 'du ba snyoms/ /drang srong rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo ma na mo bha ga wa te/ lha ṣa hye gu ru bee ḍā snge pra bha rā dzwa ya/ ta thu ga tā ya/ a rū te sa mya kshi bus ya/ ta byu thā/ oṃ hai ṣa bye dzhai ṣa nghru mahā lha ṣa hye/ rā dzā ya sa muṅga te snahwa//gsum pa/ sman sgrub kyi dmigs rim/zhes lan grangs du ma bzlas brjod gnang ba ni dus tshod dang bstun te sangs rgyas sman bla'i zungs sngags gang mang bzlas pa'i mthar/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bcas nas 'od zer kha dog brgya stong mang po phyogs bcur 'phros te phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thugs mnyes par byas pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rabs 'byams ma lus pa na mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin can bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i ngo bor 'phros nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po'i phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed nang du 'thim/ de dag rim bzhin phyir babs te na ba med par sman gyi bdud rtsi/ 'chi ba med par tshe yi bdud rtsi/ zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la 'thim par gyur te/ spyi bo/ mgrin 516

pa/ snying ga'i gnas su bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs ste gti mug klad par brten pa'i bad kun gyi nad thams cad dang / zhe snang srog rtsar brten pa'i mkhris pa'i nad thams cad dang / 'dod chags gsang bar brten pa'i rlung gyi nad thams cad dud gu dang sul khu'i rnam par thur du babs ste dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad thams cad zhi bar byas/slar khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rab tu smin par byas te phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa mdzad par gyur bsams//bzhi pa/ sman mchod 'bul tshul/bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /grangs med gzugs sku'i rnam par ston mdzad pa/ /rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi/ /zhi dang khro ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bla ma rdor sems rigs lnga yab yum dang / /rta phag yab yum mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir skur bzhengs la/ /sku gsung thugs yon byin can ma lus phobs/ /gnas khang 'di la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas la sman gyi mthu stobs stims/ /rig 'dzin tshogs la byin brlabs dbang bzhi bskur/ /re ba'i 'bras bu phyogs mthun dngos 517

sgrub rtsol/ /ces sman gyi mthu stobs nus pa phul du phyin par gyur bar mos te/ mchod yul gong ma rnams la sman mchod 'bul bar bya ba ni/ hūṃ/rtsa ba yan lag stong sbyar sman/ /dug lnga ye shes lnga gyur pa/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yidangos/ /ye shes lngardzogs mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba panya a mra ma ta hūṃ hrīḥtha/ rgyal ba sman bla rig 'dzin padma 'byung / /dpal ldan phreng ba rje btsun g.yu thog zhabs/ /ye shes gzungs dang dpal ldan gzhon nu la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /o sarba sangs rgyas rigs chen rdo rje dang / /don grub rgyal mtshan dkon mchog skya bas kyi phul/ /rin chen bsod dbang rnal 'byor chen po la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / ri khrod zhig po zur mkhar mnyam nya'id rje/ /dkon mchog pa dang nam mkha' dpal ldan zhabs/ /mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / bkra shis stobs rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i dpal/ /gsang chen chos kyi mdzod 'dzin ā nanda/ /'khor lo'i mgon po blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / blo bzang tshe dbang kun bzang grol mchog zhabs/ /chos 'byor rgya mtsho rig 'dzin bzang po dang / /padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / mthu stobs rnam rgyal bstan 'dzin mthu stobs 518

dang / /bstan pa dar rgyas byams pa bstan 'phel zhabs/ /bka' drin ma/nyam med tshos kyi seṅge la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang / /rigs kun khyab bdag blo gros mtha' yas zhabs/ /dri med blo gros byams pa 'byung gnas la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras ma lus pa'i/gcig bsdus snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ byang chub sems dpa' bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / (kho bos gsar du bsgrigs//theg chen mdo sngags thar lam gsal byed phyir/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad lung khrid chos kyi rje/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / (kho bos gsar du bsgrigs//kun 'dus rigs lnga rda phag yab yum dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sman gyi drang srong lha mor bcas pa la /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / de nas rang gis bstan par bya ba'i phyir du/ sdiḥ 'khor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang / /shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che/ /thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgyas cho ga bzhin/ /myangs pas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ / kā ya wa ka tsi twata sarba sidhi oṃ ā:nywa/ zhes brjod de/ lag 519

g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gnyis kyis sman mchod lan gsum stor te lce la myang bas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub dang byin brlabs thob par mos/ /lnga pa/ mjug bsdu tshul/de nas sman rnams nyam thag 'gro ba nad pa rnams la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'byin par gyur/ sman lha drang srong rnams kyi shis par brjod de/ lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / /klu rnams kyi ni gtsug nor lta bu dang / /drang srong rnams kyi bcud len lta bur ni/ /khyed la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig /rlung mkhris bad kun bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /tshe la bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang / /gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa//bsams pa'i bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum mnyes pa'i byin brlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin brlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /ji ltar btab pa'i smon lam grub par shog /ces sman sgrub kyi sgom rim cung zad bshad par bya ba 'di nyid dam/ rgyas par bskyang 'dod na sman sgrub drang srong dgongs rgyan gyi cho ga rgyas pa la gzigs par mdzod/ /520

le'u bcu bzhi pa/rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bshad pa/dang po/ sdig pa bshags pa'i tshul/rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen gtso bo ni sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas las kyi sgrib pa bzhi po rnams yin pas/ de lta bu'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba mchog tu gyur ba ni dpal rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas yin/ de yang lus can sems can thams cad tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang / da lta'i tshe 'dir gsog bzhin pa'i las ngan gyi sdig sgrib dang / las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang de kho na'i dbang du song nas 'byung 'gyur skye ba phyi ma rnams su las ngan gsog par 'gyur ba sogs mdor na/ sdig pa'i las mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga / phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa bcas sdig pa'i phung po tshabs che ri rab tsam bsags par gyur na yang / bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i rnam 521

pa dpal rgyal ba rje rje sems dpa'i sgo nas gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i ngang nas sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa rnams bshags par gyur na byang zhing dag par 'gyur ba yin/ de yang kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung du/ spyir sdig pa la yon tan med kyang / bshags pas 'dag pa sdig pa'i yon tan yin gsungs shing / de ltar sdig pa bshags pas dag par 'gyur ba med na ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yang mi nus te/ byang chub kyi lam zab mor nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byed pa la 'gal rkyen gtso bo ni sdig sgrib bag chags nyes ltung dang bcas pa dag yin gshis/ der brten byang chub kyi sems kyi zin pa'i thog nas yab rdo rje sems dpa'/ yang na yab yum gnyis su sbyor ba'i ngang nas gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags par gyur na ni bskal pa stong phrag mang por bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs thams cad dus skad cig nyid du byang zhing dag nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba yang yod pa yin te/ dper na/ 'og min gnas stug po bkod pa'i zhing du sngon chos sku kun tu bzang po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang de nyid dus skad cig nyid du las kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas dug skad cig nyid du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa yin/ de yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag pa bsdod pa las/ skad cig gcig gi bye brag dgyes/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs 522

sangs rgyas/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi rgyud rang las gsungs pa yin/ de ltar mtha' dang mu med pa'i nam mkha' gar khyab ma rgan 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi rang rang so so'i blo dang / dbang po dang / bas ma pa sogs rgya chen chung rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dbang las 'ga' shas dus skad cig nyid du sangs rgyas thub pa dang / 'ga' shas bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs nas sangs rgyas thub pa dang / 'ga' shas bskal pa brgya phrag mang po dang / 'ga' shas bskal pa 'bum phrag mang po dang / yang 'ga' shas ni tshe gcig lus cig la sangs rgyas thub 74 sogs gang zag so so'i glo dang bsam pa'i stobs rgya che chung dbang gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam du bzhugs nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba byed pa la'ang dus ring thung gi khyad par du ma zhig yod pa yin/ de lta bu'i glo yi stobs kyis dus yun ring thung gi khyad par yod pa yin mod kyang / sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu khams bde gshegs kyi snying po gcig mtshungs su yod pa yin te/ rgyud ta pa las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin/ 'on kyang spo bur sgrib mas grib/ /ces spyir sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu yod kyang / las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can kho nar song nas de lta bu'i las nyon sdig sgrib kyi gzhan dbang can du song phyin chad la sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na las ma — / 523 byu

'das shing / sdug bsngal khab rtse tsam yang rtsa ba nas mi 'dod pa'i blo zhig yod pa 'di rgyu mtshan du byas te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa la rgyal bas mchog tu bsngags pa ni bla ma rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas nyid yin/ tshul 'di yi sgo nas las kyi sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ shes bya'i sgrib pa/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa phra mo tshun tshad yang yang sbyong zhing dag par gyur na lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang gtan gyi bde ba bla na med pa zhig rang bzhin gyis dus gcig car nyid du thob par 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir sems can rang rang so so'i tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung da lta bar lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa'i rgyu mi dge ba gang ci bsags pa thams cad snying thag pa nas 'gyod sems drag pos legs par bshags par gyur na rang gi pha bsad pa dang / ma bsad pa/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyi khrag 'byin pa/ dge 'dun dben 'byed pa bcas mtshams med lnga'i las ngan gang bsags pa rnams kyang dag par 'gyur ba ni dngos su yod pa yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bshes springs las/ gang zhig sngon tshad bag med gyer ba las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' po sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes dper na mkha' yi zla ba sprin gyi grib ma las bral bar gyur ba bzhin sngon bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas 524

zhal zhugs pa'i dus su 'dod chags can dga' bo dang / log lta can ṭo ra phreng / pha ma bsad pa'i mthong ldan dang bde byed rnams kyang / phyis sangs rgyas la dad cing sdig pa bshags nas dag cing mthar dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur ba'i lo rgyus sogs la snyon dor spu tsam med par/ mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel gyi gsung tshad la dag las legs par bstan yod pa yin/ /gnyis pa/ gnyen po stobs bzhi/lam gyi 'gal rkyen sel zhing sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'ikoskom zlas kyi sgo nas gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i thog nas sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chag dang bcas pa sbyangs shing dag par byed dgos pa yin/ de yang tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas sdig sgrib kyi kha gtad dam gnyen po stobs bzhi bsnyen dgos sam snyam na ni/ sangs rgyas sman bla gnyis pa mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po 'gro mgon rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i snyan rgyud kyi dam pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas las 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sems des nges par zin par byas nas rang nyid tha lal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa yongs su gyur ba las bla ma dang 525

gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ru gsal ba ni rten gyi stobs/tshe rabs 'khor ba thog pa med pa nas sgo gsum mi dge'i las bcu dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba thams cad dug khong du shor ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems byed pa rnam pa sun 'byin gyi stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi dge sdig pa'i las mi byed par dam bca' ba ni nyes pa las slar zlog pa'i stobs/ thugs zhar zla steng hūṃ yig la yig brgyas bskor ba las bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong byed bzhin du bzlas brjod pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bcas gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas rang gi spyi bor pad zla sogs dmigs te bzlas dgos/ zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams ni sdig pa bshags pa'i gnyen po stobs bzhi zhes bya ba dag yi na/ / gsum pa/ rdor sems bsgoms bzlas dngos/rang gi spyi gtsug pad dkar zla ba'i steng / /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ston zla'i mdog /rdo rje dril 'dzin dar dang rin chen rgyan/ /zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs/ /thugs kur zla steng hūṃ mthar yig brgyas bskor/ /bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od 'phrog don gnyis byas/ /sa — bon sngags las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung / /sku lus nang gang zhabs kyi 526

mthe bong las/ /babs te tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun bkrus/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs/ /sbyangs shing dag nas gsal stong 'od skur gyur/ /zhes bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zhing gi dul dang mnyam pa'i tha lam pa 'gro ba mi yi lus su bsgyur te dmigs pa med pa'i nyam thag ma rgan rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhar bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong ba'i phyir du gnas par bsams te dmigs rim bskyangs nas bdag gzhan gyi spyi bor 'do ma pa gang tsam mtho dma' mnyam pa'i nam mkhar pad zla'i gnas kyi dbus su hu yig dkar po dri ma med pa'i yongs su bskor ba las bla ma dus gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo gang yin pa la 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag cing sbyong ba'i slad du rnam pa dpal rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can/ sku mdog ston gyi zla ba ltar dkar zhing dngas la/ nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi phung po lhang nger gsal ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga ba bsnams shing / rgyal ba rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can shes rabs kyi phyag rgyas thugs kur 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon la dril bu mu khyud kyi drwa bas legs par spras pa byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po rang bzhin gyis zhabs g.yon gyi dku la brten pa/ cod pan/ stod g.yog527

smad dkris/ sku regs/ dar dpyangs dang bcas dar sna lngas mdzes par spras pa/ de bzhin dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub dang bcas rin che'i rgyan brgyad kyis legs par brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis phyed rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi ngang du sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'ja' 'od kyi phung po'i klong na bzhugs su gsol ba zhig sgom par gyur na ni sdig pa bshags par byed pa'i rten gyi stobs yin/ de ltar legs par sgoms pa'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ gser zangs bris sku sogs dngos po gdos bcas ma yin pa/sha khrag la sogs zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po yang ma yin pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' mtshon ltar gar ba/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kun mkhyen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ngo bo gnyis su med pa dang bcas pas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas thabs mkhas thags rje chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i spyan sngar/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da bar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig pa mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med lnga / de dang nye ba lnga / phyi sor thar sdom pa'i 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i smon 'jug gi bslab bya'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ gsang ba gsang sngags rdo rje thog 528

pa'i rtsa lhung bco brgyad/ snyi ba bzhi dang / sgom pa brgyad bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa sogs mdor na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba gang dag tshe rab ga sngon nas bsags zin pa dag dang / da lta'i tshe 'dir gsocig bzhin pa dang / skye ba phyi ma rnams su gsog par 'gyur ba sogs thams cad sa gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus par sel bar mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i ngo bo yin pa la/ 'gro ba'i don du rnam pa sman pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshul can 'gro mgon bla ma rje btsun mahwa gu ṇa dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i spyan sngar sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bur dmyal ba/ yi dgas/ dud 'gro bcas ngan 'gro ngan song gi sdug bsngal drag po la snying nas 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blos 'gyod sems chen pos sems kyi khongs nas mthol lo bshags so snyam pa'i sgo nas/ mi 'chab bo/ mi bad do/ mthol lo bshags/bzod par gsol nas dus da lta nyid du myur bar sbyangs shing dag par mdzad du gsol bsams par bya ba ste/ sdig pa bshags par byed pa'i rnam pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs yin/ de ltar legs par bshags pa'i blo drag pos zin pa de'i rjes su bdag gzhan sems can thams cad rtsa ba bdag 'dzin dang / gces 'dzin gnyis kyi kun nas blangs shing / ma rig 'khrul pa'i shes pa phyin ci log pa de'i dbang gis sgo gsum gyi sdig 529

pa'i phung po ri rab las kyang che ba dpag gis mi lang ba dag bsags pa yin/ des na phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed do snyam pa'i dam bca' bzung nas nyin re mi tshe'i nang du 'gro ba gzhan su la'ang phan pa bsgrub ma thub kyang / rtsa ba nas gnod pa dang 'tshe ba can cung zad chung du zhig yin kyang mi byed do sems par bya ba ni/ don ngo ma'i char nyams su len par byed pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos dang / yang sgos gso ba rig pa'i gzhung gi lag len man ngag gi snying po rnams thugs snying rje chen po'i tshul du bsgrim ste 'gro ba'i dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad dang bcas pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'i gso rig sman pa'i nyams len rtsa ba'i 'gal 'gangs che shos su gyur ba yin pas/ de ni sman pa sems bzang ngam sems skyed kyi bdag po zhig gi ngang nas sngar rang gi dgra bo zhig yin kyang / phyis su dgra bo de la na tsha byung ba'i skabs su de la phan pa gang thub bsgrub par byed par ma zad/ phyin chad de la gnod par byed pa'i sems ngan rigs kun nas spangs te lag tu len par gyur ba na/ de ni sdig pa bshags par byed pa'i skabs kyi nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs yin/ de ltar gong du sdig pa bshags par byed pa'i stobs gsum po rnams kyi mjug tu/ de nas slar yang bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa spus bris pa lta bu zhig la gsal gdab/ de nas 530

hūṃ yig de la oṃ badza sa sogs yig brgya bzlas pas/ hūṃ yig gi mthar gzungs sngags yi ge brgya pas yongs su bskor ba gyur bar bsams te gzungs sngags bzlas pas/ yi ge brgya pa dag nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros nas bla ma dang / yi dam/ sangs rgyas / byang sems/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi zhing khams rab 'byams mang por bzhugs pa rnams thugs dgyes par mdzad pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho lta bur gyur te/ de thams cad mchod cing gso la ba btab ste/ thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i ngos nas de bzhin bshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rang bzhin du 'phros nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kur thim/phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu 'dres par gyur/slar yang 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad la phog pas las ngan bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don gnyis yongs su grub par byas/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas ngag bzlas sam yid bzlas gang rung gis sgo nas yig brgya bzlas pas/thugs ga'i sa bon gyi hūṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa de la yi ge brgya pa'i 531

yig 'brus yongs su bskor bas/ bdud rtsi'i chab kyi rgyun 'dzad mtha' med par byung nas rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i steng spyi bo nas smad zhabs kyi mthe bong bar sku lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi khyab cing gang bar byas/ /bzhi pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba/zhabs g.yas kyi mthe sor nas sdig sgrib dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dri ma med pa babs te rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshangs pa'i bug gar brgyud de spyi bo'i nang zhugs te/ 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ de yang sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sul khu lta bu'i mdog nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad thams cad rnag dang khrag lta bu/ 'byung po'i gdon chen bco brgyad la sogs gdon thams cad sdig sgrul sbal cong srog chags kyi rnam pa lta bur lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga bye ba sa ya dang / skra yi nyag ma nyis khri chig stong dang / de bzhin dbang po'i sgo dgu sogs nas phyir chothon nas sa gzhi thams cad kha gas shing sa 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshen rje'i sar song bar dmigs/ rang gzhan sems can gyi spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lor bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag med zhugs te shel bum 'o mas gang ba bzhin 532

las kyi sgrib pa lus pa sbyangs shing dag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku yi byin rlabs thams cad rang gzhan rnams kyi lus la zhugs/ de nas sngags bzlas shing / yang spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i nang du bdud rtsi'i chab rgyun dpag tu med pa babs te/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs shing dag nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ma lus pa dag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad rang gzhan rnams kyi ngag la zhugs/ de nas sngags bzlas shing yang mgrin pa nas snying gar slebs nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung ste/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs zhing dag shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa dag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi yid la zhugs/ de nas sngags bzlas shing yang snying ga nas lte bar slebs nas lte bar sprul ba'i 'khor lor bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs shing dag bag chags kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa dag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsum thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ dbang bzhi bskur bar bsams te tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ngang du bzla bar bya'o/ /533

lnga pa/ mjug bsdu ba/de ltar brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bzlas mthar/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i snang ba dang rmi lam mtshan ma bzang po shar ba bcas 'byung ba 'gyur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ dus dang gnas skabs kun tu 'bad pa gang thub byed pa shin tu gal che/ de nas mthar thun bsdu ba ni oṃ mdza sa hūṃ/zhes brjod pas yig 'bru lnga po la 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha 'phros nas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu dang bu mo rnams kyi sdig sgrib bag chags nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs shing dag ces gsungs nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo'i rdor sems 'od du zhugs nas rang gzhan skye 'gro thams cad la thim/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gzhan sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang rang gzhan thams cad 'od du zhugs nas thugs ku'i au thim/ oṃ badza la thim/ badza sa la thim/ sa twa la thim/ twa hu gi zhabs kyu dang 'a chung ha la thim/ ha yig yang mgo bo'i zla tshes thig le la thim thig le yang nā da la thim/ nā da yang snang la rang bzhin med pa 'i stong pa zhi dbyings spros pa bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag de nas slar yang rim gyis 'od du zhugs nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par 534

dga' ba'i zhing khams su gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rgyal ba rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs su phra lam mer gsal btab nas/skyabs gnas bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /mi dge gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /zhes dang / yang / 'dod chags zhe snang gti mu ga dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma rdo rje sems 'grub gyur cig /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /khyed kyi sa la 'god par shog /ces dmigs med bsngo ba bzang po mtshams sbyar ba bcas mdzad par gyur na/tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams dag cing sbyangs pa ma zad/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyis sgo nas gsog bzhin pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba gang dag kyang nam yang 'phel bar mi 'gyur bar las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du mi 'gyur/ sa bcu lam lnga'i nyams rtogs khyad par can rnams kyang rang rgyud la myur du skye bar 'gyur ba sogs phan yon brjod kyis mi lang ba yod de/ snying po rgyan las/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhis/ /nyi shu tsam ni re rer bzlas/ /ltung sogs byin gyis rlabs 'gyur bas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyod par bya/ /'bum phrag 535 4

du ma bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes dang /rdza dpal sprul rin po ches/ sdig pa'i gnad 'di lta bu la brten nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thabs mkhas pa'i gnad kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rdzogs bsam gyis mi khyab yang skad cig ma re la rdzogs shing /nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can gyi don yang mnyam du sgrub nus pa yin/zhes gsungs nas zhal lung sogs gzhung gzhan du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par sbyor ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong byed par gsungs kyang / 'dir rje btsun g.yu thog mthong grol chen po'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab chos byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od phyi nang gsang gsum nyams su len pa'i zin bris dang sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas gnyis kyi tshul ltar/ yab rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas g.yas kyi mtheb sor nas bdud rtsi'i 'bebs sbyong byed pa'i lugs bzhin bkral ba yin// //536

le'u bco lnga pa/ku sa la'i tshogs bsags skor bshad pa/dang po/ ku sa la'i go don/drug pa ku sa li'i tshogs bsags ces bya ba ni/ nor rdzas ci yang med pa'i sprang po'i tshul gyis nang sems kyi dmigs rim zab mo la brten nas phyi rang lus mchod sbyin du phul nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po kho ne gsog pa'i slad du yin/ de lta bu'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa la/ lus kyi mchod sbyin zhes rang rang so so'i dngas ma dang / khrag sha/ tshil/ rus/ rkang / khu ba bcas las grub pa'i lus kyi phung po mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa byed de bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas sems nyid dmigs pa chen po'i bsgom stobs la brten nas rang lus mchod sbyin gyi rgya mtsho chen por spros te mgron rigs bzhi la 'bul bar byed pa zhig yin/ de yang phyi rang byung khams kyi khor yug 'di dang / rang byung khams 'di na mnga' ba'i dngos po'i dpal yon ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad nang bcud kyi 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi rtag tu gces par 'dzin pa'i lus sems kyi phung po 'di 537

nyid bde ba 'dod pa dang / skyed par 'dod pa/ tshe ring bar 'dod pa/nad med par 'dod pa sogs don du longs su spyod par byed pa sha stag yin/ de ltar dngos po gzhan las mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa'i rang gi phung po 'di nyid lus kyi mchod sbyin bzang po zhig tu yongs su bsgyur te dbul bar byed nus na/ phyi ru 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzhan las kyang ches mchog tu phan yon che bar ma zad/ tshogs gnyis kyi stobs kyang lhag par rab tu rdzogs par byed pa'i dge mtshan chen po ldan yod pa yin/kun bzang zhal lung las gsungs pa bzhin ji skad du/ rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin/ /bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin/ /lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na yin te/ dper na/ grub pa'i skyes mchog chen po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa ni/ phyi dngos po'i nor rdzas gzhan ci yang med pa'i ri khrod 'grims pa'i bya bral blos btang gi dbul po lta bu zhig yin kyang / khong sgrib gnyis sbyangs shing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthar 'gran zla bral ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan tog ltar bod gangs can gyi ljongs su mngon par yongs su bsal ba'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur ba yin/ des na rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gsog par byed pa la phyi dngos po'i 'dod yon longs spyod ni gtso bo ma yin zhing / nang sems 538

kyi gting nas gzhan mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba sems can dpag tu med pal phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa zhig skrun thub pa'i phyir/ rang nyid theg chen byang chub kyi lam du zhugs nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi bdag nyid can zhig tu 'gyur thub pa kho na'i ched du yin pas/ de lta bu thob par byed pa ni gtso bo nang sems kyi snying stobs dang yon tan rgya che chung kho na la rag lus pa zhig yin pa gong gi dpe mtshon gcig pu kho na'i steng nas gsal por rtogs thub pa zhig kyang yin/ /gnyis pa/ ku sa la'i tshogs gsog gi dmigs rim dngos/mdun mkhar bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po la/ /mgron rigs bzhi bskor sprin phung gtibs ltar bzhugs/ /rang sems dbyings thon rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa'i sku ru gyur/ /ben po'i thod pa phyag g.yas gri gug gis/ /bregs te rang byung thod pa'i skyed bur btsugs//de nang sha rus til 'bru tsam du bsil/ /me rlung sbyar bas zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /nam mkha'i khyon gang mchod sprin zad mi shes/ /mgyon rigs so so'i bzhes rgur 'char bar gyur/ /zhes rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma 'dam bzhi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ngo bo dbyer med pa'i byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mtshungs med 539

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gro mgon rje btsun mahā gu na zhal gcig phyag gnyis sman pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshul can sku mdog dkar po 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na lhang nger gsal zhing zhugs pa'i steng du rtsa ba dang rgyud pa'i bla ma bzhugs/ g.yas su yi dam stag phag yab yum sogs dngos sgrub kyi rtsa ba yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs rnams zhugs pa/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba sogs 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba dpa' bo'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams zhugs pa dang / rtsa gsum rigs 'dus kyi lha tshogs spyi dang rig 'dzin sman gyi lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas zhugs pa de'i mthar skor du/ rnam mkhyen byang chub kyi lam sgrub pa'i phyir 'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba'i dpal mgon gyi dam pa chos skyong srung ma mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs sman srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor nas zhugs pa/ mdun du nyam thag la rgan 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sa gzhi chen po'i rdul ltar mnyam par grangs med dpag tu med par bsams pa/ rgyab tu sde brgyad 'byung po la sogs pa'i lan chags ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad mgron rigs bzhi po dag gis yongs su bskor cing / sprin gyi phung po rab tu gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par bsgoms/ de ltar mgron rigs bzhi po phra lam mer gsal ba'i ngang nas rang gi lus po 'di nyid da lta'i lus po 'di dang mi 'dra bar che ba ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam tu yid kyis sprul bar 540

byas te/ lus po de la brten pa'i rten pa rang sems kyi ngo bo de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin par bsam ste phaḍa zhes brjod de rtsa dbu ma'i rlung brgyud de spyi bo tshangs pa'i bug ga nas steng du yang mkha' dbyings su phyir thon par gyur te rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba kun gyi yul gyur bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar rab tu 'bar ba spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du gzigs pa'i skur bsgyur/ de ltar rang sems phyir ton rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgyur zin pa'i sha khrag gdod bcas kyi phung po mar bskyel ba de'i bem po'i thod pa rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug gis legs par bregs te/ phyag g.yon pas bzung nas rang byung sprul pa'i snang ba las byung ba thod pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa sprul de mi mgo'i skyed bu chen po gsum gyi steng du btsugs te/ de nang lus kyi sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa til 'bru tsam gyi ngo bor bsil bar byas te/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha gsum rab tu 'phros te/ thod pa'i steng du oṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa bdud brtsi'i rang bzhin thod pa'i 'og tu ā yig dmar po dri ma med pa 'byung ba me yi rang bzhin/ mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi mtha' skor du hūṃ yig sngon po dri ma med pa dag cing gsal ba 'byung ba rlung gi rang bzhin can zhig tu 541

gyur te/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ zhes brjod lan gsum brjod pas/ yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros te oṃ gyi kha dog dri snod kyi skyon sbyangs/ yos bdud rtsi'i rtog par byas/ hūṃ gyis mang po 'bar zhing spel bar gyur te zag med bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsgyur ma thag tu rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i spyan zung gi gzigs pa'i lta stangs tsam gyis hūṃ yig sngon rlung gi rang bzhin can gyis rlung rab tu g.yos/ ā yig dmar po me bzhin can gyis rab tu me 'bar ba byas/ de ltar yig 'bru gnyis kyi rlung g.yos/ me 'bar zung 'jug gi tshul du thod pa'i nang gi rdzas sha phrag sogs kyi rdzas rnams rib kyi bzhu par byas/ mthar oṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa de yang rim gyis bzhu bar byas te/ zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas/ mjug tu ma dag mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyi ngo bo rnams phyir rlangs pa'i tshul du thon de yal bar byas/ gang snang ba thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur te phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin byas/nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes pa'i ngo bor bsams te/ mgron rigs bzhi po rang rang so so'i gang 'dod bzhes rgu'i rnam par 'char bar gyur/ /542

gsum pa/ ku sa la'i mchod sprin 'bul tshul/thugs las mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med spros/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum srid zhu'i mgron rnams la/ /gus pas 'bul lo tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shog /dpal mgon chos skyong yon tan mgron rnams la/ /'bul lo las dang dngos grub 'grub par mdzod/ /'gro ba rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal kun zhi bde ldan shog /sde brgyad 'byung po lan chags mgron rnams la/ /bsngos pas zhi ba byang chub sems ldan shog /ces de ltar mgron rigs so so'i bzhes rgur 'char ba dang sbrags rang nyid rdo rje rnam la 'byor ma'i thugs ku'i bam yig las 'od zer dpag med 'phros te/ mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa spros te mdun du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas su sku mdog ser po/ rgyab tu sku mdog dmar po/ g.yon tu sku mdog ljang khu can sogs zhi sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rnam par sprul te/ bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro sogs dkon mchog rtsa gsum sri zhu'i mchod yul gong ma rnams la bde stong gi mchod pa gus pa chen pos 'bul zhing las kyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs shing tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs pa gyur snyam pa dang / de nas dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs dam can chos skyong yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la 'bul zhing / rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma'i byang chub kyi lam sgrub pa'i 543

las dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad do snyam/ de nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i nyam thag ma rgan 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la rang rang so so'i skal pa dang mnyam pa'i sna mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhi ru gyur te/ tsha dmyal la gnas pa'i sems can rnams bsil bar byed/ grang dmyal la gnas pa'i sems can rnams dro bar byed/ yi dgas kyi sems can rnams bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las grol bar byed/ dud 'gro'i rigs rnams rmongs pa las grol bar byed/ lha yi tshogs rnams tshe ring gi sdug bsngal las thar bar byed / lha ma yin rnams 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal las grol bar byed/ mi rnams skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las yongs su thar nas bde ba dang ldan par gyur bar shog snyam pa dang / de nas mthar sde brgyad 'byung po sogs snang srid kyi lha 'dre spyi dang / lhag par lan chags kyi rigs su gyur ba'i mgron rnams la snying rje'i bsam pas legs par bsngos pas zhi ba byang chub kyi sems rgyud la rab tu ldan par gyur snyam ste dmigs pa dang bcas ngag nas lan grangs 'ga' shas 'don par bya'o/ /bzhi pa/ mjug bsdu tshul/kun kyang rigs drug bla ma'i ye shes kyis/ /sgyu 'phrul rol par ci 544

yang snang ba ste/ /lus kyi mchod sbyin phul bas dgyes shing tshims/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /rang sems 'khrul pas bsgribs pa'i gzhan dbang las/ /kun brtags gnyis su snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /gdod nas mi dmigs spros bral nam mkha' ltar/ /yongs sgrub de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su ā/ /zhes mthar de ltar gong du lus kyi mchod sbyin zag med bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'bul bar byed pa'i phyi nang gi snang ba gang ci shar ba thams cad rtsa gsum rigs 'dus bla ma'i ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa kho na las yongs su ma 'das pas/ mgron rigs bzhi po rnams dgyes shing rab tu tshims par mdzad cing tshogs rgya chen po gang dag bsags pa de'i mthus 'gro ba rigs drug sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun gyi 'dam las legs par grol bar shog snyam ste/ 'gro ba sems can dpag med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol thabs kyi phan sems rgya cher skyed de/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pas kun nas blangs/mjug bsngo bas legs par mtshams sbyar te mthar lus kyi mchod sbyin bzang po phul tshar ba'i skabs su rang sems lta ba'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog par byed pa de gal chen stabs/ rang sems zhes bya ba de ni rig pa ye shes kyi ngo bo gsal rig gi cha la ma dag pa ci yang med cing dag pa kho na yin kyang / rang nyid las dang nyon yongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba phyin chad la bde ba med cing sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin 545

las ye nas ma 'das par song / rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ngor glo bur dri mas yongs su sbags te bsgribs pa yin/ de ltar las nyon gyi sgrib pas glo bur bsgribs pa las ma shes shing ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis don dam du dngos po'i gnas tshod la chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid gyis grub pa ci yang med par ma zad/ bdag gzhan la sogs pa rnams kyang chos gcig rang gis ngo bos rang rkya 'pher ba'i tshul du grub pa ci yang med par brten/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad dus kyi gdod ma nyid nas mi dmigs spros pa'i mtha' tha dag dang bral ba snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nam mkha' ltar gnyis su med par snang bas sgra rtog mtshan ma sogs dmigs pa kun dang bral ba don dam lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya ba bcas so// //546

dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi bdag por nges pa'i brdar glegs bam dang ral gris mtshan pa/ g.yon pa 'od gsal lhan cig skye ba'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du bstan pa'i brdar thugs kur chos mchad phyag rgyas pad sdong bsnams pa/ snyan gyi thad kur chu skyes 'dab ma rab tu bzhad pa'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gur kum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa la/ nor bu dbang rgyal dang / gser rdor/ sman mchog a ru bcas kyis g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa ste/ bum pa ni ngo bo rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ de bzhin du nor bu rgyal ba rin 'byung / gser rdor rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ a ru ra rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad/ kha rgyan gur kum ste rgyal ba don grub dang bcas pa rgyal ba rigs lnga ye shes lnga zhes me long ye shes/ chos dbyings ye shes/ bya sgrub ye shes/ sor rtogs ye shes/ mnyam nyid ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i brda dang / mchog mthun 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i brdar sku la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba ste/phyi ru sman pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i rten gyi tshul du na bza' dar dkar po lhab lhug tu gsol ba/ bar du so sor thar pa'i rten du dar dmar po'i na bza' bzhes pa/ nang du gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sngags kyi rten du dar sngon po'i na bza' bsnams pa/ thugs zag med rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes la 'pho 'gyur med pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams 548

cad zil gyis mnon pa'i brdar zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung du bzhugs pa la 'khor gyi lha mo bzhis bskor ba ste/ mdun gyi padma'i 'dam mar lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang sgyur ba/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar lha mo ser mo bya rgod kyi rkang gling sgyur ba/ rgyab kyis 'dab mar lha mo dmar mo mi rkang gi gling bu sgyur ba/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar lha mo ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long bstan pa de rnams bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dar la bab pa 'dzum sgeg 'gying bag mdzes shing mnyen lcug 'khril ldem rked par rin po che'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan te/ dbu skra lcang lo sil ma mu tig dmar po'i lan tshar dang bcas pa/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol bas gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo'i bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang la bde stong gi mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'bul zhing bzhugs par bsam/ gzhan yang steng phyogs su byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mthar thug drin can rtsa ba dang rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun thugs kyi thad du dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dpal dbang chen rta phag yab yum la sogs yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug dang / mdun du dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyi dang / khyad par ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mnyam med shakya seng ges gcos sman bla bde bar gshegs mched brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i mtha' bskor du 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'a gro dpal ldan phreng ba la sogs 549

dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs dang / lhag par ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos sman gyi srung mar bka' bgos pa'i rgyan 'dzin dang gsang 'dzin checho sogs gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po bcu gnyis dang / zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sde dgu sogs sman srung dam can rgya mtsho/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams/ ca da du sman gyi drang srong lha mor bcas pa'i rig 'dzin sman gyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs ma lus pa mkha' dbyings su gza' dang skar ma bkra ba lta bur bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang mdor na sku snang la rang bzhin me da pa'i 'ja' dang 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong du bzhugs shing / mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo mang pos rdo rje'i glu gar rol mo sogs mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa brjod du med pa spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchod de bskor ba bsams te/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i ri mo bzhin spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par rang gi mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su phra lam mer gsal gdab ste/ rab yangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba'i dbus/ /sman rgyal dbyer med gu ṇa'i zhabs/ /zhi 'dzum 'gro la chags pa'i nyams/ /dbu skra lcang lo me tog spras/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin uta la'i/ /yu ba nas bzung snyan gyi thad/ /bye ba'i steng du glegs ral mtshan/ /g.yon pa chos 'chad bad sdong gi/ /rtsa ba nas bzung 'dam ma rnams/ /snyan gyi thad kur rgyas pa'i steng / /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa la/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i 550

kha rgyan dang / /nor bu gser rdor a ru ra/ /g.yas g.yon dbus su rnam par mtshan/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' can/ /rdo rje dkyil kyung gis bzhugs pa'i/ /'dab bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang gi/ /lha mo pi wang bya rgod dang / /mi rkang gling bu me long 'dzin/ /mdzes sdug rgyan ldan lang tsho rgyas/ /bde stong rab rgyas mchod pa 'bul/ /gzhan yang rtsa gsum chos srung bcas/ /ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ /zhes rtsa gsu ma rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs shing rnam par bsal ba legs par bsgoms par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ spyan 'dren/de ltar gong du bsal btabs pa'i tshogs shing gi lha tshogs rnams spyan 'dren par bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas//dus gsum rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /thugs rje'i spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcos ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes snying gi khongs nas gsol ba drag tu btab ste thal mor sbyar nas phyogs 551

dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa nyi ma 'char kha'i rdul ltar dpag tu med pa byon nas mdun gyi tshogs shing rten la ye shes dam tshig pa rnams dbyer med du thim par gyur bsams te/ mos gus kyi gdung ba drag tu skyes par byas te/ de nas tshogs lam gyi yon tan skad cig la rang rgyud du zlum pa'i thabs khyad par can gyi phyir spyir yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bya'o/ /gsum pa/ spyir yan lag bcu pa 'bul tshul//tī/ bla ma yi dam mkha' spyan 'dren gshegs/ /seng khri pad sdong nyi zla'i snyeng du bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus pas rtag phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ /nyes ltung nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rangs/ /gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bzhin du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes gang bsags byang chub bsngo/ /mkhor ba dong sprugs bde chen mchog 'thob shog /ces pa ste/ bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal gyi tshogs shing las/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pa las las 552

ngan sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag par bsams pa ni nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi gnyen po yin zhing / de'i phan yon yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa dag gong las shes par bya/ /bzhi pa/ bla na yod pa dang bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'bul tshul/dngos 'byor lha mi'i dpal 'byor mchod pa me tog sogs phyi mchod dang / sman rag sogs nang mchod/ byang sems dkar dmar bde stong zhu bde'i 'bar 'dzag sogs gsang ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad dang / bla na med pa'i mchod par 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin las sprul pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rnam par thar pa las byung ba ni gong na med pa'i mchod pa de gnyis kyis phyogs rnams kun tu bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dag thugs dgyes shing / ma 'gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag grol ba'i phyir du 'bul ba ni ser sna'i gnyen po yin/ de'i phan yon yang / pad dkar las/ me tog gcig tsam gyis kyang mchod pa yang / /bde gshegs sku gzugs rtsig nges bris pa la/ /lus 'khrugs bzhin du sems kyi phul ba na/ /de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong / /zhes dang / mdo sde bskal bzang 553

las/ kyang / tsam pa ka yi me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs skyed do/ /zhes gang zhig gis mchod yul rgyal ba gong ma rnams la me tog chung du gcig tsam phul na yang / mthar 'bras bu rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po nyid kyang skyed par byed pa'i rgyur 'gro ba sogs yod cing / tha na phyi ma yi dgas dang mi dbul yongs bcas su mi skye ba'i phan yon grangs las 'das so/ /lnga pa/ bshags pa 'bul tshul/rang gzhan rnams kyi dus tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung rgyu nyon mongs dug gsum gyi kun nas bslangs pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs rang gis bgyis pa dang / gzhan la bskul ba/ mi dge ba la rjes su yi rangs pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga / mi dge ba bcu/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags sogs kyi rtsa ba dang / yan las gi bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i rigs ci mchis pa dag gnyen po stobs bzhi'i tshang ba'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar/ nongs 'gyod drag pos bshags pa phul ba ni/ gti mug gi gnyen por 'gro ba yin te/ yum nyi khri las/ gang gi dran pa'i mod la ni/ /sdig pa dran pas 'gyod pa yis/ /bshags pa thams cad mdzad pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i sras pos 554

phyis sdoms shig /ces dang / kun bzang zhal lung las/ gong du smos zin pa bzhin spyir sdig pa la yon tan med kyang bshags pas dag pa ni sdig pa'i yon tan yin/ zhes gsungs pa kho na yin te/ gal te bshags pas ma dag na khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ro/ /drug pa/ rjes su yi rangs ba /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa rnam par dag pa dang nyan thos rang rgyal sogs kyi bslab ba'i tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / so so'i skye bo rnams kyi rnam dkar dge ba'i bya ba gang byas pa mtha' dag la yid dga' 'gur spyad de rjes su yi rang bsgom pa ni phrag dog gi gnyen po yin/ de'i phan yon ni sngon 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur zhabs tog tshad med zhus pa'i tshe/ mi dbul po gcig gis mthong bas rgyal pos gang min tshad kyi mchod pa rgya chen chen po phul ba de la snying nas rjes su yi rang bsgoms pas rgyal po dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams thob pa rgyal bas gsungs/ yang rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 'bad pa chung ngus rlabs chen tshogs sdud la//dge la rjes su yi rang mchog tu gsungs/ /zhes nang bsam blo'i khyer so 555

yag po zhig na byung na/ bya sla la rlabs che ba zhig gi dge tshogs bsgrub nus pa yin/ rang cag bod gangs can chos ldan zhing gi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis zhing du rgyal ba sman gyi bla dang dbyer med 'gro mgon rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa nyag cig ni gzhan phan gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi kho na yin pas/gdams pa zab mo 'di dag gi gzhung lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi nyams su len par mdzad pa'i 'tsho byed sman pa su zhig gis 'gro ba nad pa'i gzhan don rlabs chen bskyangs dang skyong bzhin yod pa la sems kyi gting nas de la rjes su yi rang ba bsgom par bya ba ni shin tu gal che zhing / gal te rjes su yi rang ba byed ma nus kyang nyam thag 'gro ba'i nad pa'i mgon skyabs gcig pur gyur ba'i tshe yi rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la nyon mongs kyis kun nas blangs te phrag dog gi rigs gtan nas byed mi rung ba gal 'gangs che/ /bdun pa/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba/rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams grangs kyis mi lang ba dag na/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos mi gsungs shing mnyam par 'jog ste phyogs gang na su bzhugs rnams la bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don 556

du khams dang mos pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sems can dag gi phyir gang la gang 'dul gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing gsol ba ste/ lus 'bum phrag sa ya bye ba mang por sprul nas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa dag phul ba bsams pa ni 'dod chags kyi gnyen po yin/sngon ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshe zhal nas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi'i lta bu'i chos shig kho bos bsnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags 'dab khrod na gnas par bya/ /zhes dgongs te zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi ring chos mi gsungs par bzhugs pa la lha'i dbang po brgya sbyin gyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor te gdul dka'i zhing 'di'i sems can grangs med smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ de yang rten 'brel bstod pa las/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang yin/ /zhes ston pa'i mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang ches mchog tu gyur ba ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di nyid yin zhes gsungs so/ /brgyad pa/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ma lus na sku 'tsho zhing bzhengs 557

pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad ji srid 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po ma stong bar du de srid bstan dang 'gro ba'i phyir du bstan 'gro'i mun sel gyi sgron me mdzad de bzhugs su gsol ba 'debs pa ni log lta'i gnyen po yin/ de'i phan yon yang mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab ba na de'i bsod nams ni khyad par 'phags pa yin gsungs so/ /dgu pa/ dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba /rang bzhan sems can thams cad 'das ma 'ongs pa lta dus gsum du bsags dang gsog bzhin gsog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyin pa gtong ba/ tshul khrims srung ba/ bzod pa bsgom pa/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa/ bsam gtan bsgom pa sogs gang dag ci rigs pa'i chos rnams thams cad dngos po'i gnas tshod la gtan nas med cing rang ngos nas grub rdul phran tsam yang med par rang bzhin gyis stongs kyang kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i snang ngor btags yod kyi dge rtsa thams cad 'khor gsum yongs dag gis rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du bla na med par bsngo ba ni the tshom lung ma bstan gyi gnyen po yin pas/ de'i phyir chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis rtsis zin par byas te ma rgan mtha' yas pa'i sems 558

can thams cad sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs te dag pa chos gzugaṅge gnyis kyi sku mngon du byas nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po dong nas sprugs te/ 'pho 'gyur zag pa med pa'i gyur med bde chen ye shes chen po'i go 'phang ci nas kyang 'thob par smon pa ni smon lam khyad par can gyi yongs su rgyas 'theb par bya ba ni shin tu gal che ste/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shog /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis 'thob par shog /ces gsungs so/ /bcu pa/ phan yon/ shes springs las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che na chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi zad/ /ji ltar byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang //byang chub ma 'thob bar du de mi zad/ /ces dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang chu yi thigs pa gcig tsam blugs na yang / mtha' yas pa'i rgya mtsho ma skem bar du chu yi thegs pa yang mi zad pa de bzhin gang gis kyang byang chub mchog tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir bsngo ba'i smon lam khyad par can ni byang chub chen po'i go 'phang ma thob bar du chud zad par mi 'gyur ro/ de ltar mdo lugs spyi la yan lag bdun pa 'bul 559

srol che na yang myur lam gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la yan lag tsho brgyad dang bcu sogs 'bul tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/ skabs 'dir rje btsun g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i gdam pa zab mo nyams su len tshul la yan lag bcu ba'i tshul du nyams bzhes mdzad de skal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags dgos na'ang / gang zag dbang po shin tu rnon po'i dbang du byas te skal pa mang po'i tshogs dus skad cig re re la zlum par nus pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam zab rgyas sngags kyi gdams pa nyams su bzhes te mthar sku gzugs gang tshang 'ja' lus 'od kyi gong bur mngon du gyur te/ dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan par mdzad do/ de yang tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang mi rmongs shing / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / rje blo bzang grags pas/ sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg /ces gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ni rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di dang mthar sangs rgyas mos pa'i skabs la ma gtogs bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis 'jig rten du byon yang / sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags pa 'di mi 'byung bas dokar gsungs/ bzhi pa bzlas dmigs ni/ de ni rtsa gsum rigs 'du se smon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyi dang / khyad 560

par rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin yid la dran te dad 'dun spro ba chen po'i ngang nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin chen 'di dag 'don par bya'o/ / brtsug pa/ sman gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/'gro la phan bzhes thugs rjes rab bskrun pa'i/ /spang rtogs skyob pa mchog bsnyes lha yi lha/ /rten 'byung gtam gyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i//thub dbang smra ba'i nyi mor mgos phyag 'tshal/ /(dang po ston pa thub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs dgos pas/ rgyud 'debs 'di 7gong sa 7 skyabs mgon chen po'i gsung byin rlabs can yin pas zur du bsgrigs/snyigs dus lnga brgya'i nyam thag grol ba'i slad/ /yangs pa can du bcom ldan gdan 'dzoms mdzad/ /sman bla bde gshegs mched brgyad lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba ma lus pa/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsaXli ba'i phyir/ /mchog gi spul sku sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /bde gshegs sman gyi bla mar ga sol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rnam sprul rig pa'i ye shes dang / /rgyud bzhi'i zhu gsol chen po yid las skyes//rgyun shes bu dang 'tsho byed gzhon nu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan 561

phan snang ba stsol/ /thub bstan shing rta chen po klu sgrub mgon/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son ma khol dang / /gnas lnga rig pa zla ba mngon dga' la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /theg chen mdo sngags spyi dang gso dpyad kyi/ /dri med lugs zung gdams ngag mdzod 'dzin pa/ /'phags yul grub chen paṇa chen brgya bcu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/kun bzang chos rgyal mtho ri gnyan btsan dus/ /'phags yul drang srong bi byi dga' byed byon/ /de'i sras bla sman dung gi thor lcog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/gang de'i thugs sras blo gros chen mo dang / /de'i sras sman pa glo gros mtshungs med sogs/ /rigs rgyud gnang ba rigs kyi sman pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ //khro bos gsar du bsgrigs/gangs ljongs chos srid bstan 'gro'i nyin gcig pu/ /rmad byung thugs skyed spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos/ /rgyal bas lung bstan srong btsan sgam po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs)gangs ljongs skye dgu'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /rigs gzhung brda dag gso dpyad gtan la phab/ /bka' drin mtshungs bral 'jam dbyangs thon mi la//gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ //kho bos gsar du bsgrigs )srid pa'i rims nad tsha gdung 'drung 'a༄byin phyir/ /ris med 'gro la sman 562

gyi gzhung lugs spel/ /rjes sbyangs las goms 'tsho byed rgyud pa la//gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/mdo sngags zung 'jug rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyal ba sman bla rig 'dzin pad ma 'byung / /mkhas chen zhi 'tsho chos rgyal khri srong la//gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gso dpyad gdams pa'i mdzod/ /ma nor lam bzang yang dag tshad mar bsgyur/ /u rgyan dngos mnyam bee ro tsa na la//gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs)phyi nang mkhas dgu gdan 'dzom gso dpyad spel/ /dpal ldan rgyud bzhi bka' gter gnyis su sbas/ /sman rgyal rnying ma yon tan mgon po la//gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/gangs can mig gcig bee ro tsā na'i zhabs/ /chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog dpal/ /zab gter sgo 'byed gra pa mngon shes la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /gang de'i thugs sras dar ma grags pa dang / /tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa dkon mchog skyabs/ /'ja' lus mngon gyur rje btsun g.yu thog par/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus g.yu thog rje/ /rta phag yab yum dpal ldan phreng ba'i zhabs/ /rtsa gsum sman gyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /(kho bos gsar du 563

bsgrigs)snang srid chos kun gnas lugs mthar thug gzigs/ /g.yu thog snyan rgyud thig le'i gdams ngag bzung / /'dzin mkhas rgyal sras sum ston ye zung la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /(kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/ skye bar snying thig mnga' bdag ye shes gzungs/ /dri med lugs 'dzin gzhon nu ye shes dang / /gzhan phan gter 'byung g.yu thog 'bum seng la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /byang chub sems kyis bdud rtsi sman du blangs/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog sgrol mas rjes su bzungs/ /bka' gdams rdo bo 'gron ston yab sras la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/tshul 'dir mkhas grub buddha rata ṇa'i mtshan/ /rig byed mang thos don grub rin chen dang / /don kun grub pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /tshig don gsal byed dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan mnga' dpal ldan 'tsho byed zhabs/ /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dbang phyug grags/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /nges don mngon gyur rig 'dzin phun tshogs bzang / /mkhas grub zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs//lag len mthar phyin rje btsun tshe 'bum par/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba rtsol/ /byar po paṇa chen zla ba'i dbang po dang / /ri lding glo bzang rgya mtsho byang ngos pa/ /bstan 'dzin dar rgyas blo bzang rgya 564

mtsho'i 'bas/ /gsol ba 'angebs so ga'an phan stang ba stsol/ /ngag dbang don grub blo mchog rdo rje dang / /kun mkhyen lnga pa gang shar rang grol rtsal/ /ngag dbang gzhon nu stod lung chos kyi rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /ngag dbang chos ldan bla dga' don grub dang / /khyab bdag rdo rje rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /lung rig rgya mtsho mkhas btsun rdo rje grags/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol// sgrub pa mthar phyin 'jigs med 'phrin las dpal/ /sman rtsis bstan pa rgyas mdzad gzhan phan gter/ /bka' drin mtshungs med mkhyen rab nor bu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i lam/ /ches cher gsal mdzad gangs can bstan 'gro'i mgon/ /phyag na padmo bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ (mde dgu mkhyen brtse rin po ches bskul ba'i ngor 7gong sa mchog gi gsung byin dngos yin gsung yin pas zur du bsgrigs//theg chen mdo sngags thar lam gsal byed phyir/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad lung khrid chos kyi rje/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ //kho bos gsar du bsgrigs/rgyal bstan bshad dang sgrub pas 'dzin pa la/ /chags thogs bral ba mkha' la nyin byed bzhin/ /'phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba sgrol ba'i rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol//(4spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos yar 'brog stag lung rtse sprul rin 565

po che bshad sgrub nyin 'byed 'phrin las dpal bzang por zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'chi med bcud spungs las btus pas/ skabs 'dir so so'i dbang lung 'khrid gsum zhu ba'i bla ma de la rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zur du 'don na chog)skabs gsum pa dang phyi nang drang srong 'khor/ /'chi med tshe yi rig pa 'dzin la sogs/ /gnang rigs rjes sbyangs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho gang /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /dngos grub 'dod dgu'i dpal ster yi dam lha/ /mthun rkyen kun sgrub chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs//khyad par chos 'di'i bka' srung zhang sgron la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /mi mthun 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i las dbang gis//nyam thug nad kyis gtses pa'i skye bo kun/ /lus sems bde bar bskyed pa'i bdu rtsi la/ /mi zad longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /ro nus zhu rjes mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar/ /mthun par bsdebs pa'i tsha grang 'dus pa yi/ /nad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i ba dan che/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs sman gyis rlung mkhris bad kun dang / /'dus pa'i nad kun 'joms pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rang gzhan 'khor bar ltung byed drag po'i nad/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod par byin gyi rlobs/ /'gro mgon gu ṇa'i snying thig gdams pa'i mdzod//nyams su bstar bas ma bcos rang gi sems/ /bde chen chos kyi 'khor ༄ 566

lor ngo 'phrod nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lhag bsam kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las 'ongs pa'i/ /rlabs chen smon lam ma dros klung chen gyis/ /gso rig bstan pa'i nor 'dzin kun khyab nas//gzhan phan nor bu'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di nyid kyi mjug gi brgyud rim gsar bsgrigs su kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seng ges mdzad pa la gzhir bzhag steng cung zad kho bos kha skong byas pa bcas so/ /brtsus pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs rim dngos/mtshams 'dir bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i bka' drin yid la dran te rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dang / rigs 'dus sman rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor la gong gi maṇḍal 'bul tshul ltar rgyas bsdus gang rung gis sgo nas maṇḍal dbul te/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas ma rgan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu btab ste/ bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i spyi bo'i gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros te mdun gyi lha mo dkar mo la phog bla ma'i mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros te rgyab kyi lha mo dmar mo la phog bla ma'i thugs ku'i gnas nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros te 567

g.yon gyi lha mo ljang mo la phog bla ma'i lte ba'i gnas nas 'od zer ser po 'phros te g.yas kyi lha mo ser mo la phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul te zhi byas dbang drag gi las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub ste gang 'dod mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar bsams/ snying po gang mang bzlas/ slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur 'phros te phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ma lus pa na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la thugs mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrig sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs mkhas thugs rje'i chen po'i rang bzhin las sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin kyi byin chen ma lus pa 'od zer kha dog dkar ser sngo dmar ljang khu'i rnam par brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi dngas ma phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du thim ste/ na bar med par smanagyi bdud rtsi/ 'chi ba med par tshe yi bdud rtsi/ zag pa med par ye shesakyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pas bum pa gang / de nyid yar lud de rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga rgyud lus kyi nang du chi li lir babs pas/ tshe rabs 'khor ma thog ma med pa nas da bar bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rang gzhan gyi lus shel bum g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ slar rim gyis lus thams cad bdud rtsi ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob/568

sgrib bzhi dag sku bzhi mngon du gyur ba byas bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus chen po'i sgo nas sems gzhan du ma g.yeng bar rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ oṃ āḥshā mahwa gurā sarba saṃ ddhi hūṃ dzaḥ de wa ḍakki ni ha ri ni sa tsi ṅka hring hring sa ma yadzaḥ / baṃ hoḥ zhes dmigs pa dang bcas mang du bzla bar bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa/ dbang bzhi len tshul/dbang bzhi len tshul ni 'di lta ste/ de ltar bla ma'i sku'i gnas nas oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros te bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i nang zhugs/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku bum pa'i dbang thob/bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ skye ba sprul sku mngon du byas/ lus la bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis khyab par byas/ de nas snying po bzlas shing / bla ma'i gsung gi gnas nas spu yig dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros te bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang zhugs/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas/ mchog tu dga' 569

ba rgyud la skyes/ de nas sngags bzlas shing bla ma'i thugs ku'i gnas nas hūṃ yig sngon po las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros te bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang zhugs/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ ye shes chos sku mngon du byas/ khyad par gyi dga' ba rgyud la skyes/ slar yang bla ma'i sku gsum thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum cig car du 'phros te rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la thim/ sgo gsum cha snyogs kyi sdig sgrib dag tshig dbang rin po che thob/ bla ma'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ ngo bo nyid du mngon du byas/lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba rgyud la skyes par mos/slar bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa rang gzhan gyi spyi bor mgrin pa snying ga lte bar zhugs nas nyon sgrib/ chags sgrib/ thog sgrib/ las kyi sgrib pa bcas sgrib bzhi bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ sprul sku bcas sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du byas/ gzhi ma dag pa'i phung po lnga po dag pa ye rishes lnga ldan gyi bdag nyid du 'gyur bsam par mos te bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi snying po gang mang bzlas/ /570

bcu bzhi pa/ mthar tshogs zhing 'od du 'thim tshul/ de nas rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mtha' nas rim bzhin du 'od du zhugs nas gtso bo'i bla ma la thim/bla ma sman rgyal bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyang che ba ri rab tsam dang / chung ba dul phra rab tsam gyi rnam pa grangs kyi mi lang bas gang zhing / rten dang brtan pa thams cad rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor gyur te/ snying po gang 'tshams bzlas/ slar bla ma yang 'od kyi phung 'khrigs pa'i klong na rang gzhan gyi spyi bor zhugs nas bla ma'i sku dang mtshan bzang dpe byad rang gzhan gyi lus dbyer med du gyur/rim bzhin mgrin pa'i nang du zhugs/ bla ma'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang rang gzhan gyi ngag dbyer med du gyur/ rim bzhin snying gar zhugs/ bla ma'i thugs kun mkhyen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang rang gzhan gyi yid dbyer med du gyur bar bsam ste/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag sogs snying gar pad zlu'i steng du bzhugs/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzungs te/ /ji srid snying po'i bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab te snying ga'i 'dab brgyad twa lha'i dbus su zhabs son 'od chags g.yo med brtan par bzhugs so gsol te/ mthar sngags phreng 571
