gi bskor bar byas te dus gsum rgyal kun gsang ba gcig sdud pa/ /bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog pa/ /snying khong dus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs pa dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ / zhes mos gus gdung shugs drag po gsol ba lan gsum btab ste/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med chu la chu bzhag lta gur gyur bar bsams/ 'od bsal de nyid je phra je phrar song nas rang sems dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur/ /bco lnga pa/ mthar lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog tshul/rang sems de yang gdod nas ma grub par mtshan rtog dmigs pa kun dang bral zhing 'khor 'das kyi chos kun ma lus pa dbyer med don dam ro mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du spros bral chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa na don dam gyi gnas lugs rtogs shing / rang zhal bla ma'i ngo bo mthong ba yin gsungs pas cung zad de'i ngang mnyam par bzhag de nas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la brtse ba snying rje chen po bsgom par byas te ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi don du slar rang gi se mas dang bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur ba 572

de las slar 'od 'phros te rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs yongs su khra lam mer sngar bzhin gsal gdab ste/ ji srid khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid ma stong gi bar du de srid du bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rten dang brtan pa bcas pa bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar snang la rang bzhin med par bzhugs par gsal gdab ste rten 'brel snying po'i sngags lan gsum bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ ye nyi rma he tu pra dzha wā he tu rnye ṣa rnya thu ga 41 / (shā /to hya ba data/ te ṣā nyu yo ni ro dhwa e waṃ bā rdu mahā shra ma ṇaḥye snga hā// zhes bla ma sman rgyal g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom rim rdzogs so// // 573

mjug byang /bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gzhi rtsa rmang gzhir bzung ba'i thog mdo sngags kyi chos tshul zab mo spyi dang lhag par skye dngos dang / srog chags/ rang byung gi gter kha/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi 'byung ba sogs shes bya'i chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i srol rgyun gyi rig gzhung tshad ldan zhig yin stabs nang pa'i chos dang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'di gnyis deng sang tshan rtsal rig pa dang shog zung lta bu mnyam du bskyod thub pa ris med 'gro ba kun la phan bde dang sri zhu'i bya ba legs par sgrub thub pa'i khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin ldan yod/de yang phran la dus yun lo ngo lnga yi nang rig gzhung 'di nyid la sbyang brtson cung zad byed rgyu'i go bskal bzang po thob par brten slob gnyer gyi zhor du dus kyi khom pa nam byung la zin bris bkod pa rnams don med chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i slad du dpe deb 'di bzhin 'don spel zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa byung stabs/ bod gzhung dbus sman rtsis khang gi 'gan drung phur bu stobs rgyal mchog la re bskul zhus pa ltar res gza' nyi ma sogs las zhor du dpar rtsa bcug sgrig dang / zhu dag deb gzugs 'char 'god sogs thugs 'gan gtso bor bzhes thog lha sa ba bu mo 574

mtshams lags kyis deb 'di'i dpar rtsa phal che ba glog klad nang du bcug sgrig gnang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs sa ra mtho rim slob grwa'i bod dge ngag dbang rdo rje lags kyis kyang dpar rtsa bcug sgrig gi rogs ram mdzad/deb 'di'i rags zin tsam grub rjes 7sku'i bla sman zur pa dge slong ye shes don ldan la spyan bstar zhus te dpe deb 'di'i gleng brjod dang / lam ston bka' slob gang mang thob pa ma zad/ snyedapal ldan bod gzhung sman rtsis khang gi 'gan 'dzin dang 7sku'i 'phrod bzhes zhabs zhu ba gcig lcogs mdzad bzhin pa'i mkhas dbang sman rams pa zla ba mchog nas kyang sngon gleng dang lam ston gnang ba ma zad/ deb 'di'i mdun shog ri mo bkod chog pa'i zhal bzhes kyang thob/ de bzhin rda sa rig lam slob gnyer khang gi grogs po 'jal dpal sdo rje lags kyis mdun shog gi yig ris bris gnang mdzad pa dang / lhag par du sman ming 'dzin pa'i spogs po nya rong shar tshe brten mi 'gyur lags dang / bar bu phun tshogs bstan dar lags/ go jo bstan 'dzin mgon po lags gsum gyis dpar chas dang dpar ris khag dpar du blangs rgyu'i thugs 'gan bzhes/de bzhin mdun chu bstan 'dzin ye shes lags kyis dpar ris khag sgrig sbyor dang 'od sder gyi mthun sbyor rogs ram gnang /deb 'di'i ma zin gang tsam legs grub zin mtshams su phran nas 575

re bskul zhus pa bzhin sman rtsis mtho slob khang gi nang chos dang rig gnas kyi dge rgan 'bras klu dge bshes bstan pa bkra shis mchog gis zhus dag dang lam ston gang mang mdzad/ rgyun du rang nyid nas blta zhib lan mang byas kyang slob gnyer byed pa'i brel zing spyi dang / sgos su thon rgyugs chen mo gtong ba'i skabs 'khel bas nor 'dzol byung dogs kyis phran bod du bskyod dgos ba'i skabs su lto kha ba zla ba dang / phun tshogs bstan dar gnyis kyis gzigs zhib gang legs gnang na'ang da dung phyogs gang sar nor 'khrul yong nges pas rgya che'i gzigs pa po'i spyan sngar dgongs sel zhu rgyu yin/deb 'di'i dpar du saskrun rgyu'i mthun rkyen gyi rogs dngul gtso bo gam pa sprul 'khor khyim tshang dang / jar man de'i sman pa khug (21—pu dzi50tha )gnyis kyis rgyab skyor tshad med gnang byung ba bcas mdor na phran nas gong smros rogs ram gnang mkhan tshang mar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu dang sbrags/ skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du 'gro ba'i laspyi nor mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi ma nor lam bzang gi thugs rje'i zhabs bzung bla med 'og rgyal ba sman gyi bla mas rjes su bzung ba'i smon lam dang bstan dang 'gro ba kun la phan bde'i gzhi mar 'gyur ba'i re 'dun dang bcas/ gam pa sprul 'khor skal bzang gis/ phyi lo 2007 zla 6 tshes 10 la// //576

dkar byang smon chig rnam grol zhi ba'i rgya mtshor ro gcig tu/ /gzhol ba'i mtha' yas chos tshul dal 'babs klung / /tshig gi gzegs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma yongs 'khrud legs bshad bdud rtsi 'di/ /dpar du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung po'i mthus/ /yang dag chos kyi sgo mo stong phrag brgya/ /ga dngas te rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog /ces shākya'i dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos ris med nang bstan gyi grub mtha' kun dpar du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'o// //577

nya khu nga don nga bsdu 4 0juge'adi'inang gsorig sman gyi gzhung lugs dpal rno rī de na bla gnyis pa g.yu thog yon tan mgon 'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams ba chos sogs nang pa'i chos dang gsob rig pa'i gzhung lugs gnyin mong zung 'brel thog tu bkral yod cing yang thun mong phyi yi sngon 'grodang /na min nang gi stona'agro'i sa bcad chen poganyis su dbye mdaganyis pa/na mong phyi yi sngona'agro'i rim par dal 'byor snyed dka' tshemi rtagakhor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu'abras thar ba'i phanayonan pa'i sgom spyod gsum/ lus nad gnyen pogasum/ge ba'i bshes gnyen skor bcas le'ubargyad kyi nang du bstanayodagasum pa thun min nang sngona'atsho rim paraskyabasa'ams skyed/ bstod phyag maṇḍal smanasgrub rdor semasas la'i tshogs bsagasasdigathog bla ma'i rnama'/smorab byungakhe ba ge late ba/rdo/snapa//spyi nga po bal go4ri'i 4 4 sta stage 24 tshone
